Description
Who We Are:
﻿
The 4M story is likely one you haven’t heard before: We are on a mission to unlock access to the world below us, to do for the world below ground what Google Maps did for the world above. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we are mapping the subsurface infrastructure to make reliable, real-time utility data accessible to the construction industry - completely transforming a traditional industry.
We’re a growing startup with 120 employees currently based in Tel Aviv, Israel, and Austin, Texas.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Software Engineer with a strong inclination toward geospatial technologies to join our GeoTech team as a key contributor. In this role, you'll help process and structure all data coming into our product, execute data pipelines, and maintain data quality. Your role will be pivotal in creating a unified, up-to-date, and accurate utilities map, services, and applications for accelerating our mapping operations. Your contributions will directly impact our core product's success.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of software solutions, ensuring alignment with project goals and objectives.
Provide technical guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and supportive team culture.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers and QA engineers, to deliver high-quality software products.
Design and implement CI/CD processes for data processing, releasing, testing and monitoring, ensuring robustness and consistency.
Create and manage data infrastructure components, including ETL workflows, databases, supporting seamless data flow and accessibility.
Develop and optimize complex Python-based applications and services to allow more efficient data processing capabilities, enhancing quality and accuracy of our data.
Conduct technical reviews of third-party tools, frameworks and technologies.
Identify technical debt and areas for improvement, implementing solutions to enhance code quality and maintainability.
implement technologies, industry trends and software development methodologies.
Requirements
Required Qualifications
5+ years as a backend/software engineer with solid Python skills
Proven experience with AI development tools - we use Claude Code as a daily tool on our team
Familiarity with Airflow (or comparable orchestration)
Experience with AWS services
Solid PostgreSQL/SQL skills
Solid debugging skills
Kubernetes/Docker
English Fluent - written and verbal
AI-First Mindset
We are building an AI-first engineering culture, and we're looking for engineers who are genuinely excited about working this way.
You don't need to arrive with a fully formed AI workflow — but you should have the curiosity and the drive to develop one.
This means you are experimenting with AI tools (code assistants, LLMs) and see AI as a multiplier of your craft.
Preferred Qualifications (not required!)
3+ years in GIS/Geospatial development experience (PostGIS, GeoParquet, GDAL, coordinate systems)
Civil engineering related experience
Experience working with message queues
Experience with ArgoCD, Helm, or KEDA in Kubernetes environments

The role holder will act as a key stakeholder in shaping the 888 customer proposition, improving lifecycle performance, maximising customer retention and driving long-term player value within a highly competitive and regulated market.
A strong understanding of customer behaviour, segmentation, campaign performance and promotional optimisation is essential, alongside the ability to balance commercial performance with customer experience and regulatory compliance.
What you’ll be doing :
Define the customer proposition strategy for the 888 brand in Spain across Sportsbook and Gaming products.
Coordinate execution of the ATL campaign plans alongside CRM teams to deliver targeted campaigns across email, push, SMS, onsite and other communication channels.
Manage and evolve the 888 customer proposition, ensuring promotional mechanics and engagement strategies remain competitive and relevant to the Spanish market.
Work closely with BI and Analytics teams to analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour and segmentation opportunities.
Identify trends and actionable insights to improve retention, customer value and engagement performance.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and customer data to drive business decisions.
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Strong project management and organisational capabilities.

About the role
The Information Security Analyst plays a key role in delivering the organization's information security roadmap by combining technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. This role is responsible for supporting day-to-day security operations, including security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and the continuous improvement of security processes and capabilities.
Working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, you will serve as a security subject matter expert, providing technical guidance, consultancy, and security advice to projects and business stakeholders. Leveraging your experience in Information Security, you will proactively identify threats, enhance detection capabilities, and help strengthen the organization's overall security posture while ensuring the consistent delivery of security services.
The role blends hands-on technical responsibilities with business engagement, including supporting security initiatives, developing and optimizing monitoring and detection capabilities, participating in incident response activities, and collaborating closely with teams across Security Architecture, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), Security Engineering, and IT to implement and maintain effective security controls.
What you will be doing:
Technical Delivery
As an Information Security Analyst, you will play a hands-on role in strengthening the organisation's security posture by designing, improving, and operating key security capabilities.
You will:
Partner with technical and project teams to gather operational security requirements and ensure security is embedded throughout delivery.
Support the implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of security monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities.
Develop, tune, and maintain detection rules and use cases to improve threat visibility while reducing false positives.
Collaborate with Delivery, Product, and Planning teams to help shape security priorities and contribute to the security roadmap.
Support the vulnerability management lifecycle by validating findings, assisting with remediation prioritisation, and verifying remediation activities.
Perform proactive threat hunting across endpoint, identity, cloud, and network telemetry to identify emerging threats before they trigger alerts.
Deploy, maintain, and optimise Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, investigating web-based attacks and enhancing application protection.
Investigate security events across endpoints, identities, networks, cloud platforms, and applications using EDR/XDR, SIEM, and cloud-native security tools.
Monitor and investigate security events across AWS environments, supporting the organisation's cloud security operations.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive security processes and contribute to the development of SOAR playbooks and security automation initiatives.
Participate in all phases of the incident response lifecycle, including detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews.
Produce high-quality technical documentation, incident reports, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
Security Operations & Collaboration
Working closely with teams across Security and IT, you will help evolve operational security capabilities while providing practical security guidance across the business.
You will:
Collaborate with Product Owners, Delivery teams, and business stakeholders to define operational security requirements.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of operational processes, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.
Assess the effectiveness and coverage of logging, monitoring, alerting, and detection capabilities, identifying opportunities for enhancement.
Work closely with Security Architecture, Security Engineering, and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) teams to strengthen enterprise-wide security capabilities.
Consume and analyse threat intelligence, translating relevant intelligence into actionable detections, hunting activities, and preventive controls.
Participate in security reviews for new technologies, projects, and services, providing operational security recommendations.
Support the development of operational metrics, reporting, and dashboards to measure the effectiveness of monitoring, detection, and incident response capabilities.
Job Requierments
Who we are looking for:
We're looking for a security professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, thrives in a collaborative environment, and has a passion for continuous improvement.
You should have:
Hands-on experience working within Information Security Operations.
Practical experience supporting Security Operations Centre (SOC) and Incident Response functions.
Experience administering, tuning, and maintaining Web Application Firewall (WAF) technologies.
Experience investigating and responding to security incidents using established incident response methodologies.
Proven experience performing proactive threat hunting using SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud, and identity telemetry.
Experience working with enterprise SIEM platforms such as Splunk.
Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR) technologies.
Experience monitoring and investigating security events within AWS environments.
Strong understanding of security monitoring, detection engineering, and alert optimisation.

888 Holdings.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Cyber Security Engineer to join our security team and help protect our organization across multiple layers of infrastructure and technology.
In this role, you will be responsible for implementing, managing, and maintaining security controls across cloud and on-premises environments, networks, endpoints, applications, and data. You will work closely with the Security Architecture team , translating security standards and designs into effective operational controls.
This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys working with security technologies, solving real-world security challenges, responding to incidents, and continuously improving the organization's security posture.
What you will be doing:
Perimeter Security
Collaborate with the Security Architecture team to implement perimeter security controls designed to protect against unauthorized access and external threats.
Manage firewall policies and Web Application Firewalls (WAF) according to security architecture standards.
Operate security mechanisms designed to mitigate DDoS attacks and other external attack vectors.
Deploy and maintain cloud security guardrails and configurations across AWS, GCP, and Azure workloads.
Network Security
Implement network segmentation and enforce security policies across internal systems in collaboration with the Security Architecture team.
Manage email security solutions and protocols to protect against phishing, spam, and malware.
Implement and maintain mobile security solutions to protect devices and corporate data.
Manage web proxy configurations to control and monitor internet traffic and ensure secure web usage.
Operate Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS) to identify and respond to potential threats.
Manage network patching processes to ensure systems remain up to date and protected against known vulnerabilities.
Endpoint Security
Implement and manage endpoint protection solutions to protect devices against malware, unauthorized access, and other threats.
Deploy and maintain Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions in line with architectural standards.
Continuously assess and improve endpoint security posture and address identified vulnerabilities.
Application Security & DevSecOps
Work with development teams and Security Architects to integrate security best practices throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) .
Conduct security reviews and implement safeguards across code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and applications .
Help enforce secure coding practices and application security standards defined by the Security Architecture team.
Experience with GitLab, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Terraform, or CloudFormation is a plus.
Experience working in a DevSecOps environment is a plus.
Data Security & Compliance
Implement encryption and data protection mechanisms to safeguard sensitive information.
Support compliance with relevant regulatory and industry standards, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001 .
Partner with the Compliance team on data security audits and implement preventive and corrective measures to reduce the risk of data leakage.
SOC & Incident Response
Configure security alerts, monitoring scenarios, and detection mechanisms within SOC tools according to Security Architecture guidelines.
Support the execution of incident response plans and procedures , ensuring security incidents are addressed quickly and effectively.
Participate in root cause analysis following security incidents and implement remediation strategies.
Conduct regular security assessments, audits, and testing to maintain operational readiness and continuously strengthen security controls.
Job Requierments
Who we are looking for:
Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field .
Strong hands-on experience implementing security controls across perimeter, network, endpoint, application, and data security .
Experience with at least one major public cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure .
Proven experience in security operations and incident response .
Experience working with security technologies such as firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP, email security, and web proxies .
Good understanding of cloud security, network security, endpoint security, and application security .
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and security standards , including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001.
Experience with CI/CD, IaC, Terraform, CloudFormation, or DevSecOps is a plus.
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are a plus.
A hands-on, proactive approach with the ability to investigate security issues, work across teams, and turn security requirements into practical solutions.
*Please provide an English CV with your application.

responsibilities
In our CNC team, you will machine highly demanding and specialized materials using advanced technologies such as ultrasonic-assisted milling and grinding, CNC machining, deep-hole drilling, cylindrical grinding, and waterjet cutting.
You will work with a continuously expanding fleet of more than 50 enhanced and partly unique CNC machines, including the world's largest installation of ultrasonic machining centers. Thanks to our extensive expertise, we achieve levels of precision that go beyond the machines’ technical capabilities. We will provide you with a comprehensive and personalized onboarding program to share this knowledge and support your success. In return, we offer long-term career prospects and a wide range of professional development opportunities in the CNC field.
As a CNC milling operator, you will:
Machine highly demanding workpieces made of glass, glass-ceramics, and advanced technical ceramics according to engineering drawings and predefined programs.
Operate multiple 5-axis CNC machines simultaneously, as required, following defined procedures and using Heidenhain or Sinumerik control systems.
Prepare the required tooling for production.
Set up and configure CNC machines.
Prepare components for subsequent production processes.
Education and experience
Successfully completed vocational training as a Machinist, CNC Milling Operator, Flat Glass Mechanic, or Metal Technology Specialist, or in a comparable technical field.
Several years of solid experience in machining with 5-axis CNC milling machines and extensive practical knowledge of demanding manufacturing processes.
Ability to confidently and independently make adjustments in Siemens controls (840D and Sinumerik One) as well as DIN programs, implementing required modifications reliably and accurately.
Willingness to work in a three-shift operation.
Good German language skills, both written and spoken.
Skills
You enjoy working in a team, are approachable, and communicate clearly.
You possess excellent fine motor skills and outstanding manual dexterity.
You understand your responsibilities and work in a highly reliable manner.
You work carefully and maintain a high level of concentration; therefore, quality and error prevention are top priorities for you.
You demonstrate patience when carrying out lengthy production processes.
You enjoy working in a dynamic environment and can adapt flexibly to new situations.
You are committed, proactive, and eager to continue developing your skills.
What we offer
Job with bright future prospects at an innovation leader in the semiconductor industry in Berlin Neukölln
Remuneration in accordance with the IG Metall collective wage agreement (company[1]specific collective wage agreement) including 13th month’s salary and variable remuneration components
Collective working time: 35 hours/week
Attractive allowances in the shift model
Reimbursement of moving expenses for you and your family
Participation in the Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Specific advanced training and development opportunities
Access to organized childcare and vacation care
Comprehensive health and well-being programs
Mobility benefits to support your commute: company transit pass, parking card, and bike purchase program
Dein Arbeitsumfeld
An unserem Standort in Berlin fertigen unsere Mitarbeitendenden Schlüsselkomponenten für die ASML Lithografiesysteme. Als Teil unserer Präzisionsfertigung unterstützt du bei der Produktion optischer Komponenten, Baugruppen sowie Systeme aus Glas, Glaskeramik und Keramik für unsere High-Tech-Kleinserien, Einzelteil- und Prototypenfertigung.
Deine Aufgaben
In unserem CNC-Team bearbeitest du hochanspruchsvolle und spezielle Materialien mit modernsten Verfahren wie ultraschallunterstütztem Fräsen und Schleifen, CNC-Zerspanung, Tieflochbohren, Rundschleifen und Wasserstrahlbearbeitung. Dafür steht dir ein stetig wachsender Maschinenpark mit über 50 veredelten, teilweise einzigartigen CNC-Maschinen zur Verfügung – darunter die weltweit größte Anzahl an Ultraschallmaschinen. Durch unser spezielles Know-how erreichen wir Präzision, die über die technischen Möglichkeiten der Maschinen hinausgeht. In einer umfassenden und persönlichen Einarbeitung vermitteln wir dir dieses Wissen und bieten dir langfristige Perspektiven sowie vielfältige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten im CNC-Bereich.
Als CNC Zerspanungsmechaniker:in / CNC Fräser:in wirst du:
unsere sehr anspruchsvollen Werkstücke aus Glas, Glaskeramik und Hochleistungskeramik nach Zeichnung und vorgegebenen Programmen bearbeiten.
je nach Bedarf nach definierten Vorgaben mehrere 5-Achs CNC-Maschinen mit Heidenhain oder Sinumerik Steuerung gleichzeitig bedienen.
die jeweils benötigten Werkzeuge vorbereiten.
CNC-Maschinen rüsten und einrichten.
Bauteile für die nachfolgenden Produktionsprozesse präparieren.
Deine Qualifikation
Du hast eine Ausbildung zum/zur Zerspanungsmechaniker:in, CNC-Fräser:in, Flachglasmechaniker:in oder Fachkraft für Metalltechnik erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
Du bringst langjährige und fundierte Erfahrung in der spanenden Bearbeitung mit 5-Achs-CNC-Fräsmaschinen mit und verfügst über ein tiefgehendes Praxiswissen in anspruchsvollen Fertigungsprozessen.
Du verfügst über die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf sicher und eigenständig in Siemenssteuerungen (840D und Sinumerik One) sowie in DIN-Programmen einzugreifen und notwendige Anpassungen jederzeit zu 100% zuverlässig umzusetzen
Du hast die Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 3-Schichtsystem.
Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Deine Kompetenzen
Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bist kontaktfreudig und klar in der Kommunikation.
Du hast sehr gute feinmotorische Fähigkeiten und ein sehr gutes manuelles Geschick.
Du bist dir der Verantwortung bewusst und handelst sehr zuverlässig.
Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig und hoch konzentriert, demzufolge sollten Qualität und Fehlervermeidung für Dich an oberster Stelle stehen.

ASML.description:
as a means to realize the Vision of the factory. As a Lean Business Partner, you will be the trusted sparring partner of the Install department staff, guiding and supporting them through the change transformation.
Since the beginning of 2017, the foundations were laid to create pull for Lean principles within the EF organization. The EF staff embraced Lean Leadership behavior and the ground-work of Hoshin Kanri, Daily Performance Management and Structured Problem-Solving were laid.
10 years on, the Lean team has expanded their support by “stepping into the dance” of the operations in order to develop the Lean competency required to achieve success in our unique and challenging manufacturing and business environment.
Job Mission
The Lean Business Partner (LBP) reports to the Senior Manager Operational Excellence within the OE department of EF. The LBP is the business partner for the Install department and responsible for driving the Install strategy on Operational Excellence. She / He sets up the performance management system (= be delegate BPO for our L3 Process ‘Performance Management’ in install) and key process indicators, monitors and (co) drives the operational excellence activities, supports and guides teams and leaders with running improvement activities, coaches them in developing problem solving techniques and Lean leadership behavior. As an LBP, you will constructively challenge the status quo and act as a role model for “applied Lean thinking”. You will not be an advisor on the sideline, but you will analyze current operations and come with tangible improvements to be more effective (Quality, Performance), and more efficient (Cycle time, Cost). Some of these improvements you will drive yourself, with the full support of the EF Install staff.
Job Description
The main responsibilities of the LBP are: driving the business performance impact of the Install Operational Excellence program (A3’s, 4C’s, Breakthrough Initiatives) and developing the Lean and Operational Excellence capabilities of the EF Install organization (training, coaching, challenge on Lean principles, being a catalyst in driving the change). The holder of this position also contributes to ASML’s Operational Excellence System by improving the Lean and Operational Excellence standards used within the EF Lean team and ASML.

Drive progress and challenge roadblocks regularly with the Install team and other relevant stakeholders

Be a role model in adapting Lean principles and coach on Lean behavior

The EF Install department is accountable for all worldwide EXE and NXE installs. Our main counterpart - local CS UIR organization - is responsible for the execution of the installs, and has a track record of developing many CI/BKM’s that can be applied in other areas in the world. Our job is to support them in their success, by flawless delivery of New Product Introductions, new site support, transformation improvements (Lean, BPI, IT), operational management (2-in-a-box), and continuous improvement.

ASML.description:
As a system integrator in a complex ecosystem, ASML depends on suppliers for the majority of cost of goods sold.
This model enables flexibility and growth, while requiring suppliers to meet ASML’s standards for quality, logistics, technology, cost and sustainability.
Sourcing & Procurement builds the supplier capabilities needed to deliver ASML’s customer commitments, while managing short-term challenges and developing strategic, mutually beneficial supplier relationships. It is category-focused, with strong account management accountability for the total business relationship and material availability, supported by Centers of Excellence for escalations and cross-functional cluster support.
The position
As Regional Category Strategy Manager Asia, you will shape the Asian long-term supplier strategy for critical products in Machined Ceramics and Glass, optical components and assemblies, light sources, silicon-based devices, metrology and photonics.
A key responsibility will consist of scouting and developing the Asia supply chain for the afore mentioned technologies, with a special eye to securing ASML cost and quality goals; this includes enabling and nurturing relationships at multiple levels in the organization, at ASML and its suppliers
You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy and supplier ecosystem development, influencing decisions central to ASML’s ability to scale, innovate and serve customers.
The role co-defines, aligns and drives category strategies and supplier selections, ensuring stakeholder alignment and effective execution at supplier and account level.
You will collaborate with the Industrial Strategy Department on key make-buy decisions.
Given their strategic importance, category strategies require alignment and approval from ASML the leadership of Business Lines and of Development & Engineering (D&E), as well as the relevant Board of Management representatives.
Key deliverables and responsibilities
Lead Asia supplier landscape development, including supplier scouting, pre-screening, site visits, benchmarking, competency mapping, and supplier shortlisting.
Build a structured Asia supplier-development funnel linked to category strategy, technology roadmaps, benchmarking supplier readiness in terms of Quality, Logistics, Technology, Cost, Sustainability (QLTCS) performance, Intellectual Property protection readiness, and fit with ASML strategy and way of working.
Identify supplier capability gaps and define development actions to enable manufacturing of high complexity components, assemblies, modules, in support of present and future technology requirements.
Translate regional supplier intelligence into strategic recommendations for supplier selection, supplier development, capability investment, risk mitigation, and executive decision-making.
Co-develop and maintain global category strategies, including long-term vision, supplier landscape, technology roadmaps, commercial models, risk-reward considerations and business alignment.
Drive approved category strategies at supplier and account level, monitor deployment gaps and resolve or escalate issues.
Prepare supplier selection proposals, stakeholder alignment and decision-making forums.
Ensure Sourcing & Procurement is engaged early in design, requirement definition and specification development for new product introductions.
Represent the category in cross-functional forums, working closely with D&E and Research & Technology and securing executive support where required.
Support Industrial Strategy in make-buy assessments.
Advance internal and supplier technology roadmaps by defining targets, supporting decision points and aligning priorities across functions.
Purpose of the category strategies
Secure long-term supply chain capabilities for ASML’s business goals.
Build resilience and business continuity in critical supply chains.
Enable ASML technology roadmaps while protecting intellectual property.
Support ASML and customer cost and quality roadmaps.
Contribute to ASML ESG ambitions and manage business cycles.
Candidate profile: education, experience and background
Experience working with suppliers in Asia is beneficial and can help accelerate the effectiveness within the role
Master’s or PhD degree, preferably in a technical, business, supply chain or strategy-related field.
Typically 10–15 years of experience in advanced technology, such as semiconductor, defense, telecom or a similar industry.
Strategy experience in a large international company or consulting; commercial experience in sourcing, account management or product management is an advantage.
Strong technical background in semiconductor equipment design and/or manufacturing.
Skills and personal qualities
Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with the ability to simplify and structure complex issues.
Ability to influence without formal authority and drive decisions using technology, commercial, geopolitical and execution insights.
Ability to translate data, observations and business context into strategic recommendations and actionable plans.
Strong collaboration skills with internal and external leaders, partners and stakeholders, including the ability to find workable compromises.
Management maturity, organizational awareness and sound judgment in multidisciplinary and virtual teams.
Clear, concise and impactful communication, including presentations to senior executives and decision-making bodies.
Planning discipline, execution focus, entrepreneurship and resilience in a demanding, fast-changing environment.
The team
The Category Strategy Manager will be based in Tokyo and report to the Head of Cluster Strategy for the MLP cluster, who is based in Veldhoven, the Netherlands. The Category Strategy team consists of 7–8 experienced professionals located in the Netherlands, the USA and Asia. It works closely with the Industrial Strategy MLP team and Asia Transfers program; together, the extended team counts about 15 people. Close

As a Senior Algorithms & Controls Engineer, you will lead the development of advanced control solutions that ensure stable, efficient, and reliable EUV light generation. Working at the intersection of control systems, automation, software, sensors, data analytics, and plasma physics, you will drive technical innovation, mentor engineers, and solve complex multidisciplinary challenges that directly impact the performance of ASML's next-generation lithography platforms.
Role and responsibilities
As a Senior Algorithms & Controls Engineer, you will serve as a technical expert within the Plasma Controls Department, responsible for developing and integrating advanced control systems that enable stable EUV light production. You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept development through qualification and manufacturing support.

ASML.description:
As a HMI (Holistic Metrology and Inspection, ASML) Service engineer, you are responsible for ensuring that the inspection equipment operates reliably at the customer fab and achieves the required performance and uptime.
Role and responsibilities
The service engineer is the primary technical representative of the company at the customer site. The role combines strong technical expertise with excellent interpersonal skills to ensure high equipment performance, operational continuity, and customer satisfaction.
You are responsible for the repair and maintenance of the HMI systems at Crolles (France) from Monday-Friday. Depending on the future business needs you might be required to work shifts.
You will participate to the installation of the new HMI machines with the dedicated installation team.
You will be the local HMI expert and will develop your autonomy to :
Diagnose, analyze and solve technical problems
Ensure preventive and curative maintenance of equipment
Implement "software" and "hardware" updates
Efficiently escalate the most difficult problems to the HMI 2nd lines
Develop a solid relationship with the client: technical assistance, advices, support
Most of the work is done in a clean room environment, under strict hygiene and safety conditions.
Regularly you will be asked to support remotely or on-site other customers equipped with a HMI machine, mainly in Belgium, Germany and Ireland with an estimated travel of 30-40% of your working time.
Working in customer support is challenging due to the changing dynamics and pressure to repair machines as quickly as possible. But the work is also very rewarding since you work directly with the customer and the impact of your solutions delivered is directly visible and the end result is always a happy customer.
Education and experience
You have minimally a BTS or DUT (Higher National Diploma equivalent) in an engineering field
You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in a hands-on role (working directly on the machine).
You are upper intermediate (B2) in English. Speaking French will be an added value.
Skills
Self-motivated and flexibility
Pragmatic attitude, motivated, pro-active, self-driven and flexible
Good team player who is committed to the success of ASML
Strong analytical ability and focus on problem solving
Analytical mind, problem solving
Very good communication skills both verbal and written
Dynamic, proactive, autonomous and a great motivation to acquire new knowledge
Continuous improvement mindset
Other information
You will evolve and develop within an international and multicultural group of more than 45000 employees worldwide. Extensive training will be provided abroad during 3 weeks on top of several CBT (Computer Base Training). We offer you a permanent contract.

ActiveFence.description:
In this role, you will be on the front lines of investigating complex online child safety violations, handling sensitive content reviews, and developing technical automations to scale our policy and enforcement operations.
This is a high-impact, multi-faceted position that requires blending deep domain expertise in child safety with hands-on scripting and data engineering skills to transform raw queue data into actionable signals and automated review processes.
Key Responsibilities
Investigate & Evaluate Complex Cases: Review, validate, and adjudicate high-risk, graphic, and sensitive child safety content, navigating nuanced contexts involving legal, medical, or parental scenarios.
Extract Signals & Insights: Analyze review queues, large datasets, and user-generated content to identify new adversarial shifts, unknown unknowns, and critical keywords that inform policy updates.
Build Local Automations & Scripts: Design, write, and maintain scripts and local tools to automate review workflows, generate suggestions, and increase overall queue efficiency.
Policy & Enforcement Collaboration: Translate raw investigation findings into structured intelligence reports and actionable recommendations for client policy frameworks and engineering teams.
Quality & Model Support: Partner with product and AI teams to label golden datasets, support ML-based labeling QA, and improve automated detection models.
Requirements
Minimum 5 years of specialized experience in online child safety, content policy enforcement, or related threat intelligence research.
Workplace Requirement: Ability to work full-time (5 days a week) on-site from our office.
Content Resilience: Demonstrated ability and willingness to handle continuous exposure to graphic, harsh, and distressing child safety content.
Domain & Policy Expertise: Deep subject matter expertise in online child safety, content review operations, and handling complex review queues.
Technical & Automation Skills: Hands-on experience writing scripts (e.g., Python, Bash) and building local workflow automations to process data and optimize queue operations.
Data & Signal Extraction: Proven capability to analyze large datasets, spot emerging patterns/signals, and extract actionable insights for policy enforcement.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English to produce detailed intel reports.
About Alice
THE CHALLENGES ALONG THE WAY
1. Being Both Strategist and Executioner
One of the hardest parts of this role is that you’re both the visionary and the builder; the one drawing the map and paving the road.
That means switching between high-level strategy and hands-on experimentation daily, and doing it while bringing others along with you. There’s no playbook for this kind of work. You’re paving an unpaved road, one small experiment at a time.
‍
2. Balancing Security and Innovation
ActiveFence is the leading provider of security and safety solutions for online experiences, safeguarding more than 3 billion users, top foundation models, and the world’s largest enterprises and tech platforms every day.
As a trusted ally to major technology firms and Fortune 500 brands that build user-generated and GenAI products, ActiveFence empowers security, AI, and policy teams with low-latency Real-Time Guardrails and a continuous Red Teaming program that pressure-tests systems with adversarial prompts and emerging threat techniques. Powered by deep threat intelligence, unmatched harmful-content detection, and coverage of 117+ languages, ActiveFence enables organizations to deliver engaging and trustworthy experiences at global scale while operating safely and responsibly across all threat landscapes.

Aitech is a leading provider of rugged, mission-critical embedded computing solutions for aerospace, defense, and space applications. We develop innovative technologies for some of the world's most demanding operational environments.
At Aitech, we are leveraging AI to improve operational effectiveness, accelerate execution, enhance employee and customer experiences, and strengthen business performance.
Position Summary
The Director of AI Enablement is both a builder and a transformation leader, someone who can identify opportunities, design and implement AI solutions, and drive adoption across the organization to create measurable business value.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role at the intersection of business transformation, technology, and organizational change.
The successful candidate will lead Aitech's AI roadmap, build practical AI solutions, drive adoption across functions, and help transform how work is performed throughout the organization.

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone. 

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Database Operations team — a cross-cutting team that keeps Aiven's database services (PostgreSQL, Valkey, and MySQL) stable, automated, and running efficiently at scale.

Our philosophy is to automate everything and to avoid repetitive manual work in everything we do. Our own backend systems are mostly implemented in Python with bits of Java, Go and C.

What You'll Do:

  • Write high-quality, maintainable code and release quality features.
  • Participate in technical discussions and perform PR reviews.
  • Contribute to technical planning and backlog management.
  • Help investigate and resolve customer issues.
  • Mentor and empower other engineers.
  • Automate processes to eliminate repetitive manual work.
  • Develop and improve the scalability, reliability, and operational quality of our PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Valkey services.

What We're Looking For:

Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t line up perfectly – we still encourage you to apply! We believe in investing in our crabs’ professional growth.

Must Have:

  • Excellent development skills in Python
  • 5+ years of experience working with one of these databases - PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Valkey/Redis, or similar
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and DevOps practices in production environments
  • Experience with backup solutions and backup strategies
  • Advanced understanding of Linux OS
  • Experience with automated testing
  • Distributed systems knowledge
  • Experience with performance improvements, bug fixes, and security vulnerability resolution
  • Fluency in English, verbal and written.

Nice to Have:

  • Good understanding of security (software, networking)
  • Experience in cloud DBAAS production environments

Amazing! What’s next:

If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!

Global Benefits:

Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:

  • Participate in Aiven’s equity plan.
  • Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy.
  • Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success.
  • Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities.
  • Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program.
  • Inquire about our Global Time Off Commitment (Parental and Sick Leave, as well as Personal Time)
  • Enjoy country-specific benefits for our global cast.

How to Recognize and Avoid Employment Scams:

There has been a rise in fake job postings used by scammers to get personal information. At Aiven, all of our emails relating to recruitment come from an @aiven.io, @greenhouse.io or @eu.greenhouse.io domain and all of our interviews are conducted by video call or in person.  Our interviews will never occur via text or chat. If you’re unsure of the legitimacy of a job opportunity/offer pertaining to Aiven, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at recruitment@aiven.io.

Equal Opportunities:

Aiven provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, marital and family status or without regard to any other similar personal attributes. Aiven complies with applicable local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, training and any other terms and conditions related to employment.

At Aiven we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities or special needs in our working environment and job application procedures. We make all reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities or who otherwise need support to thrive in the workplace. We are committed to continuously improving workplace accessibility. There is an option to request a discussion in the application process but if you have any questions before applying please write to us at recruitment@aiven.io.

As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon Web Services (AWS), is looking for talented engineers to help us develop a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.

AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud, which powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

AWS Graviton is a family of processors designed to deliver the best price performance for cloud workloads running in Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), the world's largest leading Cloud vendor.
We are looking for talented engineers to join our Chip Design team, working on the Graviton product line. Our chip design team is in charge of defining the product's features and working on their architecture and development. Join our innovative team at Annapurna Labs and play a pivotal role in developing next-generation semiconductor platforms that power the world's largest cloud infrastructure. • Drive gate-level simulations to validate DFT functionality and test patterns
• Develop and verify DFT logic using UVM-based testbenches, functional simulation, and coverage-driven verification
• Participate in design reviews, DFT sign-off processes, and tapeout preparation
• Cross-functional collaboration with Design, Verification, Physical Design, and Production/Test teams

As an ISV EMEA Sales Operations Mfr, you will work closely with ISV sales leadership to execute critical business processes including revenue forecasting and planning, territory and coverage optimisation, operational process improvement, and strategic project support. In this role you will be responsible for preparing quarterly and annual tax accounting calculations, driving forward the automation of tax processes, and managing with the US corporation tax filings. The successful applicant will be highly numerate, quick to learn, and motivated by the opportunity to grow within a highly impactful team.
Arm’s Tax Team has recently been shortlisted for In-House Tax Team of the Year at this year's International Tax Review (ITR) awards!
Responsibilities
Preparation of quarterly and annual tax accounting calculations for US groups in accordance with ASC 740.
Preparation and review of federal, state, and local tax returns to ensure compliance with all applicable tax laws and regulations.
Prepare and review foreign entity tax forms (5471, 5472, 8858, 1120F, etc.)
Prepare and review the calculation of GILTI and FDII.
Provide support for tax examinations.
Support tax transformation initiatives to automate tax processes, enhance data analytics, and re-imagine how the tax function operates.
Keep up to date with tax legislation, SEC Regulations, and GAAP changes, practice and global developments.
Build and foster strong cross-functional relationships within and outside of the tax department.
Required Skills and Experience
Bachelor’s degree with major in Accounting or Taxation, CPA designation preferred with 6+ years of experience in tax from public accounting firms and US multinational corporations.
Strong knowledge of US tax laws and regulations, and capability of application in new situations.
Experience and proficiency in U.S. GAAP accounting for taxes and internal controls.
Independent and self-driven with the ability to adapt and get things done in a complex and fast-based environment.
Strong interpersonal/collaboration skills, with an ability to explain tax technical matters and ability to build strong and positive relationships
Skills and Attributes
Strong command of accounting and financial principles, with the ability to apply them to innovative commercial and IP structures.
Strategic problem solver with strong attention to business details and a passion for operational excellence.
Collaborative leader who builds trust and influence across finance, legal, and business functions.
Highly organized, proactive, and capable of leading multiple high‑priority initiatives simultaneously.

As a senior technical leader within the Sales organization, you will serve as a trusted advisor, combining deep system architecture expertise with technical account leadership to drive design wins, business growth, and long-term partner success.
Working closely with Partner Managers, Product Management, and technical development groups, you will engage with customer architects and technical leaders. You will also influence decision-makers to adopt technology and speed up the development of Arm-based solutions. You will lead complex technical engagements spanning architecture, system development, and deployment while helping customers improve the value of solutions based on Arm.
You will also act as the voice of the customer within Arm. You will provide market insights and technical feedback that help develop product strategy, roadmap decisions, and future solutions.
Responsibilities
Act as the primary technical advisor for strategic partner accounts, building positive relationships with architects, engineering leaders, and key decision-makers.
Lead technical engagements that support licensing opportunities, build wins, and successful deployment related to Arm solutions.
Develop a deep understanding of customer product roadmaps, business objectives, technical requirements, and driven challenges to identify growth opportunities.
Provide system-level architectural guidance for Arm-based SoCs and platforms, including CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, Compute Subsystems, system IP, software tools, and Edge AI solutions.
Guide customers in IP selection, configuration, integration, and optimization to meet power, performance, scalability, and time-to-market objectives.
Support customers from architecture definition and design evaluation through implementation and deployment.
Drive adoption of Arm technologies through technical presentations, workshops, demonstrations, and executive-level discussions.
Partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Applications Engineering teams to develop winning technical strategies and ensure successful customer outcomes.
Lead resolution of complex multi-functional and cross-IP technical challenges by coordinating with Support AE, Arm product and engineering teams.
Provide customer feedback, market insights, and competitive intelligence to influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and future solutions.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical rigor.
shown experience in semiconductor, SoC build, applications engineering, system architecture, engineering sales, or related technical roles.
Strong understanding of SoC architecture, system integration, and hardware/software interactions, including processors, memory subsystems, cache coherency, interconnects, and multi-IP designs.
Experience with Arm-based systems, encompassing processors such as CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, compute modules, system IP, development tools, and SoC integration methodologies.
Shown background in Field Applications Engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, technical sales, or similar customer-facing technical roles.
Experience leading technical discussions involving system architecture, efficiency, speed, scalability, and implementation trade-offs.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience with Arm Compute Subsystems (CSS), AI/ML accelerators, graphics technologies, system IP, or advanced SoC architectures.
Experience developing or supporting Edge AI solutions, including AI/ML workloads on embedded and edge platforms.
Prior experience in Field Applications Engineering, Technical Marketing, or Technical Sales within the semiconductor industry.
Experience supporting one or more of the following markets: Edge AI, mobile, consumer, or IoT.
Familiarity with semiconductor IP licensing models and ecosystem-based solution development.
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across multiple functions and organizations.
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.
Demonstrated ability to influence architecture decisions, technology adoption, and design wins with customer engineering teams and technical decision-makers.

Arm.description:
As a trusted advisor, you will partner closely with engineering, product management, licensing, finance, legal, and marketing teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and long-term business growth. Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, consultative selling skills, and the ability to navigate sophisticated technical organizations while developing account strategies that create mutual value for both Arm and its customers.
This position is part of Arm’s North America Sales organization and is based in the San Francisco Bay Area.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Account Management
Develop and complete strategic account plans that drive adoption of Arm IP and expand long-term customer partnerships.
Lead the customer relationship throughout the entire lifecycle—from initial engagement through licensing, deployment, and ongoing account growth.
Build positive relationships with executive leadership, development, product leadership, procurement, and business collaborators.
Identify customer priorities, technology roadmaps, go-to-market strategies, and business objectives to uncover new opportunities for Arm solutions.
Business Development
Expand Arm’s footprint within existing and prospective accounts by identifying new design opportunities and licensing engagements.
Understand customer decision-making processes, competitive alternatives, and market dynamics to position Arm effectively.
Lead sophisticated commercial negotiations while partnering with Licensing, Legal, and Finance to structure successful IP licensing agreements.
Develop innovative account strategies that align customer success with Arm’s long-term business objectives.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with Field Application Engineers, Product Management, Marketing, Licensing, Finance, and Legal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
Coordinate internal resources to address customer requirements and remove barriers to successful engagements.
Partner with Marketing to support lead generation initiatives, industry events, and customer campaigns.
Sales Execution
Lead and maintain a healthy sales pipeline with accurate forecasting and reporting.
Analyze market trends, driven activity, and customer feedback to refine sales strategies and identify emerging opportunities.
Drive customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term account growth by delivering exceptional service and responsiveness.
Required Qualifications
Known to work in a senior sales or strategic account management role within the semiconductor, IP licensing, EDA, or related high-technology industry.
Demonstrated experience leading sophisticated enterprise accounts and executive customer relationships.
Strong understanding of consultative and solution-based selling methodologies.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.
Experience working across global, cross-functional organizations and leading virtual teams.
Strong commercial sense and ability to identify business opportunities with capacity to negotiate sophisticated technology agreements .
Comfortable engaging with VP, SVP, and C-level executives while establishing relationships across engineering and technical organizations.
Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related difficulty, or equivalent shown experience.
Experience selling semiconductor IP, processor IP, EDA solutions, silicon platforms, or related technologies.
Solid understanding of Intellectual Property licensing models and commercial agreements.
Understanding of software or IP revenue recognition principles.
Experience supporting customers in AI, cloud infrastructure, automotive, networking, consumer electronics, or data center markets is a plus.
What You’ll Bring
A customer-first approach with a passion for building long-term strategic partnerships.
The ability to influence without authority and lead across teams with varied strengths.
Critical thinking combined with focused sales execution.
Strong business judgment, integrity, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving.
A growth mindset and passion for helping customers innovate using Arm technology.

requirements, shape enablement priorities, and drive readiness across reference platforms, firmware, OS, and tooling.

Work with internal and external collaborators to identify gaps in feature readiness across kernel, framework, development tools, monitoring systems, power methodology, and broader ecosystem enablement.
Drive prioritisation and trade-off decisions across multiple feature areas, platforms, and release timelines.
Represent software readiness and platform enablement status in planning discussions with senior leadership, partner teams, and ecosystem participants.
Build and scale a balanced team model for reference platform and firmware/platform enablement over time.

Validated experience in software product leadership, platform software, or ecosystem enablement in a customer-facing environment.
Strong understanding of system software, firmware, platform bring-up, or OS enablement.
Experience defining strategy and execution for software that bridges early technology validation and productization.
Ability to translate technical capabilities into partner value, requirements, roadmap priorities and clarifying ambiguous technical needs into well-defined work.
Strong partner management and multi-functional leadership skills across business and engineering teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align senior partners around scope, priorities, and delivery models.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Experience with Arm architecture, Arm-based SoCs, or Arm platform software.
Familiarity with client or compute platform bring-up across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments.
Experience with Android upstreaming, kernel enablement, performance tooling, telemetry, power measurement, or compiler/toolchain integration.
Experience leading the transition from prototype or research code into stable, maintainable, customer-ready software.
Knowledge of ecosystem enablement challenges for advanced features spanning firmware, OS, tooling, and applications.
Experience working with release alignment constraints, such as feature readiness tied to Android or other OS release cycles.

Help develop products that will define the future of AI compute and define what extraordinary product management looks like in AI infrastructure. Arm.description:
Responsibilities:
Perform adversarial security analysis of SoC and chiplet micro-architectures, identifying unknown or emerging vulnerabilities across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments.
Engage with project teams at different stages of the development lifecycle to review architecture, micro-architecture, system-level specifications, security assumptions, RTL implementations, and firmware components.
Participate in design reviews, security discussions, and focused hackathons to develop new threat scenarios, perform adversarial testing, and improve security models.
Apply automation, scripting, and AI-assisted techniques where appropriate to support vulnerability discovery, specification analysis, test generation, triage, or exploration of complex attack surfaces.
Demonstrate the practical impact of vulnerabilities by developing Proofs of Concept (PoCs), exploits, and security demonstrations where appropriate.
Investigate multi-stage and cross-component attack chains beyond those captured in threat models or standard verification activities.
Collaborate closely with internal security researchers and engineering teams to accelerate security assessments and identify effective mitigations.
Contribute to improving threat models, security mitigations, and security architecture recommendations based on assessment findings.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of offensive security methodologies, tools, and best practices across the SoC Offensive Security team.
Required Skills and Experience:
Strong knowledge of SoC architecture and IP integration.
Thread modeling standalone IPs and Subsystems. Candidate should have experience enumerating micro-architectural attack surfaces and SoC integration concerns.
Demonstrated experience conducting adversarial assessments (PoCs, exploits, CTFs, published work).
Practical experience with SystemVerilog RTL, UVM-based validation environments and HW Dev IDEs
Comfortable reusing current verification environments and adapting them for negative and offensive testing.
Hands-on lab experience setting up development and testing platforms, delivering security evaluations, and validating findings in practical environments.
Firmware security analysis experience on projects like UEFI, uBoot, MCUBoot, Trusted Firmware or similar.
Experience with security focused specifications and standards such as Caliptra, DICE, or related attestation and hardware root-of trust standards.
Strong, determined problem solving outlook with creative security mentality.
Great communication skills, with the ability to influence design teams and clearly articulate risk and recommendations.
Ability to independently conduct complex technical investigations across assigned areas of responsibility.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:
Familiarity with typical Hardware interface standards : PCIe, CXL, SMBus, SPI, I2C, UART, etc.
Familiarity with ARM’s AMBA interconnect protocols: AXI, CHI, CXS, APB, ATB, LPI, etc.
Experience with formal proof tools and approaches for HW Security.
Experience with TEE and their HW building blocks. Should be able to elaborate on what is in the TCB of a confidential VM.
Experience with hardware fuzzing in pre and post silicon environments
Experience with software exploitation techniques.
Reverse engineering skills for hardware, firmware, or microarchitecture.
Contributions to open standard bodies or participation in security-focused special interest groups (e.g., industry working groups, architecture forums).
In Return:
You will join a team of hard-working security engineers at the forefront of identifying vulnerabilities in Arm based systems. Your work will shape the security posture of silicon programs and provide opportunities to influence architectural direction, collaborate with extraordinary engineers, and conduct hands-on offensive security research.
This role offers a unique opportunity to have direct impact on silicon designs, contribute to industry leading security practices, and help ensure Arm’s next generation of solutions are robust against evolving adversaries. Arm is proud to foster an inclusive, diverse, and collaborative environment where your expertise and creativity will be valued.

responsibility of the Project Manager is to lead successful Cloud-based software implementations within project timelines and budgets. You will manage the project including developing work plans, scheduling resources, setting goals and priorities, tracking and resolving issues and customer acceptance.

· Ability to maintain excellent colleague and customer relationships
· Experience managing Full Life Cycle Solution Delivery projects
· Familiarity with Risk Management and Quality Management
· Experience anticipating problems and initiating corrective action
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Why join us?
Why Join Us?
As a trusted global Salesforce partner, we lead complex and large-scale digital transformation initiatives for some of the world's most recognized brands. You'll be part of an agile, innovation-driven environment, working alongside top-tier Salesforce professionals across the globe.

AstraZeneca.description:
As an MSL at AstraZeneca, you will build trusted scientific partnerships with Key External Experts and healthcare professionals, translating the latest data into meaningful insights and actions. You will be 60% field-based, engaging face-to-face across your territory and partnering closely with an office-based Medical Affairs Manager for your therapeutic area to connect scientific strategy with on-the-ground reality.
In this role, you will help align medical and commercial objectives without compromising on ethics—fueling our growth and enabling continued investment in research. Your work will ensure that the right data reaches the right stakeholders at the right time, improving decision-making and, ultimately, patient outcomes.
Accountabilities: Scientific Exchange and Insight Generation: Conduct high-quality scientific discussions with KEEs and HCPs; gather and synthesize field insights to inform medical strategy and brand planning.Therapeutic Area Mastery: Maintain up-to-date expertise on the TA, treatment paradigms, and competitor data through literature review, congress attendance, and expert engagement.Account Plan Execution: Deliver medical components of account plans to time and budget, ensuring activities address identified gaps and opportunities.Expert Partnership Development: Build deep, trust-based relationships with KEEs; map interests, identify collaboration opportunities, and support local practice change.Evidence Discussion and Data Gap Identification: Present and discuss key data sets to uncover evidence gaps, patient pathways, and unmet needs aligned to TA strategy.Scientific Events and Education: Initiate and co-create scientific events with KEEs; lead journal clubs and one-to-one scientific exchanges that elevate disease and therapy understanding.Digital Medical Engagement: Produce compliant scientific digital content (e.g., newsletters, approved emails) as part of integrated medical plans to broaden reach and impact.Field Intelligence and Internal Collaboration: Share actionable insights with cross-functional teams; contribute to the core strategic plan and educate key account managers and colleagues on disease and therapies.Clinical Study and Early Access Support: Support AZ-sponsored clinical studies (site selection and initiation) and contribute to bridging/early access programs where relevant.Externally Sponsored Research and Funding Stewardship: Manage ESRs, grants, donations, and third-party scientific sponsorships with rigor and transparency.Real-World Evidence and Care Transformation: Identify partners, including KEEs and Sick Funds, to develop real-world data initiatives and care-improvement projects that enable local practice change.Network and Best Practice Sharing: Collaborate with MSLs across countries and TAs to exchange best practices and continuously evolve the role.Congress Participation: Attend national congresses and, as required, represent the TA at international meetings to bring back insights and strengthen external networks.Medical Information and Documentation: Respond to medical information requests via approved platforms; document all interactions thoroughly and on time in the designated systems.Compliance and Continuous Improvement: Complete all training; uphold AZ policies and external codes; seek feedback through training and joint field visits to refine communication and insight-gathering skills.
Essential Skills/Experience: - MD/PharmD/PhD/DVM or equivalent - Significant and robust experience with searching, handling, assimilating, synthesizing, reporting, and presenting scientific data in the healthcare sector- Quick self-learner, ability, and willingness to work in a team and independently.- National mobility and flexibility in attendance of local events outside of working hours- Ability to multitask effectively, demonstrate strong time management skills, and excel under pre-specified deadlines- Excellent relational and communication skills- Ability to build and maintain strategic partnerships with a diverse range of stakeholders.- Takes initiative and proactive were needed while conscious of compliance and process rules in the company- Presentation skills- Medical integrity and ethical balance- Fluent knowledge of English (verbal and written)
Desirable Skills/Experience: - Experience in and knowledge of pharmaceutical medical and marketing processes- Knowledge of therapeutic area. Broad employability in other TAs is an asset.- Experience in moderation of meetings with HCPs- Business Acumen- Proven Project management skills- Digital capabilities, experience in creating digital assets- Ability to rapidly shift between multiple projects and managing field-office workload - Experience in production of scientific events- Ability to distinguish between the main and the minor
Why AstraZeneca: Here, science and strategy meet to accelerate impact for patients. You will join a team that brings medical experts, commercial thinkers, and innovators into the same room to unlock bold ideas—always guided by evidence and strong ethics. We move with agility, learn fast from what works and what doesn’t, and stay close to a broad, science-led pipeline that keeps our work varied and meaningful. Your insights from the field will shape decisions across the business, helping us invest wisely in research while improving how patients are diagnosed, treated, and cared for. We value kindness alongside ambition and collaboration over ego, so you can stretch your capabilities with the support of world-class colleagues connected across our global network.
Call to Action: Step into a role where your scientific voice drives better care—show us how you will elevate partnerships, sharpen strategy, and deliver impact for patients today!

AudioCodes.description:
as a strategic business partner. The CIO will define and execute the company's IT strategy, optimize core enterprise systems, and champion the adoption of emerging technologies—with artificial intelligence at the center—to create measurable business value. As a member of the executive leadership team, the CIO will help shape the company's technology direction while enabling business growth, operational excellence, and innovation.
The company recently completed a major transformation, replacing its legacy platform with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, which is now fully operational. The CIO will build on this foundation by ensuring reliable and secure operations, maximizing the value of the ERP investment, leading the implementation of a new enterprise service management platform, and driving the responsible adoption of AI across the organization.
Security is central to this role. In addition to protecting internal systems, the company manages infrastructure for thousands of managed-services customers, making security and compliance critical to both the business and customer trust. The CIO will own the overall security agenda, with the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) reporting into the role, and will be responsible for maintaining compliance.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and is equally comfortable defining strategy, leading enterprise-wide initiatives, and driving operational excellence.
About Us
We are AudioCodes, (NASDAQ: AUDC) a global leader in voice communications, voice AI, Unified Communications, Contact Center, and AI-powered customer experience solutions. For over 30 years, we have helped enterprises and service providers worldwide modernize their communications environments and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences.
As a trusted Microsoft partner and a leader in Voice AI and Conversational AI, AudioCodes enables organizations to accelerate digital transformation through innovative solutions that integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and other leading collaboration platforms.
With a global presence, thousands of customers worldwide, and a strong ecosystem of partners, AudioCodes is recognized as a market leader in enterprise communications and AI-driven voice solutions.
Your mission
Technology Strategy & Leadership: Define and execute the IT strategy in alignment with company goals, serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO and executive team. Partner closely with business leaders to identify opportunities where technology can accelerate growth, improve operational efficiency, and support evolving business priorities.
Security, Compliance & Risk: Own the company's information security posture, with the CISO reporting to the CIO. Protect customer-managed infrastructure and maintain compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and FedRAMP readiness.
AI & Innovation: Lead the company's AI agenda by identifying high-value use cases, introducing AI technologies, and embedding AI into workflows, products, and decision-making with appropriate governance, security, and responsible-use practices.
Change Leadership: Lead enterprise-wide change initiatives to ensure successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
Run the Business: Ensure Oracle Fusion ERP and other core enterprise applications operate securely, reliably, and efficiently while delivering value across Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and other business functions.
Major Programs: Lead strategic technology initiatives, including the implementation of a new enterprise service management platform, ensuring successful delivery through strong execution and change management.
Operations & Infrastructure: Oversee networks, infrastructure, cloud environments, Cloud Cost Optimization and enterprise applications to ensure performance, availability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
Data & Analytics: Advance data management and analytics capabilities to support better business decisions and provide a strong foundation for AI.
People & Vendors: Lead, mentor, and grow the IT organization while managing strategic vendors, partners, budgets, and commercial agreements.

Base44.description:
Company Description
Job Description
We’re building the Go-To-Market team for Base44, an AI-powered software development platform recently acquired by Wix. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of a category-defining shift in how software is built—bringing a transformative product to Enterprise accounts. This is a high-impact, strategic role for a seller who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You won’t just be following a playbook; you’ll be helping to write it. Working closely with Base44 and Wix leadership, you will drive complex sales cycles, turning technical innovation into tangible business value for multi-stakeholder organizations.
In your day-to-day, you will: 
Manage complex, long-term sales cycles with strategic Enterprise accounts, from targeted outreach to close
Turn Base44’s AI capabilities into "business-speak" that resonates with VPs of Engineering, CTOs, CIOs, and executive leadership
Shape the enterprise sales motion, navigating complex buying processes, security reviews, and custom procurement workflows
Identify and convert high-value prospects, building strategic partnerships that drive significant revenue growth
Act as a critical feedback loop between Enterprise clients and our product team to influence the platform roadmap and enterprise-grade features
Maintain a clean CRM and provide accurate, predictable pipeline forecasting for large-deal motions
Qualifications
5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience in a technology company, with a proven track record of closing Enterprise-grade deals and smashing quotas
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and navigating procurement, legal, and security processes
Comfort discussing technical workflows, with experience in AI, ML, or developer-centric SaaS – an advantage
Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable with the ambiguity of a "startup within a giant" environment
Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to tailor complex messaging to both technical teams and executive C-suite stakeholders
Additional Information
We're Base44, a newly acquired part of Wix, on a mission to change how software gets built. Our AI-powered platform empowers anyone to create custom software applications using natural language- no traditional coding required. Operating like a startup within Wix, we're fast, collaborative, and focused on turning complex problems into simple, powerful solutions.
We exist for creators, solo founders, startups, entrepreneurs, side hustlers, and everyone who wants to turn their ideas into reality. Whether you're launching a product, validating a concept, or exploring a hunch, Base44 helps you build it.
We're growing fast, the opportunity is huge, and with your help, our user-driven growth can become unstoppable.
Base44.title: Account Executive, Enterprise

As an Experienced Product Designer (UX & UI) in the Base44 team, you’ll play a central role in shaping and evolving Base44’s core product experience and design foundations.

  • Own the functional and visual design of your product.
  • Deliver extraordinary, high-quality products in a fast-paced AI driven environment.
  • Build and prototype product experiences hands-on using AI coding tools such as Claude and Codex, moving beyond traditional design tools to explore and validate ideas in working products.
  • Demonstrate a strong and practical understanding of applied AI to drive innovative, data-informed, and highly personalized user experiences.
  • Know your product and users thoroughly through extensive research based on support tickets, data, usability tests, user interviews, competitor analysis and more.
  • Collaborate with your team of PMs, developers, analysts, and other UX/UI designers to define product requirements and shape effective design solutions.
  • Take ownership and drive projects end-to-end.
  • Own your professional growth by taking part in our guild’s courses, guild days, soft and hard skills workshops, mentorship programs, and much more (both learning and teaching).
Base44.title: Product Designer (UX/UI)

Base44.description:
We're looking for a Creative Product Marketing Manager who lives inside the creative team. Someone who understands the product deeply, knows the audience and the competitive field, and turns all of it into stories worth telling. This role is built for someone who owns both the thinking and the doing. In your day to day you will:

  • Know the product inside out, including its strengths and weaknesses, how it stacks up against competitors, and where it is headed.

  • Stay in constant intelligence-gathering mode across every front we work on: product, competition, and user conversations. Know what people think of us, what they need, and where we fall short.

  • Deliver insights the team can act on, and spot product opportunities worth talking about.

  • Turn product capabilities into stories of value: know what to emphasize, how to frame it, and how to adapt it to different audiences and intents.

  • Own broad, ongoing responsibility areas end to end: gathering from multiple sources, filtering for quality, building AI tools and workflows to operate at scale, and carrying things through to production.

  • Take part in campaign and content creation across YouTube, web, and marketing channels: shaping concepts and seeing them through production with the team.

  • Create hands-on product storyboards within our design language, capture screen recordings, and drive video work alongside an editor and designer.

Own the quality, tone, and clarity of  AI-generated content - ensuring automated communications, marketing collateral, and system copy sound natural and strictly on-brand.

Ability to take manual content processes and structure them into repeatable, automated AI skills.
Strong SaaS content or PMM background; easily translates complex product architecture into clear messaging strategy alongside PMMs.
Exceptional attention to detail with zero tolerance for generic, robotic "AI-sounding" text.

We collaborate and communicate across multiple channels, helping businesses and organizations achieve their goals and succeed online.
