As our Head of Customer Experience, you will lead a unique, cross-functional global team of  L1/L2 Support, Team Leads, Business Analysts, and Content Writers.  This is an entrepreneurial, high-impact leadership role. You won’t just execute a roadmap given to you, you will define it.
If you are a leader who thrives under pressure, breathes data, understands B2C dynamics, and loves the challenge of driving operations  in a dynamic startup environment, this is the place for you.As our Head of Customer Experience you will:
⁠Lead, mentor, and shape a global, cross-cultural team. You will be the driving force behind their growth, creating training materials,  establishing team rituals, and fostering a high-performance culture.
Constantly analyze key business metrics (workloads, backlog, staffing formulas) to ensure systemic stability, predict traffic spikes, and manage critical incidents flawlessly.
Actively scout, experiment with, and integrate cutting-edge AI tools into daily workflows to drive next-level automation and efficiency
Work seamlessly with cross functional teams to improve policies and process 
⁠Build relationships across the company organically. Work independently and autonomously, driving impact without formal authority or constant supervision.
Qualifications
5+ years of leadership experience with a proven track record managing managers and leading diverse, cross-functional global teams in high-scale environments.
Deep expertise in B2C ecosystems, fostering scalable community engagement, and representing  brand reputation across digital channels.
You speak the language of numbers and data. You naturally use business metrics (like MRR) to make scaling decisions, optimize workloads, and prove impact.
While you don’t need to be a developer but you need to be comfortable leading deeply technical team members and managers.
Highly independent, proactive, creative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
Additional Information
We're Base44, a newly acquired part of Wix, on a mission to change how software gets built. Our AI-powered platform empowers anyone to create custom software applications using natural language- no traditional coding required. Operating like a startup within Wix, we're fast, collaborative, and focused on turning complex problems into simple, powerful solutions.
We exist for creators, solo founders, startups, entrepreneurs, side hustlers, and everyone who wants to turn their ideas into reality. Whether you're launching a product, validating a concept, or exploring a hunch, Base44 helps you build it.
We're growing fast, the opportunity is huge, and with your help, our user-driven growth can become unstoppable.

Beamup.description:
About Us
Beamup helps enterprises move beyond dashboards, alerts, and manual triage to automated supply chain execution .
Our AI platform supports large, complex retail and manufacturing networks by deploying specialized AI agents that operate continuously across stores, distribution centers, warehouses, and in-transit operations. These agents detect execution issues, identify root causes, and execute corrective actions - either autonomously or by routing work to the right teams.
Retailers and manufacturers rely on Beamup to replace reactive workflows with consistent, scalable execution — reducing losses, improving performance, and operating with greater confidence at global scale.
Our Mission
To redefine supply chain intelligence by building AI agents that predict, prevent, and resolve inventory health and operational issues in real time.
About the Role
This is a dual-track role combining a forward-looking mandate to identify, implement, and maintain AI tools that improve how we work, with day-to-day IT management. You'll be the internal point of contact for all things technology, and a key partner to leadership on compliance initiatives.
Responsibilities
Gen-AI & Intelligent Tools
This is where you'll make your biggest impact. Beamup is actively embedding AI into how we operate internally, and this person will be the engine behind that transformation. You won't just support tools, you'll shape the way the company works.
Scout and evaluate the latest generative AI tools (LLMs, agents, workflow automation, AI-assisted ops) and build a clear view of what's worth adopting
Own the end-to-end rollout of AI tools, from business case and procurement through integration, employee enablement, and change management
Design AI-powered workflows that eliminate manual work and unlock capacity across teams (automated reporting, intelligent document handling, AI-assisted customer interactions, and more)
Build internal expertise by running hands-on sessions, creating guides, and helping colleagues get real value out of the tools
Monitor adoption, performance, and ROI of deployed AI tools, and iterate continuously
Stay on the front edge of the gen-AI landscape, new model releases, emerging agent frameworks, evolving enterprise use cases, and translate what's relevant into action at Beamup
IT Management
Own and manage Beamup's internal IT infrastructure, including hardware, software, user access, and helpdesk support
Onboard and offboard employees, provisioning accounts, devices, and access permissions
Manage SaaS tools and vendor relationships, ensuring licenses, renewals, and integrations are up to date
Maintain IT documentation, asset registers, and internal knowledge bases
Security & Compliance
Maintain ISO certification requirements by tracking audit schedules, required documentation, coordinating departmental evidence collection, and filing certificates and reports centrally
Drive SOC 2 audit readiness by maintaining the evidence library (access reviews, training records, change management logs), tracking all controls and their status, and scheduling and supporting auditor visits
Vet new suppliers before engagement by collecting security documentation, ensuring NDAs are signed, and keeping the vendor register up to date
Requirements
3-5 years of experience in IT management, IT operations, or a similar role
Background at a startup or scale-up environment
Solid understanding of information security fundamentals and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2)
Experience coordinating with external vendors and auditors
Familiarity with SaaS ecosystems and enterprise tooling
Genuine enthusiasm for generative AI; you follow the space, you experiment, and you know the difference between hype and real utility
Hands-on experience implementing or managing AI tools in a business context (ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, Zapier, Make, or similar)
Strong organizational skills; you track things, close loops, and don't let things fall through the cracks
Comfortable working across teams and communicating technical requirements to non-technical stakeholders
Fluent in Hebrew and English

Beamup.description:
About Us
Beamup helps enterprises move beyond dashboards, alerts, and manual triage to automated supply chain execution .
Our AI platform supports large, complex retail and manufacturing networks by deploying specialized AI agents that operate continuously across stores, distribution centers, warehouses, and in-transit operations. These agents detect execution issues, identify root causes, and execute corrective actions - either autonomously or by routing work to the right teams.
Retailers and manufacturers rely on Beamup to replace reactive workflows with consistent, scalable execution — reducing losses, improving performance, and operating with greater confidence at global scale.
Our Mission
To redefine supply chain intelligence by building AI agents that predict, prevent, and resolve inventory health and operational issues in real time.
Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Applied AI/ML Scientist with expertise in building agentic systems and autonomous agents to join one of our R&D. You will be at the core of transforming our supply chain solutions into a fully agentic platform, designing and building agents that autonomously generate analytical pipelines, orchestrate multi-step reasoning, and resolve complex logistics challenges for our customers. You will combine strong machine learning and deep learning expertise with the ability to architect and implement production-grade agentic systems, working closely with engineering, product, and domain experts to push the boundaries of what autonomous AI can do in supply chain.
Responsibilities:
Design and build autonomous agentic systems that generate, configure, and execute analytical pipelines to solve supply chain challenges end-to-end
Architect multi-agent workflows with planning, tool use, memory, and feedback loops, enabling agents to reason, adapt, and improve over time
Develop and integrate ML and deep learning models (e.g., predictive models, anomaly detection, demand forecasting) as core capabilities within agentic pipelines
Research and apply state-of-the-art techniques in agentic AI, LLM orchestration, and multi-agent systems to production use cases
Translate complex logistics and supply chain challenges into agent-based problem formulations, collaborating closely with product and domain experts
Define and implement rigorous evaluation frameworks for agent performance: correctness, reliability, robustness, and edge-case handling
Collaborate with software engineers to productize agentic solutions — including testing, monitoring, versioning, and iterative improvement
Contribute to team practices: reproducible code, experiment tracking, documentation, and knowledge sharing
Requirements:
4+ years of experience in applied data science or ML in a product environment, with demonstrated experience building agentic systems or autonomous agents
MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Proven track record designing and implementing multi-step agentic pipelines, including LLM-based agents, tool use, planning loops, and memory mechanisms
Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent
Strong Python coding skills; familiar with Spark for large-scale, distributed data processing
Experience with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, open-source models) and prompt engineering for agentic use cases
Experience performing rigorous model evaluation (baselines, cross-validation, error analysis) and defining evaluation strategies for agent behavior
Strong communication and collaboration skills; able to work across engineering, product, and supply chain domain experts and iterate fast
Nice to Have (Advantages)
Experience with multi-agent architectures, agent-to-agent communication protocols, and agent orchestration at scale
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and MLOps practices (CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, drift detection)
Familiarity with containerization and production engineering practices (Docker, Kubernetes)
Beamup is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

https://www.beamup.ai/

Blink Ops.description:
Description
About us
The industry’s only Agentic Security Automation Platform - Blink enables you to automate all aspects of your security operations by combining AI security agents with deterministic workflows. Retain full control as you deploy your own custom army of virtual security employees - each tasked and responsible for managing specific jobs and capable of taking autonomous decisions. These AI agents leverage the deterministic security workflows assigned to them or by calling upon peer agents as required. Blink empowers security teams to rapidly operationalize response to zero-day and emerging threats by automating detection ingestion, cross-environment hunting, containment, and coordination with human stakeholders.
Join our fast growing team, and help put the power of automation in the hands of every security professional.
About the role
As a Senior Backend Engineer at BlinkOps, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture and evolution of our backend services. You'll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
*Please note that this position is located in Israel
Your responsibilities
What you'll be doing
Architect, develop, and test cloud-native microservices, ensuring they meet our high standards of scalability and reliability.
Deeply engage with a range of tech stacks, showcasing your expertise beyond a single framework, particularly in cloud services, Linux, and containerized environments like Kubernetes and Docker.
Enhance our platform's core workflow engine, contributing to the development of enterprise-level applications and services that set Blink apart in the market.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales and customer success, to ensure our solutions are perfectly tailored to customer needs.
Grow a culture of continuous learning and improvement, mentoring team members and guiding their professional development.
Lead best practices in observability by implementing effective logging, metrics, and tracing systems.
Design and build systems with security at the forefront, understanding and applying key security concepts to protect our customers and their data.
Requirements
What you'll need
5+ years of high-level backend development experience, with a proven track record of working in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
Strong foundational knowledge in Internet & Operating Systems, including DNS, HTTP, I/O, and Resource Management.
Hands-on experience with a variety of tech stacks, with a preference for candidates experienced in our current stack.
Proficiency in cloud services, Linux, and container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker.
Skilled in implementing observability tools and practices in a production environment.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Expertise in Message Brokers like RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, and designing systems for scale including knowledge of distributed systems, throttling, backpressure, and circuit breakers. (Bonus)
Blink Ops.title: Backend Engineer

Blink Ops.description:
Description
About us
At BlinkOps, we are building the next generation of security automation through our Agentic security platform. Our mission is to help security teams operate faster, smarter, and at scale.
As the industry’s only Agentic Security Automation Platform, Blink enables you to automate all aspects of your security operations by combining AI security agents with deterministic workflows. Retain full control as you deploy your own custom army of virtual security employees - each tasked and responsible for managing specific jobs and capable of taking autonomous decisions. These AI agents leverage the deterministic security workflows assigned to them or by calling upon peer agents as required. Blink empowers security teams to rapidly operationalize response to zero-day and emerging threats by automating detection ingestion, cross-environment hunting, containment, and coordination with human stakeholders.
About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Security Product Manager to drive the strategy, development, and growth of our product, shaping how security teams automate and scale their security operations across the enterprise.
This is a strategic product role at the center of Blink's growth. You will define the product vision, translate deep security domain knowledge into scalable product capabilities, and partner across Engineering, R&D, GTM, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional outcomes. This role requires strong technical depth, security expertise, and an AI-first mindset.
﻿What Makes This Role Unique
This role sits at the intersection of security operations, AI-powered automation, and enterprise product strategy. You will shape how BlinkOps helps security teams work faster and smarter — operating at the strategic level to drive innovation while staying close enough to the details to ensure every initiative lands with quality and impact.
Your responsibilities
What You'll Do
Define and execute product strategy – Own the roadmap for your product areas, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term vision. Think big, plan strategically, and dive deep into the details to ensure flawless execution.
Translate security expertise into product – Draw on your security domain knowledge to deeply understand how security teams operate, and shape features that solve real operational challenges at scale.
Drive end-to-end product development – Lead initiatives from discovery through design, development, release, and iteration — including full product launches in close partnership with GTM.
Go-to-market execution – Partner with GTM to plan and execute product launches end-to-end: develop positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and launch plans that land with security practitioners and buyers alike.
Engage directly with customers – Work with enterprise customers and internal teams to understand security architectures, workflows, and unmet needs.
Own product specifications – Write clear, rigorous technical and product requirements that guide engineering and ensure high-quality delivery.
Leverage AI throughout your workflow – Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, spec writing, and decision-making — and bring that same AI-first thinking to every product initiative you lead.
Requirements
5+ years of experience as a Product Manager , with a track record of owning and delivering complex product initiatives.
Strong security domain knowledge — deep understanding of how security teams operate, the challenges they face, and the tools and architectures they rely on (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, EDR, IAM).
Proven ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels — capable of setting a long-term vision while also managing the nitty-gritty details of execution.
Proven ability to lead complex technical product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery to launch, including full GTM execution.
Experience planning and executing product launches in close partnership with GTM teams — including positioning, enablement, and cross-functional coordination.
AI-first mindset — you actively use AI tools to accelerate your own PM workflow (research, synthesis, spec writing, prototyping)
Experience working with automation platforms, workflow engines, APIs, and integrations.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, working effectively with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Customer Success.
Experience working with large enterprise customers in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
Security Domain Knowledge
This role requires deep familiarity with how modern security and IT operations teams work. The ideal candidate understands the day-to-day realities of security operations across a broad range of use cases and tooling — including SOC operations and incident response, threat detection and hunting, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and more. You should be comfortable navigating complex security architectures, understanding how tools and data flows interact, and translating operational security needs into scalable product capabilities that work across diverse enterprise environments.

Boa Ideas.description:
Description
At BOA Ideas, we’ve been crafting smart, scalable web solutions for nearly two decades. We specialize in Shopify development, custom applications, and complex third-party integrations — helping brands build powerful digital commerce experiences.
We’re looking for a talented, experienced, and driven Full-Stack Developer with deep Shopify expertise to join our growing team and build industry-leading e-commerce experiences for global brands.
This role is ideal for someone with strong hands-on experience in the Shopify ecosystem — including custom theme development, Shopify APIs, app integrations, and scalable e-commerce architecture.
If you're passionate about clean code, modern technologies, and building high-performing Shopify solutions in a fast-paced agency environment — we’d love to meet you.
﻿
﻿What You’ll Do
Develop scalable Shopify websites and e-commerce experiences
Build and customize Shopify themes using Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Convert designs into responsive, high-performing storefronts
Develop and maintain third-party integrations and API connections
Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code aligned with development best practices
Collaborate with designers, Project Managers, Customer Success, Webmasters, and leadership teams throughout the project lifecycle
Test, optimize, and continuously improve client solutions
Continuously explore new technologies and recommend improvements to development processes and client solutions
Requirements
What We’re Looking For:
4+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Developer (working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS ) — MUST
Hands-on experience with React, Node.js, and Express.js — MUST
Strong hands-on Shopify development experience (Shopify Liquid, Shopify APIs, and third-party integrations)
Proven experience building and customizing Shopify / Shopify Plus stores
Working knowledge of PHP, Laravel, and MySQL
Experience with GitHub and modern development workflows
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development workflow (LLMs, code assistants, AI APIs, automation tools, etc.)
Experience building responsive, high-performing e-commerce websites
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong self-management skills
Why Join Us?
Meaningful Impact: Work on diverse and exciting projects that shape real digital commerce experiences.
Creative Problem-Solving Environment: Join a team that values smart thinking, initiative, and pushing technical boundaries.
Growth-Focused Culture: Be part of a fast-growing company where you can shape your role, expand your expertise, and grow alongside the business.

BrandShield is growing and looking for an Junior Customer Success manager to join our talented team:
Who are you?
A Lawyer after an internship (or a law degree) , with excellent English and the ability to work in a customer-facing team.

Working with leading international companies

Brenntag.description:
Import & Strategic Procurement Specialist
Brenntag Israel is seeking an Import & Supply Chain Specialist to identify and develop local and international suppliers, negotiate commercial agreements, manage end-to-end import operations, and control local supply chain and logistics costs.
Key Responsibilities:
Source, evaluate, and select local and international suppliers.
Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers to secure optimal pricing and terms.
Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships.
Manage import operations from purchase order placement through final delivery.
Coordinate with local authorities, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers.
Monitor shipments, delivery schedules, and customs clearance activities.
Control and monitor local import and logistics costs, including freight, customs, warehousing, and distribution expenses.
Manage procurement and import documentation.
Work extensively with SAP R/3 and other business systems.
Prepare reports and analyze data using Excel.
Required Qualifications
Proven experience in import and Strategic Procurement .
Strong experience in sourcing and negotiating with local and international suppliers.
Solid knowledge of import procedures, customs regulations, and international logistics.
Experience in cost control and cost analysis.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel.
Experience working with SAP R/3.
Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.
אחראי/ת יבוא ורכש אסטרטגי
תיאור התפקיד:
לחברה העוסקת בייבוא חומרי גלם דרוש/ה אחראי/ת יבוא ושרשרת אספקה. התפקיד כולל איתור ספקים בארץ ובחו"ל, ניהול משא ומתן מסחרי, אחריות על תהליכי הייבוא מקצה לקצה, בקרה וניהול עלויות בארץ וניהול הקשר השוטף עם כלל הגורמים המעורבים בשרשרת האספקה.
תחומי אחריות:
איתור, בחינה ובחירת ספקים מקומיים ובינלאומיים (Sourcing).
ניהול משא ומתן מסחרי עם ספקים בארץ ובחו"ל.
ניהול קשרי ספקים ושיפור תנאי התקשרות.
אחריות מלאה על תהליכי הייבוא משלב ההזמנה ועד הגעת הסחורה למחסן.
עבודה מול רשויות מקומיות, עמילי מכס, משלחים בינלאומיים וחברות לוגיסטיקה.
מעקב אחר משלוחים, זמני אספקה ותהליכי שחרור ממכס.
בקרה וניהול עלויות הייבוא והלוגיסטיקה בארץ, לרבות עלויות שילוח, מכס, אחסנה והפצה.
ניהול הזמנות ותיעוד מסחרי.
עבודה שוטפת במערכת SAP R/3 ובמערכות ממוחשבות נוספות.
הפקת דוחות וניתוחים באמצעות Excel .
דרישות:
ניסיון מוכח בתחום הייבוא ורכש אסטרטגי .
ניסיון באיתור ספקים ובניהול משא ומתן עם ספקים בארץ ובחו"ל.
ידע והיכרות עם תהליכי יבוא, מכס ושילוח בינלאומי.
ניסיון בבקרה וניהול עלויות.
שליטה מלאה ביישומי Office , בדגש על Excel .
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכת SAP R/3 .
יכולת עבודה בסביבה מרובת משימות ( Multitasking ).
יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ ועמידה בלוחות זמנים.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה, בכתב ובעל פה.

Being the industry’s leading distributor and service provider for chemicals, Brenntag offers best-in-class service, extensive market know-how, formulation expertise, and the highest quality ingredients.
We are looking for an hands-on Finance Manager for our Finance & Accounting Department, who will join our team in Beer Yakov, Tel Aviv Israel.
Job Description
Compiling financial data, creating reports and analyzing the financial health of the company.
Managing the relavant team of 7 employees.
Performing in-depth financial analysis to support business strategies and identify growth opportunities.
Conducting relevant financial & reporting analysis together with Regional and Global Controlling teams.
Managing cash flow related activities and identifying cost‑saving opportunities.
Managing the preparation and distribution of periodic financial statements for senior leadership.
Supervising finance staff and coordinating needed audits.
Communicating financial facts and insights to executives, stakeholders
Preparing accurate financial reports that comply with Israeli regulations and international accounting standards.
Identifying and mitigating financial risks to ensure organizational stability.
Overseeing the budgeting process to ensure effective resource allocation and financial planning.
Ensuring adherence to local and international financial regulations and standards.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Degree in finance, accounting, or related field; CPA accreditation would be an asset.
Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and numeracy skills.
Knowledge of IFRS & GAAP and Israeli financial regulations.
SAP experience in R3.
Good Microsoft Excel skills.
Excellent communication and report‑writing abilities.
Leadership experience and ability to manage teams.

Brenntag.description:
Brenntag Israel is looking for an Accounting Responsiblee who has hands on experience with minimum 15 years of experience. The position is based in Beer Yakov, Tel Aviv.
We are seeking a detail-oriented finance professional to support day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring accurate transaction processing, timely payments, account reconciliations and compliance with financial and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Record, review, and process supplier invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
Process domestic and international supplier payments, ensuring compliance with company policies and payment deadlines.
Manage payments to overseas suppliers and coordinate related documentation as required.
Prepare and complete reconciliations , ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded and supported by appropriate documentation.
Perform bank reconciliations and investigate any variances or outstanding transactions.
Conduct monthly analysis of income and expenses by business area , providing accurate financial insights to support management reporting.
Prepare and submit monthly financial reports and required documentation to relevant government authorities.
Process payments to government and regulatory authorities and assist with the preparation and submission of annual statutory reports.
Manage and record bank deposits, ensuring transactions are accurately reflected in the accounting records.
Process and maintain accurate records of import-related files, invoices, and supporting documentation , ensuring compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.
Maintain organized and accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
Support month-end and year-end accounting activities as required.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of accounting and finance processes.
Fluency in English is needed.
Experience with Accounts Payable, reconciliations, payment processing, and General Ledger activities .
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Good organizational and documentation skills.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Proficiency in accounting/ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
Understanding of statutory and regulatory reporting requirements is an advantage.

Bria AI.description:
About the Role
Bria is hiring a Senior Marketing Leader to lead marketing as a strategic, revenue-aligned operating system.
This role is designed for a hands-on marketing leader who has built brand-led growth engines, understands how categories are created, and knows how to translate deep technical differentiation into commercial impact. A strong engineering background or experience marketing developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, or AI/ML products is highly preferred. This role requires someone who is genuinely comfortable with technical content and can engage credibly with both engineering and business buyers.
The Head of Marketing will be a core member of the business leadership team and will report to the President & Chief Business Officer, working closely with BizDev, Product, and Sales.
Marketing at Bria is explicitly structured as:
Brand and category
Demand generation
Product marketing
Strategy and operations as the foundation
The Head of Marketing will step into a clear mandate, defined budget, and an established strategic blueprint, and will be responsible for executing and scaling the system with rigor and focus - in a deeply hands-on capacity.
What You Will Do
Brand and Category Leadership
Own Bria's category narrative and brand positioning, establishing the company as the reference standard for controllable, deployable, enterprise-grade visual AI.
Design and execute category-building programs including PR, analyst relations, executive thought leadership, and ecosystem positioning - including hands-on drafting of briefings, content, and outreach.
Ensure consistent reinforcement of Bria's message hierarchy across all channels and assets.
Build brand equity that compounds and materially accelerates sales cycles.
Demand Generation
Build and operate a focused portfolio of demand engines across partners, field marketing, warm demand, organic, and ecosystem-led motions.
Generate a predictable flow of qualified opportunities aligned with sales priorities and target ICPs.
Reduce dependency on founder-led sales by institutionalizing demand generation.
Own pipeline contribution, efficiency metrics, and visibility into ROI by engine.
Product Marketing
Translate Bria's technical depth into clear, credible commercial value propositions - for both technical buyers (engineers, ML teams, CTOs) and business buyers (marketing, creative, and product leaders).
Own messaging, positioning, website conversion, sales enablement, and proof assets - and be willing to write and produce them directly.
Increase conversion rates, win rates, and deal velocity through clarity and risk reduction.
Support expansion and product-led or low-touch motions where applicable.
Strategy and Operations
Run marketing as a predictable, measurable operating system.
Own planning, prioritization, and execution cadence across the marketing org.
Manage an annual marketing budget with clear ROI accountability.
Define dashboards, KPIs, and reporting tied directly to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Build and scale the marketing organization (~3 direct reports) as the company grows.
What Success Looks Like
Bria is clearly recognized as a category leader in enterprise-grade visual AI.
Brand equity meaningfully accelerates pipeline generation and deal velocity.
Demand generation delivers consistent, high-quality opportunities.
Product marketing reduces friction and increases confidence throughout the buying journey.
Marketing operates as a disciplined system with clear governance and accountability.
Requirements
Experience
6 years of B2B marketing experience in technology companies.
3+ years in a senior leadershiprole, reporting to a CEO
Proven hands-on ownership of campaigns, messaging, and pipeline metrics - not just oversight.
Demonstrated ownership of an annual marketing budget.
Track record of contributing materially to pipeline and revenue targets.
Domain and GTM Expertise
4+ years background in SaaS, software infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, open-source, or platform businesses.
Hands-on experience with B2B, PLG, and PLS motions.
Strong preference for candidates with an engineering background or significant experience at a company that sells to developers or technical buyers.
Experience marketing to enterprise buyers, technical decision-makers, and product companies.
Brand and Category Leadership
5+ years leading brand strategy, positioning, and narrative development.
Demonstrated experience in category creation or category leadership, including PR, analyst relations, and executive thought leadership.
Track record of building brand equity that measurably impacts pipeline, deal velocity, or win rates.
Demand Generation
3+ years owning demand generation in B2B environments.
Hands-on experience building and operating multiple demand engines (partners, field marketing, warm demand, organic, paid).
Proven ability to generate predictable, qualified pipeline and reduce dependency on founder-led or opportunistic sales.
Experience managing demand efficiency metrics (SQLs, CAC, payback, pipeline contribution).
Product Marketing
3+ years of product marketing experience in B2B technology companies.
3+ years of experience in PLG and PLS motions
Ownership of messaging, positioning, sales enablement, and proof assets - with ability to produce them directly.
Demonstrated impact on conversion rates, win rates, and pipeline velocity.
Experience translating complex technical products into clear, credible commercial value.
Leadership and Operating Skills
Strong strategic thinking combined with execution discipline and a bias for getting things done hands-on.
Comfortable being the most senior marketer in a growth-stage environment.
Native-level English required.
Experience working in a multicultural environment.

Faster in crisis response & coordination

You'll own the health of our operational stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, SalesLoft, DealHub, Mdoc, billing, and Control Panel), making sure data flows cleanly and the full funnel stays trustworthy from end to end.
This role blends business acumen, technical fluency, and a genuine passion for helping people. You'll have a front-row seat to the entire sales process — and the trust to keep it running smoothly.
Responsibilities
Tool Administration & Support
Own DealHub (CPQ) issue escalation — investigate, coordinate across teams, and drive fixes so reps are never blocked
Keep Salesforce and Control Panel clean by identifying and resolving duplicate accounts and field errors
Deal Desk & Pipeline Health
Monitor new and recently closed opportunities to ensure accurate opportunity types, ownership, and metadata
Track Stage 0 pipeline proactively, flagging gaps and following up to keep deals moving
Reporting & Stakeholder Updates
Maintain the weekly RVP report, keeping data current for Sales Ops analysis and distribution
Sales Rep Lifecycle Management
Maintain rep assignment logic and the Sales Assignment Calculator, ensuring accounts always route to the right owner as territories and teams evolve
Data & Metadata Management
Own internal metadata files, keeping reference data accurate and accessible
Run regular Salesforce hygiene checks across accounts, contacts, opportunities, and activities
Contracts & Compliance
Audit active accounts for valid, up-to-date contracts tied to the latest Closed Won opportunity; flag and resolve gaps with the right teams
Billing & Credits
Lead resolution when customers are billed incorrectly — coordinating with Finance, Billing, and CS to issue credits and document outcomes
Handle ad hoc billing requests and one-time customer fixes
Requirements
Entry-level/junior role — we're looking for potential, not a long resume
Tech-savvy with strong process-oriented thinking
Excellent people skills and a genuine service mindset
Highly detail-oriented and comfortable owning follow-through
Hybrid role - must be able to be in our NYC office 3x a week
Experience with quoting/CPQ systems is a plus; DealHub experience is a bonus

Canopy Care.description:
Join Us in Revolutionizing Oncology Care!
At Canopy , we’re transforming healthcare for cancer patients by shifting from episodic treatment to continuous, patient-centered care. Our cutting-edge technology empowers patients to manage symptoms and access support anytime, anywhere—ensuring they never feel alone. With Canopy, the clinic is always with them .
Our innovative approach not only enhances the patient experience but also aligns clinic revenue with better health outcomes, creating a true win-win for everyone involved. By driving a 20% increase in treatment adherence and strengthening patient-provider connections, Canopy delivers life-saving results while elevating patient satisfaction to new heights.
Join us in shaping the future of oncology care! 🌿
Your Mission
As a Backend Tech Lead , you’ll take ownership of Canopy’s backend architecture, ensuring the performance, scalability, and reliability of our platform. You’ll work closely with a talented team of engineers and stakeholders to design and implement high-quality, secure, and resilient backend systems that power our healthcare solutions. By providing both technical vision and hands-on expertise, you will help drive Canopy’s ability to scale effectively, enabling us to deliver innovative oncology care solutions that make a real difference.
What You’ll Do
Lead Backend Strategy – Architect scalable backend systems to support our growing platform.
Optimize Performance – Design efficient and resilient services that handle high data volumes in real time.
Ensure Code Quality – Enforce best practices for development, testing, and deployment.
Mentor & Guide – Support engineers at various experience levels through technical mentorship and knowledge-sharing.
Stay Ahead of Trends – Keep up with emerging technologies and leverage them to enhance our backend ecosystem.
What You’ll Bring
8+ years of engineering & architecture experience in enterprise software.
Expertise in backend development (5+ years, preferably JavaScript/TypeScript, NodeJS).
Proven experience designing scalable, performant technical platforms.
Familiarity with cloud services (AWS/GCP) and database optimization.
Strong leadership, collaboration, and communication skills.
Bonus Points
Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare or fintech.
Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams in high-growth environments.
A track record of delivering complex, high-impact technical projects.
Benefits
💰 Competitive Compensation We offer a compelling salary and equity package to recognize and reward your contributions.
🏢 Inspiring Workspaces & Travel Perks
Enjoy a vibrant, collaborative working space in Sarona Tel Aviv, near HaShalom station.
Depending on your role, you may have opportunities to travel to client sites, our New York office, or other destinations.
🌍 Hybrid Work Flexibility We embrace a hybrid culture, empowering you to work from where you thrive. We expect Tel Aviv-based employees to come into the office 3 days per week.
EEO Statement
Canopy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Canopy Care.description:
Join Us in Revolutionizing Oncology Care
At Canopy, we’re transforming healthcare for cancer patients by shifting from episodic treatment to continuous, patient-centered care. Our technology empowers patients to manage symptoms and access support anytime, anywhere, ensuring they never feel alone. With Canopy, the clinic is always with them.
Our innovative approach enhances the patient experience while aligning clinic success with better health outcomes, creating a true win-win. By driving a 20% increase in treatment adherence and strengthening patient-provider connections, Canopy delivers life-saving results while elevating patient satisfaction to new heights.
Join us in shaping the future of oncology care. 🌿
Your Mission
As a QA & Automation Engineer at Canopy, you will help ensure we ship reliable, thoughtful, and high-quality product experiences for patients, care teams, and customers.
This is first and foremost a QA role . We are looking for someone with strong analytical thinking, solid manual QA foundations, and real experience understanding product behavior, user flows, edge cases, and quality risks.
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and Clinical teams to analyze new features, identify gaps early, define strong testing coverage, and improve the way we test and release software.
Automation is also part of the role, but not in the sense of hardcore software development. We are looking for someone with enough technical ability to use AI models and tools to build, maintain, and expand automation coverage over time.
This role is about more than finding bugs. It is about raising the quality bar for everything we build.
What You’ll Do
Create detailed test specifications for new features (AI assisted), covering expected behavior, user flows, system dependencies, edge cases, regression risks, and acceptance criteria.
Review product specs, designs, and requirements to identify missing logic, unclear behavior, usability issues, and potential product or business risks.
Create and execute manual test plans for web applications, backend workflows, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and cross-system product flows.
Use strong analytical thinking to understand complex flows, break them down into testable scenarios, and define the right level of coverage.
Investigate and validate product behavior using APIs, database queries, browser DevTools, logs, staging environments, and other technical tools.
Report bugs clearly, including reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, impact, and supporting evidence.
Build and maintain automated tests using AI and existing automation frameworks.
Extend and constantly improve our AI driven internal solution to accelerate test creation, coverage analysis, regression planning and QA documentation.
Help define and improve QA processes, including release readiness, regression strategy, bug reporting, test coverage, quality standards, and release confidence.
Partner with Product and Engineering to make smart quality tradeoffs and ensure releases are stable, well-tested, and aligned with customer and patient needs.
What You’ll Bring
2+ years of hands-on experience as a QA Engineer, Software Tester, Product Quality Engineer, or similar role.
Strong manual QA foundations, including test planning, test case creation, exploratory testing, regression testing, and clear bug reporting.
Strong analytical thinking and the ability to understand complex product flows, dependencies, edge cases, and risk areas.
Experience testing web applications, APIs, backend workflows, integrations, and cross-system product behavior.
Strong product judgment and the ability to think from the perspective of users, customers, the business, and clinical workflows.
Comfort working with technical tools such as APIs, database queries, browser DevTools, logs, staging environments, and monitoring tools to investigate issues and validate behavior.
Ability to read product requirements and designs critically, identify gaps, and ask the right questions before development or release.
Enough technical ability to build and maintain automation with the help of AI-assisted tools. Deep software engineering experience is not required.
Comfort using AI tools to accelerate testing, automation, documentation, and coverage analysis.
Ability to work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Customer Success, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Excellent attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, and follow-through.
A process-oriented mindset and a desire to improve how teams test, build, and release software.
Interest in release readiness and release management. Prior release management experience is helpful, but not required.
Passion, curiosity, and energy for the QA profession.
Bonus Points
Experience in healthcare, digital health, enterprise SaaS, or regulated environments.
Experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar.
Experience using AI-assisted coding, test-generation, or automation tools.
Experience improving QA processes, regression strategies, or release readiness practices.
Experience participating in release management or production release cycles.
Benefits
Competitive compensation and equity.
A vibrant Tel Aviv office in Sarona, near HaShalom station, with opportunities to collaborate across teams and visit our New York office.
Hybrid work flexibility, with Tel Aviv-based employees expected in-office 3 days per week.

as a dedicated operational and engagement focal point for flight crews, with a strong focus on continuous support, communication, welfare, and day-to-day coordination. The role is designed to strengthen the connection between pilots, managers, headquarters, and the wider organization, while ensuring that pilots receive timely support, clear communication, and effective follow-up on their needs.
The role includes maintaining close and accessible contact with pilots, listening to questions or concerns, directing them to the relevant function within the organization, and following up to ensure proper handling. It also includes supporting Aircrew Managers in maintaining consistent management routines, strengthening ongoing communication, and promoting initiatives related to well-being, engagement, and burnout prevention.

Pilot Support and Ongoing Engagement:
Accessible Point of Contact : Serve as an approachable and trusted point of contact for pilots, providing ongoing support, listening to questions or concerns, and helping pilots navigate organizational processes.
Referral and Follow-Up : Direct pilots to the relevant function within the organization and follow up to ensure that matters are addressed and closed properly.
Personal Connection : Build trust-based relationships with pilots and act as an attentive listening ear while maintaining discretion and professionalism.
Communication and Welfare Activities:
Communication Routines : Coordinate and execute ongoing communication routines with pilots, including monthly and quarterly pilot meetings, updates, and relevant communication forums.
Welfare Events : Plan and execute aircrew welfare and engagement events, including events such as Wings Ceremony and other community-building activities.
Headquarters Connection : Strengthen the connection between pilots, headquarters, and the company, and encourage participation in welfare, communication, and engagement initiatives.
Burnout Prevention : Support the development and implementation of programs and routines aimed at identifying and reducing burnout among pilots.

Organizational Liaison : Act as a connecting link between pilots and key internal departments, including Training, Scheduling, HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and Fleet Managers.

Process Support : Support administrative and operational processes related to aircrew engagement, communication, and welfare.
Pilot Recruitment Administrative Coordination :
Selection Process Coordination : Manage the administrative coordination of the pilot recruitment and selection process, including scheduling, communication, documentation, and follow-up with candidates throughout the process.
Candidate Interface : Serve as the main administrative contact for pilot candidates during the selection process, ensuring a clear, professional, and well-coordinated candidate experience.
Preparation of Selection Materials : Prepare and consolidate materials for instructors’ selection discussions in collaboration with the Training and HR departments.
Internal Coordinatio n: Coordinate between candidates, instructors, Training, HR, and relevant internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient and well-managed selection process.
Managerial Support and Work Routines:
Support to Aircrew Managers : Assist Aircrew Managers in maintaining consistent management routines, follow-up mechanisms, and ongoing communication with pilots.
Management Routines : Help managers prepare, execute, and follow up on recurring meetings, team updates, and engagement routines.
Escalation : Identify issues requiring managerial, HR, or professional attention and escalate them to the appropriate function when needed.
HR Professional Guidance : Work under the professional guidance of the HR Manager on relevant people-related matters, ensuring alignment with HR standards, practices, and escalation principles.

Safety Management System (SMS) Support:

Maintain and update SMS documentation, procedures and manuals (OM, MOE, ATO Operations Manual) to ensure continued regulatory compliance.
Act as Deputy Accountable Safety Representative during the absence of the Safety Manager.
Coordinate SMS activities across all three certified entities, ensuring a coherent, integrated approach to aviation safety.
Hazard Identification & Risk Management:
Operate and continuously improve the organisation's hazard identification and risk assessment processes, including the Hazard Log and Risk Register.
Support safety risk assessments for operational changes, new procedures, aircraft introductions, and training programme modifications across AOC, CAMO and ATO.
Apply structured risk management methodologies (e.g. SHELL, Bow-tie) to complex engineering and operational problems.
Liaise with technical departments (maintenance, flight operations, training) to identify latent risks and systemic safety issues.

Own and administer the organisation's safety data management systems and reporting platforms, including the internal occurrence reporting system and safety performance dashboards.

Company Description
We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.
We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.
Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.
If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.
With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.
About the role
As we scale and evolve our fully automated fraud prevention strategies, we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our growing Fraud Analytics team.
We operate in a data-rich, fast-paced environment, processing billions of data points annually, and play a critical role in safeguarding large enterprises from fraud. In this role, you will work at the intersection of data analysis, fraud strategy, and automation, collaborating closely with engineering, data science, and commercial teams to develop scalable fraud detection solutions.
This is a high-impact role with significant ownership and cross-functional collaboration in a team with tremendous room for growth. If you are highly motivated, data-driven, and thrive in a fast-moving environment - you belong with us.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and refine fraud detection strategies by analyzing complex datasets and identifying fraud patterns.
Partner with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, data scientists, and commercial stakeholders, to develop scalable fraud solutions.
Conduct deep-dive risk analyses, leveraging multiple data sources to assess fraud threats and define innovative solutions.
Monitor and automate fraud detection processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
Requirements
3+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics.
Payments fraud experience.
Experience working with external stakeholders/merchants.
Expertise in SQL with the ability to write and optimize complex queries.
Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to extract insights from large datasets.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
Fluent English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with Python (Pandas, etc.) for data analysis - a plus.
If you're passionate about fraud prevention, thrive in a high-impact role, and enjoy working with big data to drive real-world solutions, we’d love to hear from you!
The team operates on a hybrid model (Tuesday, Wednesday andThursday in the Midtown Tel Aviv office).
Additional Information
Bring all of you to work
We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
Life at Checkout.com
We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Production Ownership: Take full ownership of putting models into production systems, ensuring low-latency execution and high reliability.
Agentic Workflows: Research, build, and implement Agentic flows and LLM-driven orchestration to automate multi-step fraud decisioning, logic routing, and investigation paths.
Adversarial Analysis: Conduct deep-dive exploratory analysis on massive datasets to identify emerging fraud vectors, loops, and coordinated attacks.
Feature Engineering: Build and optimize real-time streaming and batch features to improve model signal and precision.
Experimentation & Monitoring: Design rigorous shadow-testing and A/B testing frameworks for new models. Set up continuous monitoring pipelines to catch data drift and performance degradation early.

Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of applied Data Science experience with a proven track record across fintech domains, with experience in fraud, risk, or payments preferred.
Production Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience deploying and maintaining machine learning models in high-traffic production environments is required, with real-time experience preferred.
Data Science Tech Stack: Expert-level Python programming (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost/LightGBM) and exceptional SQL skills for querying massive, complex datasets.
Data Environment: Robust experience working within cloud data environments like Databricks, and querying/manipulating large-scale datasets in data warehouses like BigQuery.
Orchestration & MLOps: Practical experience with machine learning lifecycle and orchestration tools, such as MLflow and Airflow.
Business-Impact Focus: A strong ability to translate raw model results into real-world business outcomes. You know how to balance technical model performance (precision/recall) with financial impact, operational realities, and the user experience.

City Hive.description:
As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer in City Hive R&D team, you’ll become a core influencer to the way things are being planned, developed and executed. You’ll get to develop and deploy E2E systems and applications that are in use by millions of users, and make a true impact on the company’s future.
Engineering @ City Hive:
We believe and operate the entire platform in a CI/CD manner and short release cycles (a few hours to a couple of days). For that, we have an insane test coverage with thousands of tests across the stack, allowing us to deploy to production many times a day.
Our engineering culture emphasizes creative problem solving, fast iteration and execution. Team sizes are kept small to encourage big contributions from each team member and promote meaningful collaboration and problem ownership. Our technology stack is diverse and fluid. We touch on all technologies and build modular components that interacts with each other.
Job Requirements:
5+ years of full-stack development experience – MUST
An all around player, with start-up mentality, who doesn’t mind getting their hands dirty with whatever it takes to make things done – MUST
Experience developing backend web applications in a dynamic languages such as RoR\Python
Experience developing in a modern front-end framework such as Angular/React/Vue
Led the development of complex, high-scale and business critical features including assessment and mitigation of both business and technical implications
Experience in SaaS startup company – Advantage
What’s the stack?
We are here to solve business problem with high end technology.
We always embrace new technologies and processes to maintain our continuous growth, some of them are: Ruby on Rails, Python, Angular, Micro-frontends (web components), AWS, Cloudflare, Serverless Computing, Edge Computing, MongoDB, Cypress, CircleCI, New Relic, Apache Cordova, Redis and more.

Clarivate.description:
We are looking for a Manager , Accounting Financial Controller, to join our Controllership team in Jerusalem. This is a 1+year maternity leave cover. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role within our global finance organization, supporting financial reporting, compliance, controllership, and tax activities across international operations. Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will take ownership of critical financial processes, collaborate with global stakeholders, and help ensure the highest standards of financial governance and compliance.
About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments
Qualified CPA with a bachelor's degree in accounting , Finance, or related field.
7+ years of progressive accounting, controllership, or financial reporting experience, within a global organization.
7+ years of Israeli GAAP, US GAAP, statutory reporting, external audits, and accounting controls.
7 + years of experience with Israeli VAT, corporate tax, withholding tax, bookkeeping requirements, and transfer pricing arrangements.
7 +Years of managing and independently owning , and driving accounting, reporting, compliance, and close processes while partnering effectively with stakeholders across global teams.
7 years of team management
Proficiencies in English and Hebrew.
It would be great if you also have
Experience working with Oracle NetSuite and/or Oracle EBS.
What will you be doing in this role?

Job Description
Retail Service Associate – Job Profile Summary & Description
Job Profile Summary
The Retail Service Associate supports the store team in delivering a best-in-class customer experience across mobile, operational, and transactional activities. This role serves as a go-to technical and operational resource, helping to maintain a clean and efficient store environment, and provide exceptional customer support for mobile. RSAs handle mobile activation, education, troubleshooting, and escalations while assisting with operational priorities to ensure that customers leave confident and excited about their Comcast products and services.
Primary Responsibilities — Mobile Focused
Mobile Activations & Customer Education
Provide a white-glove experience activating new devices or BYOD to the network.
Guide customers through tablet setup and connectivity options.
Support activation and pairing of wearable devices for seamless use.
Educate customers on accessories and add-ons that enhance their experience and drive incremental revenue.
Demonstrate strong understanding and enthusiasm for technology and act as a go-to resource.
Demonstrate basic features and capabilities of devices to increase customer confidence.
Mobile Escalations
Troubleshoot and resolve complex device or service issues.
Assist customers in securing accounts, replacing lost or stolen devices, and navigating access recovery.
Use advanced tools to manage escalations.
Mobile Support
Assist customers with transferring contacts, emails, and media.
Provide password resets with appropriate credential verification.
Activate and configure SIM or eSIM for device connectivity.
Perform in-depth diagnostics to identify and resolve issues.
Process returns or exchanges in compliance with company policies.
Assist with warranty claims and replacement processes.
Ensure devices, counters, accessories, and walkways are clean, functioning, and accessible.
On-Demand Delivery, BAPIS & XM Upsell: Fulfill Xfinity Mobile on-demand deliveries and BAPIS pickups by staging orders accurately, ensuring smooth handoff, and identifying opportunities to upsell accessories or add-ons.
Secondary Responsibilities — When No Primary Actions Occur or on Red Floor
Customer Check-In
Provide hands-on demonstrations of devices and features to enhance value.
Operations
Support store resets for proper merchandising and operational readiness.
Maintain visual standards and product placement for optimal customer experience.
Inspect back-of-house to ensure clean, secure, and properly placed inventory.
Express Transactions
Facilitate quick device swaps for customers.
Process equipment returns efficiently while ensuring compliance.
Expectations for All Employees
Understand and follow the Comcast Operating Principles.
Own the customer experience and promote digital options at every touchpoint.
Be an enthusiastic learner and advocate of Comcast products, services, and digital tools.
Win as a team through collaboration and openness to new ideas.
Participate in the Net Promoter System: huddles, callbacks, and feedback loops.
Drive results and operational excellence.
Foster and support a culture of inclusion.
Do what’s right for customers, teammates, communities, and investors.

Continental Israel.description:
Stellenbeschreibung
Als Legal Counsel (m/w/d) im DACH Commercial Team der Continental Tires Rechtsabteilung beraten und unterstützen Sie die Geschäftsbereiche von Continental Tires in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz bei rechtlichen Fragestellungen des Tagesgeschäfts. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit den Fachbereichen sowie den nationalen und internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen des Global Law Departments zusammen.
Zu Ihren wesentlichen Aufgaben gehören:
Entwurf, Prüfung, Verhandlung und Auslegung von unternehmenstypischen Verträgen in deutscher und englischer Sprache in Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen.
Rechtliche Beratung in laufenden Vertragsverhältnissen, u. a. nationaler und internationaler Vertriebs-, Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsvorgängen, einschließlich digitaler und IT-bezogener Projekte.
Beratung in den Bereichen allgemeines Vertragsrecht, Handelsrecht, Immobilienrecht sowie weiteren wirtschaftsrechtlichen Fragestellungen.
Analyse, Bewertung und Erstellung von rechtlichen Standarddokumenten, Vertragsmustern und allgemeiner Vertragsbedingungen.
Identifikation und Bewertung rechtlicher Risiken sowie Entwicklung pragmatischer und geschäftsorientierter Lösungen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen des Global Law Department von Continental Tires weltweit sowie Unterstützung bei internationalen Projekten und Initiativen.
Auswahl, Steuerung und Koordination externer Rechtsanwälte und Kanzleien.
Zusätzliche Informationen
Attraktive Vergütung : Sie erhalten ein Gehalt auf Basis des Tarifvertrags der chemischen Industrie, inklusive tariflicher Jahresleistung und Urlaubsgeld – transparent, fair und zukunftssicher.
Flexibilität, die zu Ihrem Leben passt:  Die Position ist grundsätzlich in Vollzeit vorgesehen. Gleichzeitig sind wir offen für individuelle Teilzeitlösungen, sofern diese mit den Anforderungen der Rolle vereinbar sind. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, mobilem Arbeiten und Sabbaticals finden wir gemeinsam ein für Sie passendes Arbeitsmodell.
Erholungszeit, die wirklich zählt: Freuen Sie sich auf 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub pro Jahr – plus drei zusätzliche freie Tage zur individuellen Nutzung im Rahmen unseres „Zukunftsbetrags“.
Zukunft sichern: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge investieren wir schon heute in Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit von morgen.
Karriere mit Perspektive: Wir unterstützen Sie darin, Ihre Karriere aktiv selbst voranzutreiben mit individuellen Weiterbildungsangeboten, Bereitstellung von Lernplattformen wie LinkedIn Learning und vielfältigen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten.

as an MLOps Engineer
In Digital Solutions, we drive innovation for connected mobility and deliver cutting-edge digital products to our global fleet customers. As an MLOps Engineer, you will be at the forefront of transforming machine learning into scalable, production-ready solutions.
You will design, deploy, and maintain robust ML pipelines , ensuring seamless integration of models into production environments and optimizing their performance at scale. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and cross-functional teams , you will enable AI-driven insights that power smarter, safer, and more efficient mobility worldwide.
This position is intended to be filled on a full-time basis. However, applications for part-time employment will be considered in accordance with business needs.
Main responsibilities :
Design and manage CI/CD pipelines for ML models from development to production
Build and maintain scalable ML infrastructure on cloud platforms using infrastructure-as-code
Automate deployment, monitoring, and rollback processes for reliability and reproducibility
Implement monitoring and feedback loops for model performance and continuous improvement
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate ML models and standardize workflows
Provide technical leadership and mentorship, fostering knowledge sharing and best practices

Read less
Your profile
Academic degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field
Several years of professional experience as a MLOps Engineer
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
Expertise in CI/CD and automation tools (e.g., GitHub Actions)
Proficiency in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Hands-on experience with ML model deployment and lifecycle management (MLflow, SageMaker)
Good knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code practices
Familiarity with monitoring and performance tracking tools (Grafana) and workflow orchestration (Airflow)
Solid understanding of software engineering and DevOps practices (testing, GitOps, CI/CD design patterns)
Experience with Agile project management methods (Scrum, Kanban)
Proficient English language skills (written and spoken)
Experience working in an international team (desirable)
Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Flexibility that fits your life: Whether mobile working, part-time models, flexible working hours, or sabbaticals – together we find a working model that suits your individual needs.
Time off that truly matters: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation per year.
Secure your future: With our company pension plan, we already invest today in your financial security of tomorrow.
Career with perspective: We actively support you in shaping your career through individual trainings, access to learning platforms such as LinkedIn Learning, and a wide range of development opportunities.
Borderless opportunities: As an EU citizen, you can work remote from other EU countries for up to 40 days per year – offering greater freedom and international flexibility.

Stay fit – nationwide: With our comprehensive range of health and wellness initiatives, you stay active – wherever you are in Germany.
Sustainable mobility: Use our “JobRad” bike leasing program and secure your preferred bicycle at attractive conditions – for more fitness, climate protection, and enjoyment on your daily commute.

Coralogix.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Backend / Data Engineer to join our Core Data Pipeline team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and scaling the engine that processes Coralogix’s high-throughput, real-time telemetry data.
Our pipeline handles billions of events per second, performing real-time processing, data enrichment, and other transformations. If you thrive on solving high-scale, low-latency distributed systems challenges - this is the place for you.
What You’ll Do
High-Scale Engineering: Design, build, and maintain our central data processing pipeline, handling massive volumes of logs and traces at extreme scale.
Transform & Enrich: Architect real-time stream processing systems to perform complex data transformations and enrichments in real time.
Performance & Efficiency: Optimize system throughput, reduce memory footprints, and minimize latency across distributed clusters.
Architecture & Reliability: Take full ownership of feature lifecycles - from design and system architecture to production monitoring and resilience.

About the Role
This role sits squarely at the intersection of Cybersecurity and AI. We are looking for a hands-on, builder-minded AI Senior Product Manager to lead a high-stakes, 0-to-1 initiative .
This is a rare opportunity to operate with the agility and autonomy of a startup founder while leveraging the massive datasets, engineering resources, and established market presence of an industry leader. You will be responsible for building a net-new product from the ground up - translating raw technical concepts into production-grade reality. We are looking for an entrepreneurial builder who thrives in ambiguity and is obsessed with rapid iteration and technical depth.
This is not a role for a traditional "project manager." You must be a hands-on owner who brings strong, opinionated perspectives formed by real-world technical experience. You will own product initiatives from deep problem discovery through engineering execution, validating and shipping products that security practitioners rely on every day.
What You'll Do
Drive 0-to-1 Cybersecurity & AI Products End-to-End
Operate with a founder's mentality: own the product lifecycle from initial discovery and definition to UX design, technical execution, customer validation, and production release.
Frame ambiguous market opportunities into simple, well-scoped milestones, specs, and rapid execution plans.
Act as a hands-on builder-owning the outcome end-to-end rather than just managing processes or tickets.
Build Practical, Production-Grade Capabilities for Security
Identify key leverage points in security workflows (e.g., threat hunting, incident response) where AI can unlock step-function improvements.
Harness and build on top of existing AI agentic frameworks to solve complex cybersecurity challenges - translating model strengths and limitations into practical UX decisions.
Go beyond theoretical AI buzzwords to ship reliable, predictable, and value-driving security features in production.
Partner Deeply with Engineering & Security Experts
Work daily with Tech Leads, AI Engineers, Security Analysts, and Designers in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Get comfortable looking at raw logs, trace data, system architectures, and security vulnerabilities alongside engineers to deeply understand root causes and technical tradeoffs.
Challenge unnecessary technical complexity and continuously push for the simplest, most elegant solution.
Own UX & Product Quality for Technical Users
Maintain an exceptionally high bar for product quality, clarity, and system reliability.
Abstract dense technical data, security alerts, and complex AI outputs into intuitive, actionable user workflows.
Treat launch day as the start of continuous learning - actively monitoring usage metrics, validating edge cases, and rapidly iterating based on live system feedback.
Stay Connected to Technical Customers
Engage directly with security practitioners, DevOps, and SREs to uncover genuine friction points in their daily operations.
Translate raw customer feedback into prioritized product roadmaps grounded in real operational impact.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
Extensive Product Management Experience: Proven track record in B2B SaaS, specifically leading 0-to-1 product units. An entrepreneurial, founder-level mindset is critical for success here.
Practical AI Application: We need a practitioner, not a researcher. You have experience harnessing LLMs, RAG, or AI agents to solve real-world problems, translating model strengths and limitations into practical UX decisions.
Non-Negotiable Cybersecurity Mastery: Theoretical or "buzzword" knowledge is insufficient. You must demonstrate deep, hands-on technical mastery of how vulnerabilities and exploits work at a code and infrastructure level. You are comfortable inspecting raw logs, reviewing API structures, and debating technical tradeoffs with engineers.
Builder Mindset: Strong ownership instincts. You care deeply about execution speed, customer impact, and shipping high-quality software end-to-end.
Outcome-Driven Impact: You focus on delivering tangible value to users, ensuring the complexity of technical data is simplified into immediate, actionable outcomes rather than just features that look good.
Clear Communication & Influence: Concise, high-signal written and verbal communication style with a strong preference for actionable docs over unnecessary meetings, and the ability to influence others without direct authority.
Huge Advantage If You Have
Deep Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience with SIEM, or cybersecurity workflows.
Ex-Engineer / Security Background: Prior experience as a Software Engineer, Security Analyst, DevOps Engineer, or System Architect.
0-to-1 AI Production Track Record: Experience taking an AI capability from early concept/POC all the way to enterprise-grade production.
Inbound Passion: You are an active user, tinkerer, or follower of the modern AI and cybersecurity tooling ecosystems and have genuine excitement for the space.
Why Join Us?
You will have direct ownership over building a net-new product at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity. This role offers high visibility, significant autonomy, and the chance to operate like an entrepreneur within a growing company, solving high-stakes technical problems every day.
