Hud.description:
About the Role
We’re building a runtime code sensor that operates where most tools don’t: inside running applications. Our goal is to give engineers and AI agents real-time, high-fidelity visibility into how code actually behaves in production – under real load, real traffic, and real failures.
This role blends deep systems engineering with applied research . You’ll dive into runtime internals, explore undocumented behavior, design low-overhead instrumentation, and turn research insights into production-grade components that safely run in customer environments. One day you might analyze GC or JIT behavior; the next, design tracing mechanisms that survive real-world distributed systems.
If you get excited about runtime internals, enjoy breaking (and fixing) complex systems, think like both a researcher and a production engineer, and care deeply about performance, safety, and correctness – you’ll feel right at home here. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for engineers who want to ship technology that engineers actually trust to run in their most critical services.
Engineering Excellence / Mindset
Ability to anticipate technical risks, identify bottlenecks, and drive long-term engineering improvements.
Takes ownership of code quality, documentation, reliability, and observability.
Comfortable working with product teams to balance technical trade-offs with user and business needs.
Autonomous and proactive; capable of mentoring others or leading technical initiatives.
Bonus Points
Background in security agents, observability tools, or other components deployed directly into customer environments.
Experience with APM agents, JVM agents, Python tracing, V8 internals, or other instrumentation/profiling frameworks.
Experience with telemetry systems (metrics, tracing, logging) including batching, rate-limiting, and safe data collection.
Familiarity with sampling techniques, bytecode manipulation, eBPF, or low-overhead tracing.
Exposure to safety-critical or high-throughput environments where reliability and minimal overhead are mandatory.
Contributions to open-source instrumentation, tracing, or internals-related projects.
Requirements
This is a full-time on-site position located in Tel Aviv.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment is essential.
Experience
5+ years of hands-on research or development roles.
Deep expertise in at least one runtime (Node.js, Python, or Java/JVM), including understanding of internals (event loop, GC, tracing hooks, bytecode/JIT, etc.).
Hands-on experience building in-process production components (SDKs, agents, profilers, monitoring/security tools) that must be safe, stable, and backward-compatible.
Strong performance engineering skills – profiling CPU/memory, avoiding overhead, understanding how instrumentation affects runtime behavior.
Defensive engineering mindset – experience designing systems that fail-open, degrade gracefully, protect the host application, and never introduce instability.
Track record debugging production issues (latency, memory leaks, regressions, deadlocks) in real-world distributed systems.
Solid understanding of modern backend architectures – experience with microservices, distributed systems, async and event-driven patterns, containers/orchestration (Docker/K8s), cloud runtimes, and the performance or reliability challenges they introduce.
Proven ability to ship stable, resilient, maintainable systems in production.

מהנדס/ת תהליך למפעל העשרה באתר רותם

23 באוג׳ 2026

Dimona, IL
חברה:
רותם
!הזדמנות מצוינת להתחיל קריירה בהנדסת תהליך
.מפעל העשרה באתר רותם מחפש מהנדס/ת תהליך מתחיל/ה להצטרפות לצוות מקצועי ודינמי בתעשייה משמעותית ומובילה
!רוצה לגעת בתהליכים אמיתיים, ללמוד מהשטח ולהשפיע כבר מהיום הראשון? זו ההזדמנות שלך
:תיאור היחידה
,מפעל העשרה כולל שני תחומי פעילות מרכזיים: תחום אחד בו מתבצעת העשרה יבשה של פוספט, המשמש כחומר גלם למתקני הדשנים ולמתקני המשך נוספים ותחום נוסף בו מתבצעת העשרה רטובה של פוספט עבור מתקני הזרחתית
.העבודה מתקיימת בסביבה תעשייתית דינמית, המשלבת עבודת שטח עם עבודה משרדית
מהנדס/ת התהליך משמש/ת כסמכות מקצועית בתחום ההפעלה, ועובד/ת באופן שוטף מול מגוון ממשקים, בהם הפעלה, אחזקה, חשמל, מכשור, מעבדה, ספקים ונותני שירות
באחריות מהנדס/ת התהליך לבצע בקרה שוטפת על התהליכים בשני תחומי הפעילות, תוך מתן הנחיות עבודה וליווי מקצועי לצוותי התפעול
:מה יהיו תחומי האחריות שלך
שיפור וייעול תהליכים תעשייתיים קיימים, כולל ניתוח נתונים, פתרון תקלות והטמעת שינויים -
מתן תמיכה מקצועית לעובדי ההפעלה בשטח – חניכה, ליווי והדרכה -
עבודה שוטפת מול ממשקים פנימיים: אחזקה, חשמל, מכשור, מעבדה, בטיחות, איכות והנדסה -
ניהול קשרים עם ספקים ונותני שירותים חיצוניים, כולל תיאום פעולות ופתרון בעיות -
ביצוע תחקירים והפקת לקחים בעקבות אירועים חריגים או תקלות תפעוליות -
כתיבת נהלים, הוראות עבודה ודוחות טכניים -
השתתפות פעילה בפרויקטים הנדסיים לשיפור תשתיות, ציוד ותהליכים -
שמירה על עמידה בתקני איכות, בטיחות, סביבה ורגולציה -
:מה אנחנו מחפשים
בוגר/ת תואר ראשון בהנדסה כימית/ביוטכנולוגיה/ חומרים– חובה -
ניסיון קודם בתעשייה כמהנדס/ת תהליך – יתרון -
יכולת עבודה בצוות ושיתוף פעולה עם ממשקים מגוונים -
עצמאות, יוזמה ויכולת פתרון בעיות -
חשיבה אנליטית ויכולת ניתוח תהליכים -
הבנה הנדסית ויכולת טכנית גבוהה -
גמישות מחשבתית ויכולת הסתגלות לשינויים -
יכולת למידה עצמית והתפתחות מקצועית -
כושר ביטוי גבוה בעל פה ובכתב -
:מי אנחנו
אנו חברת מינרלים וכימיקלים עולמית מובילה, המפתחת פתרונות חדשניים לאתגרי הקיימות של האנושות בתחומי המזון, החקלאות והתעשייה העולמיים
עם כ-12,000 עובדים ברחבי העולם, חברתנו מפעילה אתרי כרייה וייצור הממוקמים בישראל, אירופה, צפון ודרום אמריקה וסין
​אנו חברה בעלת תרבות ארגונית מבוססת מנהיגות, חדשנות וקיימות, המאפשרת לעובדיה ועובדותיה לצמוח, להתפתח ולהיות חלק ממשהו משמעותי
:אנחנו מעריכים את הייחודיות שלך
כחברה גלובלית, אנו מחויבים ליצירת סביבת עבודה מכילה ושוויונית לכל, תוך קידום גיוון רב-תרבותי, שוויון מגדרי, הבדלים בין-דוריים, קהילות להטב"ק ואנשים עם מוגבלויות
אנו מעריכים את הייחודיות שלך ואת התרומה האישית שלך ומזמינים אותך לבוא ולעבוד בסביבת עבודה תומכת ומזמינה, המאפשרת לך להתפתח ולפרוח

דשנים וחומרים כימיים (דח"כ)
הזדמנות לעבוד בחברה גדולה ויציבה, רווחה עשירה הכוללת ארוחות חמות הסעות ושפע של הטבות נוספות
הדרכות והשתלמויות מקצועיות, אפשרויות קידום והתפתחות מקצועית בתוך הארגון
קצת על אתר דשנים
דשנים הינה מרכז הייצור והשיווק לתעשיית החקלאות בישראל, עוסקת בהזנת הצומח ומפתחת פתרונות גידול חדשניים לאתגרי הקיימות הגדולים ביותר של האנושות מתקני הייצור עובדים 24/7
תיאור המחלקה
מחלקת שירותי תעשייה מהווה את "לב הפועם" של המפעל, ואחראית על תפעול ותחזוקה של מערכות התשתית החיוניות להמשך פעילות תקינה של מתקני הייצור. צוות המחלקה מפעיל ומתחזק מגוון מערכות קריטיות הכוללות: דוודים לייצור קיטור מתקני טיפול במים בשיטת האוסמוזה ההפוכה, מגדלי קירור, בארות שאיבה, מתקן טיפול בשפכים, מערכות אוויר דחוס ומערכת הביוב המפעלית
העבודה במחלקה מאתגרת, מגוונת ומחייבת אחריות גבוהה, עבודת צוות ותפקוד מיטבי גם בתנאי לחץ
מה יהיו תחומי האחריות שלך

Immunai.description:
Description
About Immunai:
Immunai is an AI-driven platform company focused on improving drug discovery and development by decoding the human immune system.
We combine large-scale single cell immune data, advanced machine learning, and strong engineering to help pharmaceutical and research partners make better, more informed decisions throughout the drug development process.
Our long-term goal is to reduce drug development failure rates and help more effective medicines reach patients. We’re building this platform thoughtfully and collaboratively, bringing together expertise across biology, AI, engineering, and business.
Immunai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
About the role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced LLM/ML Agentic AI Researcher to lead the technical development of our agentic AI interpretation framework. This hands-on role involves designing, building, and evaluating AI agents that interpret complex biological data.
You will be at the forefront of developing a sophisticated scientific reasoning system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide structured, biologically-grounded explanations. Collaborating closely with immunologists, machine learning researchers, and technical leadership, you'll shape how we derive insights at a systems level, pushing the boundaries of AI in biology.
Location: Ramat Gan, Israel (Hybrid role)
What will you do?
Design, prototype, and build LLM-based agentic systems that reason over biological data, scientific literature, model outputs, and internal tools.
Develop agents capable of structured reasoning, hypothesis generation, explanation, planning, tool use, and iterative scientific analysis.
Build robust evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, including automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation pipelines.
Define and implement benchmarks, metrics, and test suites for measuring agent performance, including reasoning quality, biological grounding, factuality, robustness, reproducibility, and usefulness.
Work closely with AI researchers, computational biologists, immunologists, and product teams to translate scientific needs into measurable AI capabilities.
Create evaluation datasets and benchmark tasks that reflect real-world biological and therapeutic reasoning problems.
Analyze agent behavior, failure modes, hallucinations, tool-use errors, reasoning gaps, and grounding issues.
Contribute to the architecture of production-grade AI systems, including agent orchestration, retrieval, tool calling, memory, planning, and monitoring.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in LLMs, agentic AI, evaluation methodologies, and scientific AI systems.
Help turn research prototypes into reliable products used by internal teams and external partners.
Requirements
Required qualifications:
MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computational Biology, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong background in machine learning, data science, statistics, or computational modeling.
Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic AI systems.
Proven ability to design evaluation methodologies for AI systems, especially LLM-based or agent-based systems.
Experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source LLMs.
Experience with agent frameworks or orchestration tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, or similar systems.
Experience defining benchmarks, metrics, validation sets, scoring methods, or automated evaluation pipelines.
Strong Python skills and ability to write clean, production-aware research code.
Ability to work with complex, noisy, high-dimensional data.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with experts from different disciplines.
Desired personal traits:
You want to make an impact on humankind
You prioritize “We” over “I”
You enjoy getting things done and striving for excellence
You collaborate effectively with people of diverse backgrounds and cultures

Description
About Immunai:
Immunai is an AI-driven platform company focused on improving drug discovery and development by decoding the human immune system.
We combine large-scale single cell immune data, advanced machine learning, and strong engineering to help pharmaceutical and research partners make better, more informed decisions throughout the drug development process.
Our long-term goal is to reduce drug development failure rates and help more effective medicines reach patients. We’re building this platform thoughtfully and collaboratively, bringing together expertise across biology, AI, engineering, and business.
Immunai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
About the role:
We are looking for a Staff Architect, Data & AI Infra to shape, build, and scale the infrastructure that powers Immunai's data, AI, and research platforms. This is a senior player-coach role with broad architectural ownership across data infrastructure, ML infrastructure, developer experience, reproducibility, and production reliability. You will work across the wider engineering group as a hands-on technical architect , while also managing a small team of individual contributors focused on ML infrastructure.
This role is ideal for someone who can move between long-term platform architecture and practical execution: defining standards, building core systems, mentoring engineers, improving reliability, and partnering with Data Engineering, AI/Research, Product Engineering, Security, Bioinformatics, and Leadership to make Immunai's data and AI platforms scalable, reproducible, secure, compliant, and easier to use.
Location: Ramat Gan, Israel (hybrid model)
What will you do?
Architectural Leadership : Own and evolve the technical roadmap for Immunai’s data and AI platforms, ensuring scalable and reliable architecture that supports current needs and prepares for a multi-cloud future.
MLOps & Platform Development : Design and build end-to-end MLOps systems—covering experimentation, training, reproducibility, and deployment—while managing specialized infrastructure like BigQuery, orchestration tools (Dagster/Airflow), and R/Python workloads.
I nfrastructure Strategy : Define and lead strategy for GPU resources (scheduling, utilization, batch compute) and establish engineering best practices, data architecture standards, and platform guardrails.
Developer Experience : Enhance developer productivity by building self-service platforms, automation, internal tooling, and reusable templates that simplify workflows and reduce operational friction.
Team Leadership : Act as a player-coach to mentor engineers and manage a small team of ICs, fostering a culture of sound decision-making and technical excellence across the broader group.
Security & Reliability : Partner with Security to enforce compliance (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR) and access controls, while mitigating operational risk through improved observability, incident readiness, and robust support processes.
Requirements
Required qualifications:
8+ years of industry experience in infrastructure, platform, data, or ML engineering , with a deep background in designing production infrastructure for data-intensive or AI/ML systems .
Hands-on expertise building and operating MLOps systems (for model development, training, and deployment) and managing GPU infrastructure, including scheduling, resource management, and utilization.
Proficient in managing data infrastructure technologies (e.g., BigQuery, data warehouses, object storage, orchestration systems like Dagster or Airflow) and operating within Kubernetes/containerized environments .
Demonstrated ability as a player-coach , including people-management experience or leading small engineering teams, with a focus on mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction.
Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively across diverse groups , including Data Engineering, AI/Research, Product Engineering, Security, Bioinformatics and Leadership.
Preferred qualifications:
Developer Platform & Velocity: Proven ability to build internal developer platforms, "golden paths," and self-service infrastructure that reduce operational friction and streamline workflows for research and engineering teams.
AI-First Transformation: Experience leading or guiding software and data engineering teams through the transition toward AI-first development processes, fostering adoption of new paradigms and tooling.
Compliance & Domain Expertise : Strong background operating within regulated environments (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR) and applying infrastructure best practices to domain-specific fields such as biotech, life sciences, or bioinformatics.

You want to make an impact on humankind
You prioritize “We” over “I”
You enjoy getting things done and striving for excellence
You collaborate effectively with people of diverse backgrounds and cultures
You have a growth mindset
You are candid, authentic, and transparent

Intuit Israel.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Foundational Models and Agentic systems

Intuit Israel.description:
In this role you will define, design, and build groundbreaking AI solutions that understand, reason, and act across complex financial and business contexts.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional experts across AI research, data science, engineering, and product to create intelligent agents that help SMBs automate financial tasks, make smarter decisions, and operate more efficiently. Your work will combine scientific rigor with visionary execution, balancing theoretical innovation with large-scale practical impact.
As a Staff Scientist you set technical direction beyond your own projects. You are a builder-scientist — a creative thinker who develops novel model architectures and training paradigms and also drives their implementation and validation in real-world applications — and you raise the scientific bar for the teams around you. You will help shape the AI foundation that powers transformative products serving millions of customers.
Responsibilities
Set technical direction. Define the technical strategy and roadmap for next-generation agentic and foundation-model systems, and drive innovation and scientific excellence across the organization.
Build foundational models and agents. Design and develop foundational language models and agentic architectures that power intelligent decision-making for small and medium businesses.
Advance the science. Explore novel approaches in large-scale pretraining, fine-tuning (SFT and RLFT/GRPO), retrieval-augmented generation, and reasoning to improve factuality, adaptability, and alignment.
Solve real financial work. Build intelligent agents that understand financial data, customer context, and business workflows — from bookkeeping and autonomous accounting to planning, communication, and insight generation.
Leverage Intuit’s data moat. Turn Intuit’s unique ecosystem signals — counterparty behavior, two-sided transaction visibility, and business twins — into defensible modeling advantages.
Ship end-to-end. Take work from experimentation to production, owning evaluation frameworks and metrics that prove real-world impact.
Elevate others. Mentor scientists and engineers, review technical designs, and grow the craft of the wider team — a core expectation at the Staff level.
Collaborate across functions. Partner with AI research, engineering, product, and design to translate breakthrough science into scalable products used by millions.
Share knowledge. Publish and present research findings, internal innovations, or contributions to open-source frameworks where appropriate.
Qualifications
Qualifications
Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field, with a track record of technical leadership on complex AI systems.
Proven experience with LLMs, multimodal, or foundation models — including pretraining, fine-tuning, and deployment.
Deep understanding of transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, reasoning models, and agentic systems.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML and agentic frameworks .
Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end AI pipelines, from experimentation to production at scale.
Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams and mentoring other scientists and engineers.
Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
A passion for creating AI that augments human potential and simplifies complex business workflows.
Nice to have
Experience applying RL fine-tuning (GRPO, RLHF/RLFT) or model-based RL to language or decision-making systems.
Background in financial, accounting, or business-domain AI, or in probabilistic forecasting and world models is a major advantage.
Publications at top ML venues or meaningful open-source contributions.

Responsibilities
What You'll Do
Proactive Pipeline Generation: Execute daily outbound activity (calls, email, social) to identify and engage decision-makers at target Mid-Market accounts.
Consultative Solution Selling: Lead deep-dive discovery sessions to uncover business pain points and architect the right solution using Intuit Enterprise Suite's AI-Native ERP platform and ecosystem.

Intuit Israel.description:
As a TurboTax - Retail Expert, you will serve as a trusted advisor, empowering customers to achieve positive financial outcomes while supporting Intuit’s mission of “Powering Prosperity Around the World.”
About the Role: In this role, you will work on-site from a TurboTax Retail or Flagship location as part of a collaborative team of financial experts, serving in-person customers who use Intuit TurboTax products.
You will serve customers in-person using Intuit TurboTax products. You will leverage your tax expertise to provide full service tax return preparation, tax advice, calculations, and software/product support. Your ability to demonstrate understanding of each customer’s unique situation, and connect with them on a personal level is critical to alleviating the stress some may feel when tackling their taxes.
Additionally, you will play a key role in growing TurboTax’s client base within the local community, attracting new clients, establishing long-term relationships, and driving customer loyalty. You will leverage TurboTax marketing support and software to empower you in building a thriving business that fosters prosperity for both you and your community.
This role is non-exempt and requires onsite presence at a TurboTax location in the United States.
What You’ll Do:
Be a Proactive Community Ambassador
Enthusiastically represent TurboTax locally, serving as a fixture and public face of TurboTax in the community.
Engage with new prospects, nurture leads, and convert prospects into long-term clients through proactive outreach.
Lead and participate with the support of TurboTax in local marketing, making the topic of taxes accessible and approachable.
Provide Tax Expertise
Give hands-on tax advice and complete preparation services for TurboTax customers, handling simple to complex tax situations (e.g., personal and business income, deductions optimization, amendments).
Facilitate discovery sessions and tax reviews to uncover deductions, minimize tax liabilities, maximize refunds, and provide future tax planning advice.
Utilize resources such as government websites, professional tools, and team expertise to deliver accurate tax solutions in personalized everyday language.
Deliver a Best in Class Customer Experience
Create an exceptional customer experience through professionalism, and genuine interest in helping clients achieve their financial goals (e.g., saving for retirement, college funds, weddings, or vacations).
Connect with people to build the long-term trust that turns a one-time transaction into a loyal, multi-year relationship.
Interact with customers both in-person and through Intuit’s state-of-the-art video communication tools.
Address client inquiries while helping them overcome tax-related challenges.
What You Get: As a TurboTax - Retail Expert, you’ll receive access to exceptional company benefits and resources, including:
401(k) Savings Plan with company matching, paid sick time, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, E&O Insurance provided by Intuit, Employee Assistance Program
discounts on Intuit products including a free copy of TurboTax, ongoing collaboration opportunities with TurboTax’s network of growth-minded professionals and marketing support
Key Qualifications
Who You Are:
Active, unrestricted EA, CPA, or attorney license with strong tax preparation experience with deep knowledge of tax law preferred.
Have an active Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN) as required by law to file taxes.
Must possess or be able to obtain any related State licenses, certificates, permits, or bonds
Minimum of 3 years of paid experience filing 30 or more federal and state individual 1040 tax returns per tax season using professional tax preparation software.
Familiarity with Circular 230
Must be comfortable working onsite at a TurboTax retail or flagship location, Sunday through Saturday, for a minimum of 20 hours per week. Operating hours are subject to change and will likely scale up during periods of peak customer demand .
Interest in building a local and online social presence as a TurboTax Expert, creating accessible tax-related content and resources for your community in accordance with Intuit’s policies
Bilingual (English/Spanish) communication skills are a plus
Experience in holistic tax advisory services beyond tax filing
Must be willing to wear a TurboTax uniform
Must be willing to work in a front facing retail environment
Attributes & Skills:
Passionate about empowering customers and helping them overcome the complexities of taxation.
Passionate about your local community and excited to work with Intuit to engage with and build Intuit’s presence in your local community (e.g., speaking at events, building a local and online social presence, creating content such as tax tips and educational videos).
Entrepreneurial and self-driven with a business ownership mindset to grow your customer portfolio.
Exceptional customer service skills, high empathy, and a friendly, professional demeanor.
Excited to be showcased as a TurboTax Expert in local and national marketing efforts.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment independently while managing multiple priorities.
Proficient with technology, including tax preparation software and CRM/sales tools.
Additional Requirements:
Must reside within the United States.
Must possess or be able to obtain any related State licenses, certificates, permits, or bonds.

This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits ). Jafi.description:
Description
אחריות על הנחיית האבטחה בחו"ל לרבות מתקנים, עובדים, מבקרים, אירועים וכיו"ב תחת מנהל אגף חו"ל.
ניהול מערכות המידע, טכנולוגיה וביצוע משימות מגוונות נוספות בארץ ובחו"ל.
אחריות לנושאי המודיעין והמידע אל מול כלל הגורמים.
ביצוע ומימוש הנחיות ומדיניות חטיבת הביטחון לשגרה, הערכות לחירום וחירום.
אחריות לכתיבה, הפצה, הטמעה, בחינה ועדכון של נהלים, הוראות והנחיות בתחומי האחריות בהתאם להנחיית מנהל חטיבת הביטחון.
אחריות להפעלת מערך הבקרה בכל מתקני היחידה לפיקוח על יישום הנחיות, ביצוע הוראות ונהלים ועמידה בתוכניות העבודה.
קיום קשר עם גורמי הביטחון המנחים כגון: שב"כ, משטרת ישראל, משרד הביטחון וצה"ל לתאום ועדכון הדדיים, בכל נושאי אחריותו/ה.
הכנת סקירות, ניירות עמדה ודיווחים, ע"פ הצורך.
ביצוע תפקידים נוספים בארץ או בחו"ל, בתחום המקצועי, ע"פ הנחיות הממונה.
Requirements

Description
מובילת תחום הנוער בשותפות ביחד- קריית גת, שפיר, לכיש- שיקגו , האחראית על תכנון, פיתוח והוצאה לפועל של תוכניות חינוכיות ופרויקטים של קשרי גומלין בין בני נוער מהארץ לבני נוער משיקגו. התפקיד משלב חינוך ערכי בלתי פורמלי, חיזוק הזהות היהודית והישראלית, מנהיגות צעירה וניהול קשרים בינלאומיים שוטפים.
​תחומי אחריות מרכזיים
​פיתוח והובלת תוכניות חינוכיות:
​בנייה והנחיה של תוכניות שנתיות לבני נוער בנושאי עמיות יהודית, זהות, ציונות ותיקון עולם.
​פיתוח מערכים ותכנים חינוכיים מותאמים אישית (לעבודה פרונטלית ווירטואלית).
ריכוז קשרי גומלין ושותפויות:
​ריכוז הקשר השוטף עם שותפים בקהילת השותפות בחו"ל, אנשי המקצוע ומנהיגי הנוער מעבר לים.
​ייזום ויצירת חיבורים וגשרים חינוכיים בין בתי ספר, תנועות נוער וארגונים מקומיים לבין מקביליהם בחו"ל.
​הובלת משלחות ואירועי שיא:
​ליווי, הכנה והוצאה לפועל של משלחות נוער (נכנסות ויוצאות) ומחנות קיץ.
​הפקת אירועי שיא, סמינרים וימי עיון מרוכזים.
​ליווי והנחיית בני נוער:
​גיוס, מיון והנחיית קבוצות מנהיגות צעירה.
​ליווי אישי וקבוצתי של בני הנוער לאורך התהליך החינוכי.
אדמיניסטרציה ותפעול:
​ניהול תקציב התוכניות שבאחריותה.
​עבודה מול ספקים, לוגיסטיקה, שיווק וגיוס משתתפים.
​מעקב והערכה של התוכניות.
Requirements
תואר ראשון רלוונטי (חינוך, מדעי החברה, עבודה קהילתית, יהדות וכד') – חובה.
​ניסיון בחינוך בלתי פורמלי (תנועות נוער, שנת שירות, מרכזים קהילתיים) - חובה.
​ניסיון קודם בעבודה עם יהדות התפוצות, הדרכה או השתתפות בשליחויות ומשלחות – יתרון משמעותי.
​עברית ברמת שפת אם.
​אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד (דיבור, כתיבה וקריאה) – חובה לצורך ניהול קשרים בינלאומיים.
​יחסי אנוש מעולים, יכולת עבודה בצוות, יכולת הנחייה ועמידה מול קהל ובני נוער.
​יכולת עבודה עצמאית, מוטיבציה, יוזמה, יצירתיות וראש גדול.
​כושר ארגון וניהול זמן ברמה גבוהה (יכולת תמרון בין משימות לוגיסטיות לחינוכיות).
תחילת עבודה מיידית.
​ היקף משרה: משרה מלאה .
​גמישות ושעות עבודה:
​העבודה דורשת גמישות בשעות, כולל עבודה בשעות אחר הצהריים והערב בהתאם לפעילות הנוער ולפערי השעות מול חו"ל.
​נכונות לנסיעות לחו"ל, עבודה בסופי שבוע בשבתונים וביציאה למשלחות (על פי הצורך).
*במקרה של שוויון בין מועמדים ינתן משקל נוסף לטובת מועמד.ת עם מוגבלות.

Hungry for a challenge?
That’s good, because at Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET) we have abundant opportunity, or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe.
Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding or couriers.
About this role:
As a B2B Marketing Manager for our brand in Tel Aviv, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our brand strategy to drive sustainable and profitable growth. Your primary responsibility will be to develop and implement multi-channel marketing campaigns that align with our brand positioning and resonate with our target audience.
Leveraging your deep understanding of market insights, you will transform data into impactful campaigns that support our business objectives. Your expertise in analysis and strategic thinking will be key in identifying local growth opportunities and mitigating potential risks.
From planning and executing marketing initiatives to evaluating their success, you will ensure that every activity—whether local campaigns, customer activations, or PR efforts—is optimized to strengthen our B2B presence and effectively engage customers across Israel.
Responsibilities:
Competitive analysis of the B2B landscape and changing dynamics- conducting in-market surveys, round tables, participation in conferences, and relevant forums.
Drive new potential consumers in-bounds and SDR via B2B communication tools (Linkedin campaigns, Meta, Google, Taboola)
Drive existing customer success and retention efforts- Build and execute creative communication plan (newsletters, notifications, presentations, leaflets, etc.) to existing corporate admins and end users via (writing and communicating new product features, special events, unique benefits and propositions, etc.)
Budget Ownership & media planning
Brief agencies, plan, execute, and evaluate winning marketing activities, ensure they are consistent with brand positioning across all touchpoints, and drive 10bis corporate users base growth.
Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders- acting as a contact point and B2B landscape expert
Own and maintain our B2B social media assets, driving brand presence, engagement, and content strategy across relevant platforms.
Reports to the Head of B2B Sales
Your profile:
Minimum of 2-5 years of relevant working experience in B2B marketing (advantage from corporate wellbeing-related segments)
A Bachelor's degree in Marketing/Business Administration or related field
Excellent collaboration skills with multiple internal and external parties
Strategic thinking with strong creative judgment
Planning and organizational skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Creative and with a test & learn approach
Excellent writing and communication skills. Fluent in Hebrew and English (written and spoken)
The ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing work environment
Budget ownership
Proven experience in managing customer clubs and/or loyalty programs – significant advantage.

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

Responsibilities :
Responsibilities:
The Association Manager is responsible for the overall administration and smooth operation of the society, supporting its strategic, operational, and business objectives.
Key Areas of Responsibility:
Administration & Operations:
Manage the association’s day-to-day activities, stakeholder communication, documentation, and internal processes.
Meeting & Board Management:
Coordinate and manage virtual and in-person meetings (Board, committees, General Assembly), including logistics, materials, minutes, and follow-ups.
Executive & Governance Support:
Support the Board and Officers, implement strategic plans and policies, manage elections, governance processes, and key programs (e.g., grants, endorsements).
Project & Event Management:
Plan and deliver key projects, awards, grants, and support congress coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Communications & Marketing:
Manage member communications, newsletters, website, and social media; support branding, visibility, and promotional activities.
Financial Coordination:
Support financial operations including budgeting, invoicing, payments, reporting, and coordination with finance teams.
Membership Management:
Oversee membership processes, database management, renewals, engagement, and growth initiatives.
Stakeholder Management:
Work closely with Board members, partners, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure effective collaboration.
Qualifications:
University degree, or equivalent
Excellent English (written/spoken)
Excellent computer skills (Microsoft Office – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
Working knowledge of online systems such as WordPress, CRM system.
Experience:
3–5 years of experience in an administrative, Project Managment, coordination role
Experience working with non-profit associations / NGOs – an advantage

Strong administrative and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using a variety of digital tools (e.g., Canva, Mailchimp, Elementor, and similar platforms)
High level of commercial and financial awareness
Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills
Good judgment, with the ability to work independently, proactively, and creatively
Ability to build effective working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders, including international counterparts
Discretion, diplomacy, and strong attention to detail

Competitive salary and full-time labor contract.
Flexible benefits program: food vouchers, optional additional health insurance, corporate discounts, etc.
Fixed working hours (Monday-Friday).
Hybrid working mode, excellent office location, and free shuttle bus from the metro station to the office.
Gifts for special occasions, fruits, massages, and yoga classes in the office once per week.
Real opportunities for professional development in a leading international company.
Friendly team culture that promotes initial and continual professional education and team collaboration.
Regular team events.
Refer a friend program.

Komodor.description:
We're looking for a technical Product Manager to join Komodor's AI product team and own the roadmap for Klaudia - our autonomous AI SRE agent. You'll work directly with customers, solution architects and R&D leads to define how Klaudia senses, investigates, decides, acts, and validates across availability issues and reliability risks. It's a role for someone who can translate complex AI/infra tradeoffs into a sharp product strategy.
What you will do
Work on the product roadmap execution, aligned with Komodor's mission and customer needs
Collaborate with engineering and design teams to drive Komodor’s AI to success
Conduct thorough market research, close work with sales teams and customer calls to identify trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for AI integrations
Effectively communicate product vision, progress, and outcomes to internal stakeholders and customers
Define KPIs around AI capabilities and utilize data-driven insights to make decisions and product iterations
Requirements
3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, with a proven background as a Software Engineer / Developer prior to transitioning into product management.
Significant hands-on software development experience , ideally within cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, microservices, or AI-driven solutions.
A data-driven mindset with the ability to approach challenges strategically and identify impactful solutions.
You know to operate independently, move quickly, and keep work organized.
Excellent verbal and written communication abilities, capable of translating complex technical concepts for various audiences, including non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to work effectively across diverse teams, managing multiple stakeholders and aligning priorities to drive product success.
Why Join Komodor?
Be part of a team that's at the forefront of Kubernetes and AI technology
Great culture and perks
Options & benefits
Growth opportunities!
Wellness and Employee experience events
Dog friendly (well, we love animals in total!)
Contribution to local communities by hosting, participating and encouraging our employees to be our ambassadors!
If you're passionate about AI and eager to drive innovation in the Kubernetes ecosystem, we'd love to hear from you!
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Why People Love Working Here
We invest in our team's growth, wellbeing, and happiness with
comprehensive benefits and perks
Start-Up Spirit
Fast-moving, collaborative, and ownership-driven. Ideas matter, initiative is rewarded, and the energy is always high.
Learning & Development
Curiosity thrives here. We invest in courses, conferences, mentorship, and hands-on learning so you keep growing, always.
Founders Mindset
Everyone gets meaningful equity. Real ownership, real upside—yes, the life-changing kind.
Employee Experience
From off-sites and team days to global meetups and conferences—we make time to connect, learn, and have fun together.
Impact From Day One
No sidelines. You’re involved from day one, shaping decisions and building things that matter. Your voice is heard.
Our Secret Sauce
Hybrid in Israel, flexible globally. Office for collaboration, home for focus—trust, balance, and zero guilt.
The hiring team tips
What are we looking for in a candidate? We are looking for proactive people that have the ability to smoothly get into our fast paced rhythm, learn and adapt quickly, be communicative as we believe in collaboration and continuous learning. We are looking for experienced people that have the willingness to have an impact.
What should you expect in the interview process? Some of the interviews will focus more on your skills and knowledge, and some would be to assess your fit to our company’s culture. We believe that setting and matching expectations are important not just in the recruitment process – but also in general! We strongly believe that meeting your direct manager & colleagues is an important phase in our recruitment process that could give you more transparency and information about us. And if it is a match – it is a match!
How do you evaluate success in any role? At Komodor, we believe in data. We are a data-driven company with goals to achieve and make impact and value to our customers.
Are there any growth opportunities within the company? Yes! There are many opportunities at Komodor for everyone to evolve and move forward in their careers. In startups you tend to learn fast, have different touch points within your role and responsibilities and also you will collaborate with different people from different departments. This leads to 360 exposure in any of our work processes. Also, we are growing from year to year so as we grow – you will grow with us!

Konsortium Ziviler Friedensdienst.description:
About the role
Pro Peace – formerly forumZFD – started its operations in Palestine and Israel in 1999. We work with Palestinian and Israeli civil society organizations to strengthen civic space, democratic participation, and non-violent conflict transformation in an increasingly polarized and restrictive environment.
The Project Manager for Advocacy, Media and Communications strengthens Pro Peace’s work on Palestine and Israel by monitoring political developments, identifying advocacy opportunities, supporting partners in articulating and amplifying their messages, and contributing to strategic advocacy, media and communication approaches. The role supports the development of advocacy initiatives, communication materials, campaigns, and engagement with German and international audiences, in close cooperation with programme colleagues, local partners, and relevant Pro Peace Head Office colleagues.
Key responsibilities
Develop advocacy strategies and projects for Pro Peace’s work on Palestine and Israel, drawing on programme developments, the perspectives of local civil-society partners and local colleagues.
Identify advocacy opportunities, target audiences, strategic entry points for engagement in Germany and internationally by analysing political, social, and conflict-related developments.
Capacitate and support local partner organizations in articulating their messages and engaging with relevant audiences through advocacy opportunities, including speaking tours, public events, campaigns, petitions, policy engagement, and other advocacy formats.
Develop and coordinate media and communication outputs , including articles, briefings, statements, letters, and campaign materials – drawing on partner perspectives and programme experience.
Build and maintain relationships with relevant advocacy networks and stakeholders – locally and internationally – to strengthen strategic engagement opportunities.
Report to the Regional Director and work in close coordination with Pro Peace Head Office colleagues in communications, media, and advocacy.
Your profile
Minimum of 3 years’ professional experience in advocacy, civil society engagement, political communication, or related fields, preferably in Palestine and Israel or the wider Middle East context.
Strong understanding of the political and social context in Palestine and Israel, including the dynamics affecting civil society, civic space, and non-violent civic engagement.
Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with the ability to analyse complex political contexts, design context-sensitive interventions, and translate political analysis into strategic programme approaches.
Strong writing and communication skills, including experience developing advocacy and communication materials for different audiences.
Excellent interpersonal and facilitation skills, with ability to build trust-based relationships with diverse civil society actors, strengthen their advocacy capacities, and work sensitively in a highly polarized environment.
Ability to work independently, take initiative, and connect programme realities with advocacy opportunities.
Fluency in German, excellent command of English; Proficiency in Arabic and/or Hebrew is an advantage.
Our offer
We offer an attractive position for a minimum of two years in a mission-driven organisation.
As the position is based on the German Development Aid Workers Act (EhfG) , it is open for non-Palestinian and non-Israeli nationals only. The position is remunerated according to the provisions of this law, including comprehensive social security benefits and financial reintegration assistance upon return.
We also offer participation in qualification and professional development courses (among others, at our Academy for Conflict Transformation), a project-based preparation, and regular coaching.
Start of assignment : Ideally, you are available to start working on 1st November 2026 .
Your application
Please apply online (motivation letter, CV and contact details of 2-3 persons who may provide personal references, all in English) latest by 6 September 2026.

פעולה להתנדב לתרום דף הבית / דרושים / אחראי/ת משמרת למוקד גיוס התרומות משרה מס׳ 892637 אחראי/ת משמרת למוקד גיוס התרומות מטה, ת"א | משרה מלאה על המשרה על ארגון לתת לארגון לתת הפועל לצמצום העוני בישראל באמצעות גיוס כספים והצלת מזון דרוש/ה אחראי משמרת תותח/ית למוקד גיוס התרומות שלנו.   התפקיד כולל: אחריות על ניהול המשמרת והתפעול השוטף של המוקד. מעקב אחר תפוקות והנעת הצוות ליעדיו ולמטרותיו. חניכה, הדרכה , שימור וטיפוח הנציגים. פיתוח כלי הדרכה וחפיפה. אחריות על שיבוץ נציגים והפקת דוחות יומיים. קיום תדריכי משמרת ליצירת מיקוד, מחויבות ומוטיבציות נדרשות. דרישות התפקיד: ניסיון כנציג/ה בכיר/ה או כאחמ"ש/ית במוקד גדול של לפחות 3-4 שנים – חובה! רצון וזיקה לעבודה בארגון חברתי. שליטה בסביבת עבודה ממוחשבת. אסרטיביות ומכוונות ליעדים. יחסי אנוש מעולים. ארגון לתת נוסד במטרה לפעול לצמצום העוני למען יצירת חברה צודקת וטובה יותר, על ידי: סיוע לאכלוסיות במצקוה על בסיס אוניברסלי, הנעת החברה האזרחית לערבות הדדית ונתינה והובלת שינוי בסדר העדיפויות הלאומי. אנחנו ארגון הגג ובנק המזון המוביל בישראל ומקיימים שותפות עם 210 עמותות וארגונים מקומיים, מפעילים 40,000 מתנדבים בכל שנה ומסייעים ל-100,000 משפחות ו-1,700 ניצולי שואה וקשישים נזקקים באופן קבוע. להיות ישראלי זה לתת, כבר שלושה עשורים לתת זה לקום בבוקר כדי לעשות שינוי וליצור השפעה חברתית, לעזור באופן מיידי ויומיומי, בשגרה ובחירום, לאוכלוסיות נזקקות ולפעול למען עתיד טוב יותר. מה שהפך אותנו למי שאנחנו זו הרוח הלתתית, זו שמנחה אותנו לחתור קדימה, להיענות לכל אתגר ולפעול בנחישות תוך תחושת שליחות. הקמנו את לתת ב-1996, כארגון הסיוע ההומניטרי הראשון מסוגו בישראל ומאז עיצבנו את העשייה בתחום המאבק בעוני מתוך אמונה בכוחה של סולידריות. חידשנו את השאיפה לבסס את זהותה של החברה הישראלית על ערכים של ערבות הדדית ונתינה, הנחנו תשתיות של עשייה הומניטרית אפקטיבית וחדשנית ופיתחנו את החינוך להתנדבות כדרך חיים. עם השנים הפכנו לארגון מוביל ומשפיע שפועל על פי אמות מידה של מצוינות, אחריות חברתית, שקיפות, יעילות, מחקר ולמידה. בזכות צוות מקצועי ומסור, אלפי מתנדבים ומאות שותפים לדרך, אנחנו יוצרים שינוי שמתחיל בחיי היומיום של הזקוקים לכך ומגיע עד למקבלי ההחלטות, בדרך ליצירת חברה צודקת וטובה יותר. מחכים לשמוע ממך מרגיש לך שזה יכול להתאים? נשמח להכיר שם פרטי* (חובה) שם משפחה* (חובה) מס' נייד* (חובה) מייל* (חובה) קורות חיים* (חובה) Max. file size: 3 GB. כמה מילים על עצמך (אופציונלי) *רק פניות מתאימות ייענו הגשת מועמדות רוצה להתחבר לעשיה? מייל ויוצאים לדרך להיות ישראלי זה לתת *6833 הדרך שלך לתת לתרום להתנדב לשתף פעולה לתת קצת עלינו שותפים לדרך צור קשר בקשה לקבלת סיוע שקיפות כספית העשייה שלנו לתת ביטחון תזונתי הצלת מזון לתת סיוע לחיים נוער לתת שינוי מדיניות לתת בחירום קריירה בלתת לכל המשרות הפתוחות להיות ישראלי זה לתת *6833 תרומה מוכרת לצרכי מס חומה ומגדל 2, ת.ד 20606 6120601 ת"א מעגלים כסף קטן ועושים הבדל ענק! חומה ומגדל 2, ת.ד 20606 6120601 ת"א תרומה מוכרת לצרכי מס מעגלים לטובת לתת תנאי שימוש הצהרת נגישות crafted by: Layer.co.il Latet (לתת), Israel's largest NGO fighting poverty and food insecurity, is seeking a talented, driven professional to serve as Director of International Development. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing, high-performing department that has consistently exceeded its goals and is constantly evolving and expanding. As we grow our international presence and deepen our global partnerships, we are looking for someone with strong leadership skills and a proven track record in business development, sales, or entrepreneurship—experience in the nonprofit world is welcomed but not required. We believe that the skills required to lead successful fundraising efforts—strategic thinking, relationship building, and persuasive communication—are shared across sectors. If you bring these qualities, and you’re passionate about creating social impact, we encourage you to apply.   Fundraising & Donor Relations Manage & meet annual fundraising goals. Manage relationships with existing partners, including private donors, foundations, Jewish federations, and corporate sponsors. Identify and engage new funding opportunities in international markets. Draft compelling proposals and reports for foundations, federations, and individual donors. Oversee donor stewardship and impact reporting. Strategic Development & Leadership Develop and implement an annual fundraising work plan with clear goals and objectives. Supervise all fundraising activities within the international development department. Lead marketing and digital fundraising campaigns targeting overseas audiences. Host and manage delegations from abroad, strengthening ties with international partners. Team Management & Collaborations Supervise and mentor a team of 4-5 staff members in the resource development department. Coordinate with Latet’s local and international teams to align fundraising strategies with organizational priorities. High analytical abilities and Excel proficiency Professionalism, attention to details, sensitivity, and excellent people skills. Experience of working with graphic design tools – an advantage. Legit Security.description:
Description
About Legit Security
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in software security — how to make AI-first organizations release applications securely, leveraging AI agents to create secure code from the start, and fix vulnerabilities automatically. In a world where attackers leverage AI to exploit software in minutes, this becomes a must-have capability for every organization.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who doesn't just manage- they lead, own, and win. Someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp strategic thinking, and who knows how to turn customer pain into product that matters.
What you'll own
Take full ownership of product domains, from strategy to feature definition to delivery, driving growth and ensuring impactful results.
Engage directly with customers to deeply understand their needs and pain points and translate to actionable tasks
Define product features, backlogs, and roadmaps, collaborating closely with UX, design, and R&D with the power to build some of it yourself.
Communicate effectively and create alignment across sales, marketing, customer success, support, and R&D.
Requirements
What you’ll bring
A high-performing leader who owns their domain and gets things done
3–4 years of experience as a software developer or engineering team lead — experience in both is a significant advantage.
2–3 years of proven product management experience, particularly with enterprise B2B products.
Strong software engineering or DevOps background.
“Builder” mindset – come to build the product with us. Leverage AI to bypass blockers and lead with example.
Fluent English with outstanding communication and presentation skills.
Core product skills we value
Leader / Founder mindset
Hungry to win- energetic and pushing with ambition to make things happen
Strategic and first principal thinking
Presentation skills
Legit Security.title: Product Manager

Legit Security.description:
Description
About Legit Security
Legit Security is a well-funded cybersecurity company backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in application security. We help AI-first organizations release software fast, without security slowing them down, by leveraging AI agents to secure code and remediate vulnerabilities automatically. We're leading a new era of AppSec, built for a world where AI writes the code.
﻿About the Role
We're looking for a driven, enterprise-focused Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just close them. You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, targeting security and development leaders at enterprise accounts across the US. If you thrive in fast-moving environments and know how to navigate a technical buyer, we'd love to meet you.
﻿ You Are
A pipeline builder. You proactively create opportunities through outbound, your network, and market knowledge.
A solution seller. You understand customer challenges and know how to map our platform to real business outcomes.
A strong communicator at the C-level- CISOs, VPs of AppSec, and DevSecOps leaders are your primary targets.
Persistent and process-driven. You can find, navigate, and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
A team player. Comfortable collaborating across sales, marketing, and customer success in a fast-moving startup.
Proficient with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, Salesforce, SalesLoft, and Clari.
Requirements
10+ years of sales experience, predominantly in SaaS solution selling to enterprise and larger mid-market accounts.
Strong background in cybersecurity sales- AppSec or DevSecOps experience is a significant advantage.
A network of CISOs, Directors of Application Security, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
Proven track record of overachievement in previous roles.
﻿Work Model
Remote - West Coast - USA
Sound like you? Give us a ping 🤙
Legit Security.title: Security Team Analyst Lead

Legit Security.description:
Description
Legit Security is looking for an experienced security leader to build and lead our Security Analyst team — the people who turn the latest threats, frameworks, and data into detections, fixes, content, and insights inside our product and for the industry
About Us
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs. Our mission is to solve some of the most challenging problems in software security – how to make organizations build with AI fast, and stay secure, especially against the rising threats from supply chain attacks. Our solution provides full management from AI-generated code to deployment – helping customers analyze their software risk, fix it with agents and secure code during generation.
We are in a fast-growing new space and work hard to become the leader.
What you'll own
Own the business of security analysis in Legit – owning the quality and content of our risk detection, threat intelligence feed and security-matter-expertise.
Manage the team — set the bar for the work, coach analysts day-to-day, and own their development and performance.
Own the team's roadmap together with engineering, product and marketing: prioritize and bring initiatives to promote your business.
Be the focal point to lead Legit's response to global incidents in supply chain and application security — decide how the team reacts, what ships into the product, and what we publish externally.
Own the quality and voice of the team's security content — guides, remediation steps, in-product insights, blogs and social publications — and represent Legit as a thought leader in the space.
Partner with customers and field teams on high-stakes analyses of customer data and environments; present findings to security leaders and use those engagements to sharpen the team's focus.
Requirements
﻿What you’ll bring
﻿ Has experience leading a security research, detection or analyst team
Has deep hands-on background in cybersecurity or application security or supply chain security or a closely related domain.
Has some development experience (can be AI-based), and is comfortable with modern development workflows.
Knows how to balance speed and rigor — and how to make that trade-off legible to a team under incident pressure.
Writing and speaking skills in English enough to represent Legit publicly: customer executives, webcasts, blogs and social platforms.
If you think you are "Legit”, let's talk

Lema AI.description:
Description
We are
Lema AI is a fast-growing, venture-backed B2B SaaS company on a mission to ensure modern businesses never fail because of a third-party incident. We’re reimagining the stagnant Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and cyber resilience space by moving companies from reactive compliance to proactive, real-time risk prevention powered by advanced AI.
Already trusted by industry-leading enterprises, Lema is entering a phase of hypergrowth. We’re tripling our team as we build a category-defining platform, guided by a culture of radical ownership, transparency, and fast, cross-functional execution. If you thrive in high-context, high-impact environments, you’ll feel at home here.
More about Lema:
Lema.ai website
Business Insider - Cybersecurity startup Lema has come out of stealth to raise $24 million
Team8 - Why We Invested In Lema
About the TPRM market:
McKinsey - nearly one-third of recent cyber breaches originated from third parties
Hitch Partners - Third-party risk dominates security priorities, with AI-enhanced attacks and cloud misconfigurations completing the top three concerns.
About The Role
We’re looking for a a senior backend engineer with 6+ years of experience, playing a key role in building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up. As part of the company’s early engineering team, you’ll help shape both the product and the engineering culture, own backend architecture, lead end-to-end feature development, and drive technical excellence while collaborating closely with product, design, and infrastructure in a fast-growing environment.
What You’ll Do
Be one of our first 10 engineers, shaping both our product and our engineering culture.
Define and evolve the backend architecture, infrastructure and development best practices for a fast-growing team.
Own features end-to-end - from concept and design discussions to implementation, deployment and observability.
Solve complex challenges in distributed systems, event-driven architectures and real-time data pipelines.
Continuously improve developer workflows - identify friction, integrate new tools, automate repetitive tasks and champion engineering excellence.
Lead and mentor a small team of engineers: drive planning, break down work, ensure quality delivery and help hire exceptional talent.
Collaborate with experienced peers - engineers, PMs and designers - who’ve built large-scale systems at top-tier companies.
Here are some of the technologies we work with: Golang, Python, Protobuf, React, Typescript, Kafka, Postgresql, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS
Requirements
What You Bring
A seasoned backend engineer (6+ years) who thrives on building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up.
Experienced in designing and scaling modern microservices architectures (both BE and FE integration).
Capable of taking complex features from design to deployment, owning every stage of the backend lifecycle - while guiding others to do the same.
Pragmatic about code quality: confident refactoring, simplifying and deleting code when needed.
Comfortable leading code reviews, defining engineering standards and collaborating across product, design and infrastructure.
Why Join Lema AI
Impact: Build a category-defining platform that safeguards how modern businesses operate.
Ownership: Join a culture that gives you full context, autonomy, and trust to drive outcomes.
Compensation & Benefits: Competitive salary, equity package, and additional perks
Velocity: Work with exceptional peers in a high-energy, low-bureaucracy environment.
Growth: Shape a company that’s scaling rapidly, backed by Tier 1 investors and visionary customers.

Lightbits Labs.description:
In this role, you will work at the intersection of CUDA, GPU architecture, transformer inference, Rust systems programming, and large-scale AI serving platforms. You will design and build systems that intelligently manage KV cache placement across GPU, CPU, storage, and remote memory tiers while maximizing throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing infrastructure costs. This is a highly hands-on position for someone who enjoys solving deep performance challenges, optimizing every layer of the inference stack, and turning low-level innovations into customer-facing product value. Position based in Israel.
Responsibilities
Design and implement KV cache offloading, streaming, and memory management infrastructure for large-scale LLM serving.
Build cache-aware scheduling systems that determine when to keep, evict, prefetch, stream, compress, decompress, or recompute KV cache blocks.
Optimize inference runtimes such as vLLM and SGLang, including paged attention, prefix caching, schedulers, and cache management systems.
Develop mechanisms that overlap IO operations with attention execution to maximize GPU utilization and minimize latency.
Build high-performance components in Rust, C++, and CUDA for scheduling, cache coordination, telemetry, and inference optimization.
Profile and eliminate bottlenecks across GPU, CPU, memory, networking, storage, and runtime layers.
Design benchmark frameworks and performance tests for long-context, streaming, multi-turn, and high-concurrency workloads.
Measure and improve key inference metrics including TTFT, TBT/ITL, GPU utilization, cache hit rates, and cost per token.
Collaborate closely with Product, Platform, ML, and Engineering teams to deliver production-ready optimization capabilities.
Desired Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with CUDA programming and GPU performance optimization.
Deep understanding of transformer inference, attention mechanisms, KV cache architecture, batching, streaming generation, prefill, and decode.
Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or similar LLM serving frameworks.
Experience designing or optimizing KV cache systems, including cache reuse, eviction, prefix caching, radix caching, or cache offloading.
Strong systems programming skills in Rust, C++, or both.
Strong Python skills for experimentation, benchmarking, and performance analysis.
Experience building performance-sensitive schedulers, async IO systems, or distributed infrastructure.
Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as Nsight, CUDA profiling tools, or custom telemetry systems.
Experience with GPUDirect, RDMA, NVMe, cache compression, FlashAttention, paged attention, or distributed inference architectures is a strong advantage.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Lynxight.title: Senior Full Stack Developer

Lynxight.description:
As a Senior Algorithm Developer, you will own the core AI and computer-vision algorithms behind Lynxight's products: swimmer detection and segmentation, multi-camera tracking, distress detection, and camera calibration — from research through to real-time production on edge and cloud. You will work closely with software, product, QA, and field deployment teams, and mentor others as we grow.
What You'll Do
Design, train, and deploy deep-learning models for swimmer detection, segmentation, and behavior analysis.
Develop distress-detection and multi-camera tracking / identity-association algorithms.
Work on 3D vision — camera calibration, multi-view geometry, and pose estimation in challenging pool environments.
Optimize algorithms for real-time inference on edge and cloud (GPU utilization, memory, latency).Drive deployment, monitoring, debugging, and performance investigations end-to-end.
Research, evaluate, and integrate state-of-the-art AI, machine learning, and computer vision technologies to continuously improve our products and development processes.
Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, foundation models, vision models, and developer tools, and identify opportunities to apply them to real-world products.
Requirements
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, with a strong foundation in linear algebra, probability and statistics, optimization, and geometry / multi-view vision - A Must
5+ years developing computer-vision and machine-learning algorithms - A Must
Proven track record delivering ML solutions to production - A Must
Expert-level Python; strong experience with PyTorch - A Must
Object detection, segmentation, and tracking systems.
Solid ML fundamentals and model evaluation.Linux development environments.
Version control and CI/CD workflows.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) and agentic patterns (LLMs, MCP services, context engineering, memory, etc.) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate development, improve code quality, and solve complex problems.
Self-motivated and able to drive tasks independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
Thrives on tackling complex technical challenges and delivering practical, high-quality solutions.
Apply Now

MAX Security.description:
In this role, you’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Senior Analysts and the Protective Intelligence Directors. You’ll have the opportunity to engage with our portfolio of blue-chip clients, including some of the most recognizable names in the Fortune 100. This position offers the opportunity to make a significant impact by safeguarding the interests of global leaders and high-net-worth individuals.
What You’ll Do:
Scan and research online-based or originated threats.
Assess risk and present findings for a variety of clients.
Design threat monitoring plans.
Requirements
What You’ll Bring:
English with a very high level of fluency suitable for all audiences
Practical experience with OSINT, WEBINT, web investigations, online due diligence, and social media monitoring – either military, private or public sector.
Knowledge of open-source research methodologies (e.g. Boolean logic) and environments (including forums, message boards etc.), as well as web intelligence techniques (including deep and dark), link analysis, data mining, and other online intelligence tools.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail.
Highly motivated to contribute and grow within a fast-paced and demanding working environment.
Additional Preferred Qualification:
Native-level German proficiency (spoken and written)
﻿ Academic degree in geopolitics, international relations, journalism, criminology, forensics sciences (preferably: cyber/digital), or related domains.

מקומכם אתנו. הצטרפו למשפחה. תחושת משמעות, שליחות וסיפוק נמצאות בכל רובדי העשייה שלנו אם הגעתם לכאן, אין ספק שבריאות נמצאת בראש סדר העדיפויות שלכם, במיוחד כשמדובר בשיפור חייהם של אחרים. אם אתם מחפשים גאווה, משמעות וסיפוק בעבודה שלכם, תהיו בטוחים שהגעתם למקום הנכון. כי הכול מתחיל בעובדים שלנו: הרופאים, המטפלים, הצוותים הפארא-רפואיים והמנהלים במכבי הם שעושים את הארגון למה שהוא – ארגון הבריאות המוביל בישראל. ככזה, ליווי, תמיכה ומקצועיות הם עמודי התווך של העשייה שלנו, בכל דרך ובכל זמן, בין אם בשגרה או במקומות הקשים ביותר. איתנו תזכו להיות עבור המבוטחים ועבורכם – בתחושת השליחות החזקה ביותר. ההתפתחות שלכם בעבודה היא המקצועיות וההצלחה שלנו אנחנו מאמינים ששירות מעולה ומקצועי מתחיל מתחושת הסיפוק שלכם בעבודה. לכן, יוזמה, מחקר וטכנולוגיות חדישות הם חלק בלתי נפרד מהיום-יום שלנו, תוך מתן שירותי רפואה קליניים ודיגיטליים משני חיים. כעובדי מכבי, יהיה לכם מקום לגשת לכל מבוטח ומבוטחת בדרך המתאימה עבורכם, להשמיע את הקול שלכם, לממש רעיונות חדשניים ויצירתיים ובעיקר – לעשות את ההבדל, לבוא לידי ביטוי, להתקדם ולהשפיע. בכל המסדרונות שלנו נושבת רוח מכבי וגאוות יחידה זה לא רק מקום עבודה - זו קהילה שעובדת, מדברת ופועלת בגובה העיניים. אנחנו ארגון אנושי, עם מגוון בעלי ובעלות תפקידים שונים שמרגישים כולם חיבור ושייכות, שיתוף פעולה, ערבות וכבוד הדדי. יחד, אנחנו מאפשרים את איכות הרפואה הטובה ביותר בארץ כארגון המוביל את שירותי הרפואה בישראל, העובדים במכבי הם חלק ממותג חזק, צעיר, יציב, מקצועי ומתקדם, הנמצא בצמיחה מתמדת בפריסה ארצית. מוכנים גם אתם להתחיל להוביל? הצטרפו אלינו ותיהנו מעצמאות רפואית, מהגבוהות בארץ, ומכלים מתקדמים, שיאפשרו לכם להעניק טיפול ברמה מצוינת: פחות בירוקרטיה, יותר השקעה בליבת העבודה, חדשנות וטכנולוגיה; לא רק אימוץ הרעיונות שלכם, אלא גם סיפוק כל הכלים הדרושים ליישם אותם ולממש את עצמכם; סביבת עבודה תומכת, שיתופית ופתוחה; איזון ברור בין הבית לעבודה כערך מהותי. נשמע לכם טוב? הצטרפו אלינו! אנו תמיד שמחים לצרף אלינו אנשים אכפתיים, חיוביים ופרואקטיביים, שחושבים בגדול, נחושים להצליח, לא פוחדים מאתגרים ואוהבים לאהוב את העבודה שלהם. נשמע טוב מדי? היכנסו לראות מה העובדים מספרים על הקהילה שלנו: בפייסבוק האנשים של מכבי ועכשיו גם בpeople of maccabi בלינקדאין Maccabi Health care Services בעמוד הפודקסטים שלנו שליחות שמתחילה באנשים דואגים לך ולמשפחתך מכסות חופשה וימי בחירה האיזון בין הבית לעבודה חשוב ומהותי! לכן, מכסות החופשה במכבי גבוהות משמעותית מהמקובל: 22 ימי חופשה בשנה, החל משנת העבודה הראשונה. לאחר 10 שנות וותק במכבי מתווספים 2 ימי חופשה נוספים - 24 ימי חופשה. מפרגנים לכם יותר: זכאות לשני ימי בחירה בשנה (בשנה הראשונה: תלוי במועד תחילת עבודתו) זכאות לחופשה מיוחדת לרגל אירועים משפחתיים כמו חתונה או נישואי הילדים בחוה"מ סוכות ופסח עובדים רק 2/3 מתקן יומי במכבי – זה אתם במרכז. כעובדים, אתם זוכים, לא רק לעבוד בארגון הבריאות המוביל בישראל, אלא גם לכיסוי רחב של הטבות, זכויות סוציאליות ותנאי העסקה נלווים לשכר, בהתאמה לאורח ומצב החיים שלכם ושל משפחתכם. במקרים רבים, מעבר למחויב על פי חוק*. ימי מחלה זכאות ל-עד 12 ימי מחלת ילד בשנה: ילד אחד- 8 ימים בשנה 2 ילדים – 10 ימים 3 ומעלה – 12 ימים רק שיהיו לנו בריאים. שעות נוספות מי סופר? אנחנו! החלק מהדקה הראשונה שלאחר השלמת תקן השעות היומי, ואפילו ביום פנוי - תקבלו תשלום על כל השעות בהם הגעתם לעבודה מעבר לתקן. עובדים במשרה חלקית? אתם זכאים להטבה נוספת, לפיה שעות עודפות (השעות הנוספות עד להשלמת תקן משרה מלאה) משולמות בתעריף של 125% ולא בתערי

Majestic Labs ai.description:
Description
About Majestic Labs
Majestic Labs is a deep-tech pioneer re-architecting AI systems for the data center to systematically dismantle the industry's most critical barrier: the "memory wall." Backed by a $100 million Series A closed in late 2025.
We’re a fast-moving AI startup building next-generation infrastructure for the world’s most demanding AI workloads. Our mission is to accelerate the future of intelligence by delivering cutting-edge server solutions optimized for large-scale inference and training. Backed by top-tier investors and led by industry veterans, we’re scaling rapidly and looking for a dynamic partnerships leader to help us win the trust of enterprise and hyperscaler customers.
We are a US-Israeli company looking for builders-engineers and operators who have shipped production hardware and know the crucial difference between compelling research and systems that operate at massive scale.
If you want to build infrastructure that fundamentally changes what the world can accomplish with AI, come join us!
About the position
Design and implement high-performance compute kernels for AI primitives such as GEMM, attention, normalization, and convolution.
Optimize for throughput, latency, and memory hierarchy across heterogeneous compute units (SIMD, matrix engines, DMA).
Collaborate with compiler and runtime teams to integrate kernels into Triton and PyTorch pipelines.
Profile and tune kernels using tools like Perfetto, VTune, Tracy, Nsight, or custom simulators.
Prototype and evaluate precision formats (FP16/BF16/FP8/e5m2, MXFP/FP4, etc.).
Contribute to micro-architecture feedback loops, helping co-design ISA and memory features with the hardware team.
Requirements
Degree at any level in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field from a recognized university.
Strong background in parallel programming (CUDA, Triton, RISC-V Vector (RVV), POSIX Threads, or OpenMP).
Deep understanding of memory layout, vectorization, thread/block scheduling, and cache behavior.
Experience programming wide-SIMD vector units and matrix/systolic engines.
Familiarity with the parallel-computing ecosystem and its high-performance libraries and
primitives, such as BLAS/BLIS, dense linear algebra, and parallel scan/reduce/sort.
Skilled in performance analysis and parallel debugging using tools such as GNU Debugger and Nsight.
Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing compute or AI workloads (e.g., GEMM, softmax, attention).
Solid grasp of numerical stability, precision formats, and mixed precision arithmetic.
Proficiency in C++17 or higher, with strong knowledge of standard algorithms, data structures, and generic programming paradigms.
Collaborative work style with the ability to operate effectively in multicultural, cross-disciplinary environments.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with optimization of irregular algorithms, such as graph computations or sparse
numerical linear algebra, combining high-level data structure design with low-level SIMD and synchronization optimizations.
Familiarity with LLVM/MLIR.
RISC-V systems or bare-metal programming, including RISC-V vector and matrix extensions.
We seek smart, curious, self-driven individuals who enjoy creative problem-solving and continuous learning. Even if you don't meet all requirements, we'd love to hear from you if you have the mindset to tackle complex challenges.
Majestic Labs is an equal opportunity employer deeply committed to diversity of background and thought. If you are ready to dare greatly, learn from mistakes, engage in vigorous debates, and help create a step-function shift in human technical capability, we want to meet you!

About Majestic Labs
We’re a fast-moving, US-Israeli AI startup building next-generation infrastructure for the world’s most demanding AI workloads. Our mission is to accelerate the future of intelligence and make it ubiquitously accessible by delivering full stack custom AI servers optimized for large-scale inference and training.
Backed by top-tier investors and led by industry veterans, we’re scaling rapidly. We seek forward-thinking engineers and operators who thrive in a collaborative environment and excel at solving complex challenges from first principles. If you want to build infrastructure that fundamentally changes what the world can accomplish with AI, come join us!
About the position
We are seeking an experienced SoC Architect – AI Acceleration (RISC-V and Compute Cluster Development) to lead the architecture and integration of Majestic’s compute subsystem.
In this role, you will define and optimize the RISC-V–based compute clusters, vector engines, and shared memory structures that power high-performance AI workloads.
You’ll collaborate closely with design, verification, compiler, and ML software teams to define architectures that maximize performance per watt while ensuring scalability across multiple generations of silicon.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an architect who thrives at the intersection of hardware design, parallel compute, and AI acceleration.
Responsibilities
Architect and define RISC-V compute clusters, including multi-core integration, interconnects, and memory subsystems.
Design matrix multiplication and vector processing engines optimized for neural network and ML kernels.
Define the ISA extensions, microarchitecture, and system-level interfaces supporting AI acceleration.
Develop strategies for compute task mapping, thread scheduling, and shared cache (L3) utilization.
Collaborate with compiler and ML runtime teams to ensure software–hardware co-optimization.
Evaluate performance and power trade-offs across workloads using simulation and modeling.
Define debug, trace, and performance-monitoring features at the compute-subsystem level.
Work with SoC, memory, and I/O architects to ensure cohesive dataflow and system efficiency.
Provide specifications and technical guidance for RTL, verification, and firmware implementation teams.
Requirements
Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of experience in SoC or compute architecture, with a focus on AI acceleration or high-performance compute.
Deep understanding of RISC-V architecture, vector extensions, and parallel compute design.
Experience with multi-core cluster integration, shared memory hierarchies, and cache coherency protocols.
Familiarity with matrix multiplication engines, SIMD/vector processors, and AI kernel optimization.
Strong background in embedded systems architecture, system-level performance modeling, and debug methodologies.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing custom RISC-V ISA extensions or AI-specific compute units.
Hands-on work in neural network mapping, tiling, and kernel scheduling.
Familiarity with AXI, UALINK, HBM, or chiplet-based architectures for scalable AI compute.
Contributions to open-source RISC-V or AI compute frameworks.
Proven success in first-silicon AI or HPC SoC programs.
Understanding of compiler design and low-level ML operator optimization.
We seek smart, curious, self-driven individuals who enjoy creative problem-solving and continuous learning. Even if you don't meet all requirements, we'd love to hear from you if you have the mindset to tackle complex challenges.
