Tomorrow.io.description:
Tomorrow.io's Engineering department is focused on building life-changing software and products at scale, from infrastructure that handles massive amounts of data to outstanding customer-centric user experiences in B2B, B2C and B2D products that change billions of lives worldwide.
We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to power the reliability, security, and efficiency of the world's most impactful weather platform. You'll build self-service platforms that give developers and weather scientists true independence, weave AI into how we operate, and work side-by-side with R&D to push performance and scale further. You'll evolve our cloud infrastructure to match the pace of the business, hold the line on cost, and stay close to production through on-call. The people who thrive here bring a product mindset, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and leave the people and systems around them better than they found them.
As a DevOps Engineer at Tomorrow.io, you'll:
Evolve and maintain our cloud infrastructure, delivery and observability - and the self-service platforms above them - so they serve our business strategy and let scientists and developers work on their own as we grow at scale Develop and adopt tools, with AI at the center, that make development and operations processes measurably more efficient Partner with the engineering teams behind the Tomorrow.io platform and its API to improve service performance, reliability, scale, security and cost Keep production available to its SLOs - taking your turn on the on-call rotation and following each incident through to whatever stops it from happening again Work as part of the team: share what you know, learn from the people around you, and help us keep improving how we work together
What you bring:
4+ years as a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, including 2+ years hands-on with a major cloud (GCP, AWS or Azure) and with IaC such as Terraform (Crossplane or another Kubernetes-native approach is a plus)
Production Kubernetes depth - containerized deployments, scheduling, resource management and real troubleshooting - plus CI/CD pipelines you've built and owned end to end with modern tooling and advanced deployment methodologies
Experience implementing and customizing monitoring and observability systems (Datadog, Grafana + Loki, Prometheus, ELK)
Software engineering craft and the judgment to review, debug and improve what an agent produces
Hands-on use of AI tooling in your engineering work - shaping and extending it (agents, rules, integrations), not only consuming it
A product mindset and a deep sense of responsibility for service reliability: you build internal tools from developer feedback, measure success with clear metrics and KPIs, and treat production as yours to care for Curiosity, adaptability and a bias for action in a high-velocity, changing environment - with communication that connects infrastructure work to business impact and brings R&D stakeholders together around shared goals
Our stack: GCP (primary), Azure and AWS · Linux · Kubernetes on GKE and AKS with Helm, KEDA, Argo Workflows and External Secrets · Cloud Run and Cloud Functions · Terraform and Crossplane · GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (GitOps) · Datadog, Grafana + Loki · PostgreSQL/PostGIS, MongoDB Atlas, Redis · Pub/Sub · GCS and S3 · Cloudflare, Kong Gateway, Google LB, CloudFront · Python and Go, with Node.js + React on the frontend.
So if you're passionate about optimizing development processes and curious about how systems work behind the scenes, if continuous improvement is a way of life and automation is your tool of choice, this is the place for you. You'll help teams deliver faster and more safely, working with some of the sharpest minds in the industry on complex, high-scale problems, as we build the world's most trusted weather platform for millions of people every day. You'll grow quickly here, in both technical depth and responsibility, in a culture where engineers truly care for their production workloads end to end.
If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. Tomorrow.io is on a mission to build a special company. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.
___________________________________________________________________________________________
About tomorrow.io:
Selected by TIME Magazine as one of the Top 100 Most Influential Companies in the World, Tomorrow.io is the world's leading Resilience Platform™. Combining next-generation space technology, advanced generative AI, and proprietary weather modeling, Tomorrow.io delivers unmatched forecasting and decision-making capabilities. Trusted by six of the top ten Fortune 500 companies, Tomorrow.io empowers organizations to proactively manage weather-related risks, opportunities, and enhance operational efficiency. From cutting-edge weather intelligence to real-time early warning systems, Tomorrow.io enables predictive, impact-based action for a safer, more resilient future. Learn more at Tomorrow.io.
Ethos: Our ethos guides us in everything we do - The people of Tomorrow are here to make an impact, they show true grit, and always put people first.
How we roll: We work in an “one office” environment. We believe that magic happens when people work together. Together also includes Zoom meetings, flexible hours and unlimited vacation days. Your success is achieved by your impact and deliveries and not by the hours you put in. We believe in transparency and directness, putting work before ego and empathy. We grow fast and move faster but we always see people first. Each person has their own career growth path for we believe that the only way for the company to grow is if you grow.

Twine Security.description:
About the Role:
We're looking for a Product Manager to own the operational efficiency aspect of the platform end to end. This is both a strategy and an execution role: you'll decide what execution responsibilities the product would expand to and be in the details with engineering and design shipping it. The hard part isn't building a workflow - it's knowing which work a customer will genuinely hand to an agent, and what has to be true before they will.
What You'll Do:
Define human and agent interaction models: Shape how users collaborate with AI agents, from user initiated queries and agent driven outreach to seamless side by side execution.
Lead agentic ticket resolution and IAM automation : Own the end to end product strategy for identity tasks, including provisioning and deprovisioning, entitlement changes, plus joiner, mover, and leaver workflows.
Own the agentic execution layer: Spec the core product rails for executing actions in customer environments, including human approval flows, risk controls, and confidence building mechanisms.
Drive field to roadmap feedback loops: Partner closely with customer facing and POC teams to translate real world edge cases and customer insights into scalable roadmap features.
Requirements:
2+ years building or owning products where the deliverable is work getting done - workflow automation, ITSM, orchestration, ops tooling, RPA. Something with queues, approvals, handoffs, and a human on the other end who either trusts the system or works around it.
Experience with agentic AI or LLM-based system s - particularly human-in-the-loop design and how agents hold up their end of a conversation with a person
Enough security fluency to make access decisions responsibly, or the appetite to build it fast. You don't need years in the industry, but you'll be making calls about access and permissions and you can't be squeamish about the stakes.
You're comfortable in the details. You'll spec approval flows and escalation logic with engineering and design, define what "resolved" means precisely enough to measure, and write requirements precise enough to build from.
Nice to Have:
Background in IAM, IGA, or PAM - you know what an entitlement, a group, and a joiner-mover-leaver process actually are
Cybersecurity experience more broadly, in any function
Experience working with customer-facing or POC teams, turning field signal into roadmap
Intertwine your future with ours!
At Twine, we're dedicated to fast, informed decisions and transparent collaboration, tackling some of the cyber industry’s most complex challenges. With passion and expertise, we build AI digital cybersecurity employees like no other. Join us in addressing the evolving, unparalleled challenge of bridging the cyber execution gap.

Twine Security.description:
About the Role:
You'll own technically difficult problems before the solution is known. Starting with a cybersecurity need, you'll study the domain, frame the technical challenge, investigate possible approaches, and build the solution through production. You'll have access to Twine's shared agent infrastructure, but the role goes far beyond configuring existing components. Many use cases will require new reasoning methods, agent architectures, evaluation techniques, data strategies, or model behavior. This is a role for someone who enjoys applied research but is motivated by outcomes. The goal is not simply to prove that an idea can work, it is to make it useful and reliable for customers.
What You'll Do:
Design and implement AI solutions for complex cybersecurity workflows.
Develop new approaches for agent reasoning, planning, tool use, context management, decision-making, and recovery from failures.
Determine the right technical approach for each problem, combining models, algorithms, data, and conventional software where appropriate.
Define quality for each use case and create evaluations that measure correctness, task completion, consistency, safety, latency, and cost.
Analyze agent behavior deeply, identify the underlying causes of failures, and improve the relevant model, data, tool, or architecture.
Collaborate with cybersecurity experts, product teams, software engineers, and AI infrastructure engineers throughout development.
Requirements:
Excellent software engineering skills and substantial experience with Python.
Hands-on experience building advanced systems with modern language models.
Deep familiarity with several areas relevant to AI agents, such as planning, tool use, retrieval, memory, structured generation, model adaptation, or evaluation.
The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a technical research plan and then into working software.
Strong experimental instincts: you form clear hypotheses, design meaningful tests, and make decisions based on evidence.
Sound judgment about when to use an AI technique and when a deterministic approach is more effective.
Ownership of the complete result, including its behavior after reaching production.
Nice to Have:
Developing autonomous or long-running agents that interact with real systems.
Building evaluation environments, simulations, or benchmarks for complex model behavior.
Experience in cybersecurity, identity, security operations, or enterprise automation.
Applying published research or your own research to production problems.

About the Role:
We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help build the core infrastructure behind Twine's agentic AI system. This is not another workflow tool: we are building something new, in a category that does not really exist yet. You will work on the services, orchestration, integrations, data models, retrieval layers, guardrails, and evaluation infrastructure that let AI agents reason over enterprise context and take reliable action.
This role is deeply product-facing and infrastructure-heavy. Our customers are large enterprises that manage tens of thousands of identities, so the systems we build need to be secure, observable, reliable, and able to operate at real scale.
What You'll Do:
Build production backend services in Python that power Twine's agentic AI platform.
Design and implement AI-agent orchestration, tool-calling infrastructure, workflow execution, guardrails, and evaluation loops.
Integrate with enterprise applications, identity providers, SaaS tools, and customer data sources so agents can understand context and execute tasks safely.
Build systems that ingest, model, and reason over organizational processes, permissions, policies, and internal knowledge.
Solve scale and reliability challenges for large enterprise environments with tens of thousands of identities.
Collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous business processes into reliable automated experiences.
Own reliability, observability, performance, and security for production systems.
Requirements:
5+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
Strong expertise in Python and production service development.
Experience building complex, production-grade backend systems such as APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems, or workflow engines.
Hands-on experience or strong practical familiarity with LLMs, agentic AI, tool calling, RAG, workflow orchestration, or AI infrastructure.
Ability to design systems that use AI safely: validation, guardrails, evaluation, observability, and controlled execution.
Solid understanding of databases, data modeling, and API design.
Comfort working with ambiguous product requirements and turning them into robust technical designs.
Excitement about building a new category and solving problems that do not have off-the-shelf answers.
Nice to Have:
Experience with identity, security, governance, permissions, or enterprise SaaS integrations.
Experience with LLM evaluation, tracing, observability, or production AI systems.
Experience building systems that automate complex operational workflows end-to-end.

Work hands-on with messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and database infrastructure to keep pace with increasing load
Consolidate infrastructure work under one team and bring structure and clear ownership to this core domain.

Partner with engineering teams across the company, but as the clear owner of infrastructure decisions, not just an advisor

Independent, self-driven working style- you take a problem and run with it

You build a team that can independently carry infrastructure work

Senior Technical Marketing Manager
Tel Aviv
· Full-time
About The Position
About The Position
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection.
Upwind is hiring a Senior Technical Marketing Manager to own the technical narrative behind runtime-powered cloud security. This is a hands-on role for someone who is part technologist, part storyteller: comfortable diving deep into architecture, runtime behavior, Kubernetes environments, identity flows, APIs, and kernel-level telemetry, then translating that depth into content that earns trust with engineers and security leaders. You'll think like a security engineer and write like a product marketer, building the technical content, product narratives, launch assets, and enablement materials that explain not just what Upwind does, but how it works and why it's architecturally different. You'll report to the Head of Product Marketing and work closely with Product, Sales Architects, Engineering, and Research to turn complex innovation into market-ready messaging that drives real pipeline impact.
What You'll Do
Own the technical narrative. Partner with Product and Product Marketing to define use cases, and build demo labs and training material for all new features and releases.
Create and execute high-impact technical content, from deep-dive technical blogs and solution guides to architecture explainers and product landing pages that security engineers and cloud teams actually want to read.
Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives across product management, engineering, and field teams for high-impact security use cases.
Translate complex architecture into clear value, turning runtime telemetry, eBPF instrumentation, Kubernetes metadata, identity context, and API flow mapping into differentiated, defensible positioning.
Keep our technical voice sharp: precise, modern, and human, authoritative when discussing architecture, approachable when discussing customer value.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
3-6 years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, solutions engineering, product management, or a related role at an enterprise SaaS company, ideally in cloud security or cloud infrastructure.
Deep curiosity about how things work. You're comfortable reading architecture docs, asking engineers hard questions, and understanding runtime systems at a technical level.
Understanding of the full sales process, from pitch to demo to POC to production.
Strong technical writing skills. You can take complex infrastructure concepts and turn them into structured, compelling narratives without oversimplifying or hiding behind jargon.
Experience marketing to technical audiences. You've written for security engineers, DevOps teams, platform engineers, or CISOs and understand how to earn credibility with them.
A hands-on execution mindset. You don't just define positioning, you write the blog, build the page outline, create the sales asset, and help get it live.
Familiarity with cloud-native environments: Kubernetes, containers, APIs, IAM, vulnerability management, runtime security, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, AI security, or related domains.
Comfort working cross-functionally. You can translate between Engineering, Sales, and Marketing without losing clarity or technical accuracy.
Fluency in modern AI tools.
A data-informed, impact-driven approach. You care about adoption, engagement, and pipeline influence, and you refine messaging based on real feedback from the field.
Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You're energized by building in a fast-moving startup where features ship quickly and messaging evolves alongside the product.

About The Position
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities — including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. We're in a period of significant growth. There's an enormous amount to build, improve, and shape - and every hire changes the trajectory of the company.
About the Role
We're looking for a Talent Network Builder, an experienced, full-cycle recruiter who works differently than most. You don't rely on job boards and cold outreach alone. You've built a real, personal network over the course of your career: people who know you, trust you, and pick up when you call. You bring candidates a level of care and attention that feels more like a trusted advisor than a transactional recruiter. You listen, you follow up, you make people feel genuinely looked after throughout the process.
This role exists because we believe that kind of relationship-driven recruiting, deep networks and high-touch candidate experience, is something we can build inside our own team, instead of outsourcing it to external agencies or headhunters.
What You'll Do
Own full-cycle recruiting for roles across the organization (R&D and beyond): sourcing, screening, interview process management, and closing.
Source proactively across various platforms and tools, blending modern AI-assisted sourcing with your own network and direct outreach.
Lead with relationships: reach candidates through your own professional network, not just inbound applications or cold sourcing.
Give every candidate a high-touch, closely-managed experience: clear communication, real attention, and a process that reflects well on Upwind.
Fully unlock our internal potential: referrals, employee networks, and every internal connection we have, as a real, ongoing source of talent, not an afterthought.
Collaborate closely with recruiters across Israel, EMEA, and APJ, and stay aligned with team goals and standards.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
Must-have
Proven experience in full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, process management, closing.
A real, established professional network built over your career, not just online connections, but relationships people actually respond to.
A relationship-first way of working. You'd rather spend real time getting a placement right than move fast and loose across a large volume.
Comfort and fluency with AI-assisted sourcing tools and modern recruiting technology. You seek these tools out, you don't avoid them.
Nice-to-have
A background that naturally built a strong network, for example a technological military unit, a professional community, or years of activity within a specific industry network.
Prior experience as an external recruiter or headhunter with a track record of network-based, not just inbound, placements.
Deep familiarity with the Israeli hi-tech recruiting landscape.

Description
We are Utila, an enterprise-grade platform that powers digital asset operations for more than 200 global institutions. Our technology secures $15B+ in monthly transaction volume and has protected over $100B to date. Backed by $50M in funding , Utila is growing fast with a rapidly expanding global customer base.
We build mission-critical infrastructure for institutions operating in the digital asset space, where security, reliability, and scale are non-negotiable. Our customers include fintechs, trading firms, payment companies, and enterprises managing large-scale digital asset operations.
This is a revenue-owning IC role within an established EMEA CS team. You’ll own a book of institutional accounts - renewals, expansions, and net-new onboarding and product adoption - and be expected to run the full commercial lifecycle: discovery, negotiation, and close. You’ll coordinate with Tel Aviv-based Product, Sales, and Finance while managing relationships with CFOs, CTOs, and COOs across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities
Commercial Ownership
Run end-to-end commercial cycles: renewal, upsell, and cross-sell from initial stakeholder mapping through signed contract
Manage and forecast a regional ARR book; own churn mitigation and net revenue retention targets
Lead complex multi-stakeholder negotiations - pricing, SLAs, contract terms - with C-suite counterparts
Conduct build-vs-buy analysis conversations with technically sophisticated clients evaluating Utila against proprietary alternatives
Identify and size expansion opportunities across the portfolio; build account plans with clear revenue milestones
Strategic Account Management
Own institutional accounts (exchanges, OTC desks, funds, fintechs) from onboarding through multi-year retention
Act as a strategic business advisor to CFOs/CTOs/COOs, translating MPC wallet infrastructure into operational efficiency and competitive advantage
Drive product-led growth through feature adoption, ecosystem management
Collaborate with Tel Aviv-based Support, Product, and Engineering teams; channel EMEA client feedback to influence product roadmap
Requirements
5+ years Customer Success/Technical Account Management in B2B SaaS or fintech; 2+ years in a senior/strategic CSM capacity
Proven commercial & sales track record (required): closed renewals and expansions with documented ARR impact; led C-suite negotiations (CFO, CTO, COO) as primary counterpart; managed complex deal cycles including competitive displacement, build-vs-buy, and multi-product expansion
Crypto-native knowledge (preferred): fluent in custody models, MPC architecture, DeFi, stablecoins, institutional wallet operations, and blockchain transaction flows. Alternatively, Fintech, Financial Services, Cyber Security companies
Technical fluency: able to engage engineering counterparts on API integration in high-level, authorization workflows, and wallet infrastructure without a solutions engineer in the room. Hands-on API proficiency is an advantage
Background at crypto-native or fintech companies strongly preferred; growth-stage team (#50–150) experience valued
EMEA regional experience: business cultures across UK/Europe/Middle East, timezone management, remote-first collaboration. Regulatory knowledge (MiCA, DORA, UAE/Saudi frameworks) a significant advantage
Based in EMEA timezone (Tel Aviv, London, Amsterdam, Dubai, or similar); ~30% travel; English fluency required (additional European languages a plus)
Self-starter and autonomous operator with an ownership mentality; exceptional communication skills across C-suite presentations, demos, and QBRs
This is not a relationship maintenance role. You’re expected to run deals, negotiate contracts, and close - just like any quota-carrying AE. If your CS experience is primarily onboarding and QBR coordination, this isn’t the right fit.

Description
About Us
At Utila, you’ll help build the modern, enterprise-grade platform that powers digital asset operations for more than 200 global institutions. Our technology secures $15B+ in monthly transaction volume and has protected over $100B to date, and we’re growing fast, backed by $50M in funding and a rapidly expanding customer base.
We work on mission-critical systems that demand innovation, precision, and deep technical expertise. If you’re excited by complex challenges, want to work with exceptionally strong teammates, and are looking to make a real impact on the future of financial technology, you’ll feel right at home here.
Join us, and help build something big.
About the Role
﻿ We're looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our Finance team.
As our sole bookkeeper, you will own our day-to-day financial record-keeping end-to-end and be a key part of the finance function as we scale.
Responsibilities
Handle multiple subsidiary bookkeeping, including intercompany transactions.
Support month-end, quarter- end, and year-end close processes
Manage AP- Process invoices, vendor payments, and lead end to end invoice to Pay process
Manage expense reimbursements and travel expenses
Reconcile bank and credit card statements
Process payroll journal and accruals
On going statutory reporting- withholding tax, vat etc.
Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and tax requirements
Maintain organized, audit-ready financial records
Coordinate with external accountants/auditors during tax season and audits
Handle ad hoc cross company projects and tasks
Requirements
Certified bookkeeper (Type 1+2)

This is a **cross-functional, company-wide role**. You won't be embedded in a single product team — instead, you'll partner with every department to identify high-leverage opportunities and build AI-powered tools and workflows that boost productivity and efficiency across the entire organization.
This is a great opportunity to be part of one of the fastest-growing infrastructure companies in history, an organization that is in the center of the hurricane being created by the revolution in artificial intelligence.
"VAST's data management vision is the future of the market."- Forbes
VAST Data is the data platform company for the AI era. We are building the enterprise software infrastructure to capture, catalog, refine, enrich, and protect massive datasets and make them available for real-time data analysis and AI training and inference. Designed from the ground up to make AI simple to deploy and manage, VAST takes the cost and complexity out of deploying enterprise and AI infrastructure across data center, edge, and cloud.
Our success has been built through intense innovation, a customer-first mentality and a team of fearless VASTronauts who leverage their skills & experiences to make real market impact. This is an opportunity to be a key contributor at a pivotal time in our company’s growth and at a pivotal point in computing history.
What You'll Do:
- Design, build, and operate LLM-powered applications, agents, and workflows end-to-end — from prototype to production.
- Architect retrieval, context engineering, and tool-use strategies that make models reliable, accurate, and cost-efficient.
- Integrate LLMs with internal services, third-party APIs, and data stores to automate complex business and engineering workflows.
- Build, evaluate, and continuously improve evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic systems.
- Collaborate closely with product, research, and platform teams to translate ambiguous problems into shipped capabilities.
- Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving LLM ecosystem (models, frameworks, agentic patterns) and bring the best ideas into our stack.
Requirements
﻿ Engineering Foundations:
- Strong Python skills- you write clean, idiomatic, well-tested code and understand the language deeply.
- Hands-on experience using coding agents(Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to build complex software systems. You know how to delegate effectively to AI assistants and review their output critically.
- Experience with multiple database paradigms- both SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, or similar). You can choose the right tool for the job.
- Experience designing and integrating with third-party APIs- REST and gRPC. Comfortable building robust clients, handling auth, retries, rate limits, and schema evolution.
- Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes- containerizing services, writing manifests, and debugging deployments.
- Strong Linux fundamentals- confident in bash and the terminal; you can navigate, script, and troubleshoot a server without reaching for a GUI.
- Experience building cloud-native tools on AWS, GCP, or Azure (compute, storage, queues, serverless, IAM).
AI / LLM Expertise:
- Solid understanding of what an LLM is and how it works- tokenization, attention, context windows, sampling, and the practical implications of each for system design.
- Strong grasp of modern patterns for integrating LLMs into real workflows, including RAG, MCP (Model Context Protocol), vector databases, agents, tool use, and context engineering- with hands-on experience building with several of them.
- Production experience implementing LLM-powered systems end-to-end, using relevant tools and frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, Pydantic AI, vector stores like Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector, observability tools like LangSmith or Langfuse).
- Solid foundation in core ML concepts; embeddings, evaluation, overfitting, generalization, and how classical ML relates to and differs from modern LLM-based approaches.
Nice to Have:
- Experience fine-tuning or distilling open-source models.
- Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.
- Experience with streaming, real-time systems, or low-latency inference.
- Familiarity with prompt evaluation frameworks and LLM-as-judge methodologies.
- Background in distributed systems or high-scale backend engineering.
What We Look For:
- A builder's mindset; you ship, measure, iterate, and don't get stuck in analysis.
- Comfort with ambiguity; LLM systems are non-deterministic and the field moves weekly. You navigate that with curiosity rather than frustration.
- Strong communication; you can explain trade-offs to engineers, product managers, and executives alike.
- Pragmatism; you know when to reach for a 200-line script and when to invest in proper infrastructure.

Work cross-functionally with R&D to push performance limits across interactive, streaming, and ML-ready analytics workloads.

Open-minded team player, passionate about self-driving technologies and solving hard problems

Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Data Infrastructure team!
The team's main responsibility is developing Voyantis' data platform - from building the microservices and pipelines that onboard customer data into our platform, to the infrastructure and tooling that enables our internal data teams to analyze, transform, process, and collect data independently. Our goal is to build leverage: every feature we ship reduces friction for the teams that depend on our platform. We're looking for a builder who takes full ownership from inception to production, cares deeply about quality and performance, and leverages AI tools to move faster and deliver better outcomes.
About Us
Voyantis was founded in 2020 on the premise that market fundamentals are shifting companies worldwide from growth-at-all-costs strategies to efficient and responsible growth practices, with a focus on improving Unit Economics. With a bold mission to leverage AI to reimagine the whole Growth process, to streamline this transition and ensure its sustainability, Voyantis eliminates the guesswork from customer value creation, empowering leaders with actionable strategies and tactics to acquire, nurture and retain the high-value customers their businesses really need, with the actions and the timing that would be most impactful to achieve their goals.
Leading companies like Miro, Rappi and Moneylion rely on Voyantis to effectively apply these predictions. They use Voyantis to drive high-value customer acquisition on platforms like Google and Meta, optimize incentives through Salesforce and Braze, and perfectly time upsells, resulting in a 20%-40% ROI uplift.
Voyantis is well-backed by top VCs such as Target Global and SquarePeg. The company has tripled in size annually over the past two years and now boasts a team of 100 with offices in California, New York and Tel Aviv.
Responsibilities
Design and implement scalable, production-grade data pipelines and microservices that ingest, transform, and move data from a wide variety of customer sources at high volume.
Build and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs that interface with our data ecosystem, ensuring reliability, low latency, and security.
Develop and evolve the platform infrastructure — data warehouse, orchestration, compute — that internal data teams rely on daily.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring workflows and turn ad-hoc needs into robust, self-serve platform capabilities.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineers across R&D to translate requirements into platform features.
Drive code quality through design reviews, code reviews, and adherence to engineering best practices.
Leverage AI tools throughout the full engineering cycle — from scoping and design to implementation and debugging — to deliver faster, higher-quality outcomes.
Requirements
5+ years building production backend services in Python / Go / Node
Strong software engineering fundamentals — design patterns, testing, CI/CD, microservices architecture
﻿ Experience designing and operating distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS)
Deep understanding of data — modeling, pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and query optimization.
Experience with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake / Databricks and orchestration tools such as Airflow / dbt.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Proven ability to take ownership end-to-end: from gathering requirements and designing solutions to deployment and production support.
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as a core part of the engineering workflow.
Proactive by nature with a strong sense of ownership and internal drive for excellence.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; high English proficiency.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Description
We are looking for a mission-driven Product Group Lead to own Acquire, our core product. We specialize in advanced AI predictive models, focusing on LTV, churn, and intent to drive business growth.
As the Product Group Lead for Acquire, you will be accountable for everything Acquire: strategy, roadmap, execution, and business outcomes. Acquire turns our predictive models into the conversion signals that drive smarter bidding on Google, Meta, and other channels, which means you will be operating at the intersection of predictive modeling, ad platform mechanics, and the daily reality of performance marketing teams.
Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead a group of three Product Managers, setting direction, raising the bar on product craft, and growing them as practitioners. This is a player-coach role: you will own the group's strategy and its people, while staying close enough to the product to make sharp calls on scope, model behavior, and customer trade-offs yourself.
A defining part of this role is your partnership with Operations. Today, a lot of what makes Acquire work is carried by our Operations team working alongside our AI engine. You will embed with them, understand their day-to-day in real detail, and productize it: turning manual and repetitive work into scalable, agent-driven capabilities so we can scale even further.

Voyantis was founded in 2020 on the premise that market fundamentals are shifting companies worldwide from growth-at-all-costs strategies to efficient and responsible growth practices, with a focus on improving Unit Economics. Responsibilities
Own the Acquire strategy and roadmap end to end, from problem definition and prioritization through launch and adoption, and define the success metrics the group is held to, favoring experimentation and clear evidence over opinion.
Lead, coach, and grow a group of three Product Managers, setting clear ownership boundaries, quality standards, and a healthy operating rhythm across the group.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering to translate predictive model capabilities into product value, making informed trade-offs between model performance, signal latency, explainability, and customer trust, grounded in deep expertise in ad platform mechanics (Smart Bidding tCPA/tROAS, UAC, SKAN and privacy-driven attribution shifts).
Work side by side with Operations to learn their workflows firsthand and turn them into product: agentic workflows, AI-driven automation, and self-serve tooling that let a small team scale across a much larger client base.
Stay close to customers and partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing on positioning, launch readiness, and expansion.
Requirements
Experience & Leadership: 6+ years in product management, including experience leading and developing other PMs. Able to set direction and raise the standard across a group while remaining hands-on where it matters, with strong cross-functional influence across Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales.
Domain Expertise: Strong background in marketing technology, ad-tech, or growth/performance marketing products. Familiarity with paid acquisition, bidding, attribution, and measurement is a significant advantage.
AI & Predictive Products: Hands-on experience shipping products built on predictive models or machine learning, plus practical experience designing agentic and LLM-based workflows into real products. Comfortable discussing model quality, evaluation, and failure modes with data scientists.
Product Craft & Customer Orientation: Excellent judgment on prioritization and scope, strong analytical and data fluency, and the ability to reduce a complex, ambiguous space into a clear product direction. Credible and comfortable with both external customers and internal operational stakeholders.

CyberSec Engineer
Kyiv
Wiliot was founded by the team that invented one of the technologies at the heart of 5G. Their next vision was to develop an IoT sticker, a self-powered computing element that harvests radio frequency energy, bringing connectivity and intelligence to everyday products and packaging. This revolutionary combination of cloud and semiconductor technology is already being used by some of the world’s largest consumer, retail, food, and pharmaceutical companies to transform how products are made, distributed, sold, used, and recycled.
Our investors include SoftBank, Amazon, Alibaba, Verizon, NTT DoCoMo, Qualcomm, and PepsiCo.
CyberSec Engineer works with all business units, supporting and maintaining IT security solutions and related governance for empowering business success. IT Security is responsible for protecting Cloud and IT infrastructure, edge devices, networks, and data. Responsible for preventing data breaches and monitoring and reacting to attacks.
CyberSec Engineer works on implementing a new developmental approach to the entire organization in preventing and alleviating threats/attacks. Oversee the company's security, backup, and redundancy strategies support. Should support security procedures in the software development process at every stage in the organization's ISMS activities.
The role relies on AI-assisted tools and scripting/automation to speed up analysis, response, and reporting.

● Assist and guide implementation of the ISMS activities.
● Monitoring the compliance of information security policies and procedures.
● Report to Senior Management periodically on different ISMS activities.
● Responsible for IT security, recognizing the security threats, and working with the IT team on closing vulnerabilities and mitigating misconfigurations.
● Monitoring and auditing that company's critical assets are secured and controlled.
● Incident Response - testing for and resolving system vulnerabilities, maintaining strong security best practices, and providing support for all incident handling measures.
● Install, configure, test, and maintain security systems, and other security tools related to IT Security.
● Maintain and support with SOC team collaboration and MDR service management.
● Use AI-based tools and scripting/automation to accelerate threat analysis, vulnerability triage, and security reporting.
Requirements
University or post-graduate degree
Strong academic background (e.g., computer science, engineering)
3+ years of experience in IT Security (IT Security and Cloud tools)
Strong private and public cloud security experience.
Experience and knowledge in security architecture, identity and access management, application security, and network security.
Cloud security experience.
Experience with Identity, SSO solutions and methodology. SAML and similar protocols.
Excellent written / verbal communication and professional maturity.
Able to multi-task in a fast paced, deadline-driven work environment.
Ability to work in afterhours to complete tasks in different time zones.
Ability to consistently demonstrate and reinforce organizational values.
Threat intelligence analyst experience. SIEM analyst experience.
Incident forensics (Digital forensics and incident response (DFIR)).
ISO 27001/27018 knowledge.
Working knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation, log analysis, and security tool integration.
Solid understanding of network security fundamentals (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPN, network segmentation) and operating system security (Linux and Windows hardening, patch management).

Data Solutions Analyst
San Mateo
Wiliot was founded by the team that invented one of the technologies at the heart of 5G. Their next vision was to develop an IoT sticker, a computing element that can power itself by harvesting radio frequency energy, bringing connectivity and intelligence to everyday products and packaging, things previously disconnect from the IoT. This revolutionary mixture of cloud and semiconductor technology is being used by some of the world’s largest consumer, retail, food and pharmaceutical companies to change the way we make, distribute, sell, use and recycle products.
Our investors include Softbank, Amazon, Alibaba, Verizon, NTT DoCoMo, Qualcomm and PepsiCo.
We are growing fast and need people that want to be part of the journey, commercializing Sensing as a Service and enabling “Intelligence for Everyday Thing”.
About the Role
We are looking for a Data Solutions Team Lead to join our delivery teams and work closely with customers on real-world IoT deployments.
In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and improving the quality and performance of data generated from customer environments. You will work as part of cross-functional Scrum teams, partnering with customers, product, and engineering to ensure successful deployments and meaningful data outcomes.
This is a highly customer-facing, hands-on role that sits at the intersection of data, operations, and product.
﻿Responsibilities
· Work closely with customers as part of ongoing projects and deployments
· Monitor real-time data streams and system performance across customer environments
· Analyze data to identify trends, gaps, and anomalies in performance and data quality

As a Security Researcher, you’ll help shape how the system understands real-world binaries, by reversing complex targets, finding where automation breaks, and turning that insight into product capabilities.
This is a hands-on research role with direct product impact: your work will influence accuracy, explainability, and trust in the results we deliver to security teams.
What You’ll Do
Reverse engineer complex binaries and large real-world codebases
Analyze malware samples and vulnerability-relevant behavior (as needed)
Identify edge cases and failure modes in decompilers and reversing workflows
Work closely with engineering to translate findings into robust product features
Validate accuracy and explainability of analysis outputs across diverse targets
What You Bring
Strong background in reverse engineering or security research
Experience with low-level programmingDeep understanding of operating systems, binary formats and common executables format
Comfort working with decompiled code and imperfect signals: partial symbols, noisy decompilation, obfuscation, etc.
Ability to clearly communicate technical findings
Nice to Have
Experience with vulnerability research or malware analysis
Experience reversing high-level languages
Public work: blog posts, talks, or CTF participation

adidas.description:
The role has ability to impact work from design concept phase to final production.
Key responsibilities
Act as a technical and digital consultant to cross-functional product creation teams by analysing designs for manufacturability, production efficiency, potential functional or quality risks, and costing opportunities, and by offering alternative solutions that are commercially, technically, and operationally feasible.
Own the Pattern &/or Tooling creation process by driving the translation of design information into a confirmed set of technical data and leading creation of upper &/or Tooling prototyping.
Provide advanced 2D and 3D expertise in cross functional projects made up of designers, developers and product marketing.
Ensure smooth and timely transition and involvement from concept stage to inline process & Statement Partner Product creation.
Conduct tear down meetings at all key development milestones (i.e. with Product testing, Developers) to ensure that each shoe is engineered and constructed to meet adidas quality standards, functional requirements and potential cost opportunities are identified.
Help to mentor new employees in technical product development by teaching them about adidas specific technical standards, processes and systems related to the Tech Package creation.
Offer technical solutions to the product team taking into consideration functional requirements of products, adidas quality standards, target costs and manufacturing constraints.
Design and create, using algorithmic and parametric methods, future concepts and ideas with a focus on aesthetics.
Connect insights to design and collaborate with teammates to create innovative products, services, interactions and experiences.
Enable faster decision making within Marketing, Design, Development and external Partners through virtual prototyping & in house sampling.
Drive concept ideas and independently plan, execute & evaluate innovative concept projects in cooperation with the key stakeholders in house (LA WRKSHP or PDX Sample Studio) to create physical prototypes.
Continuously increase your knowledge regarding latest technological trends in CAD systems and processes and Footwear manufacturing.
Research within Sportswear, Fashion and other related industries to discover adaptable concepts for footwear (online research, supplier and fair visits)
Document findings and present them to the cross functional teams including marketing, design and development for review on potential inclusion into future footwear products.
Prepare best practice manuals for new processes and help to imbed these into development calendars across Statement and Streetwear LA.
Be a catalyst in adoption of AI tools enabled by Adidas to implement in creation workflows.
Key relationships
Product Development, Marketing, Design
Liaison Offices and supply partners (Tier 1/2/3)
Advanced 3D Team
Fit and Wear Test Department
Innovation
Material Development
Costing
Knowledge, skills and abilities
Advanced knowledge in digital tools and methods, mold making and/or shoe making for pattern engineering
Progressive work experience with 2D and 3D CAD applications; Rhino experience preferred.
Progressive work experience in Jevero for pattern engineering
Passion for tinkering, experimenting & building
Working knowledge of Grasshopper for Rhino 3D, Botcha, Raven, Blender, and Vizcom as tools to support digital creation and footwear development workflows.
Ability to provide input for enhancement of Fit and Comfort Engineering
Ability to integrate & create AI agents or workflows to enhance technical impact & speed of creation.
Strong communication (both written and verbal)
Well organized team player who feels comfortable communicating in an international and diverse environment and work in a fast-changing footwear world.
Ability to anticipate and define problems and develop innovative solutions
Experience working with Sourcing partners (T1, T2…) in USA & Asia.
Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and/or Adobe Photoshop; proficiency with Microsoft 365.
Knowledge in the latest trends in technology and design
Highly collaborative
Continuous learning/growth mindset
Fluent in English (written and spoken)
Travel, domestic and International as required by business needs
Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications
Four-year college or university degree, comparable technical or engineering education or equivalent experience as a Technical Product Designer, technical draftsman, Mold Maker or Pattern Engineer.
At least 5 years of work experience in the athletic footwear industry, specializing in product development, pattern engineering, tooling or design

the role contributes to the data preparation, analysis, modelling, and testing that sit behind our data science products – and builds, over time, the technical depth and business understanding needed to take ownership of a use case.
Key Responsibilities
Hands-on analytical delivery (under guidance)
Perform data extraction, cleaning, profiling, and exploratory analysis in support of active use cases
Build and test analytical components – features, model candidates, calculation logic, validation scripts – against requirements agreed with the responsible Data Scientist
Write clear, readable Python and SQL, following team standards on version control, code review, and documentation from day one
Investigate data quality issues, trace them back to source systems, and propose fixes
Prepare validation outputs, back-tests, and comparison analyses that show whether a solution performs as intended
Support solutions running in production: run scheduled checks, flag anomalies, and help reproduce and root-cause issues
Produce analysis outputs – notebooks, charts, summary tables, dashboard components – that colleagues can pick up and re-run without explanation
Stakeholder collaboration & communication
Join working sessions with DC, Outbound, and planning stakeholders; capture requirements, assumptions, and open questions in a structured way
Ask questions to understand the operational process behind the data rather than taking fields and figures at face value
Present analysis results to the project team and working-level business contacts clearly and honestly, including what the analysis does not show
Support user testing and enablement sessions; collect user feedback and log it for follow-up
Keep the responsible Data Scientist and the Product Owner informed on progress and blockers early
Learning & ways of working
Actively build technical depth in the team’s core stack and working knowledge of distribution centre and outbound processes
Seek out and apply feedback on code and analysis; treat code review as a learning channel
Work in agile delivery cycles: manage own tasks, estimate honestly, and raise blockers early
Contribute to team documentation, reusable components, and knowledge sharing
Ensure compliance with relevant statutory or external regulations and codes of good practice
This role carries no direct people management responsibility.

Data Scientists and Senior Data Scientists within SCM Advanced Analytics (day-to-day guidance)
Director Product Ownership – SCM Advanced Analytics (line manager)
Global & Market SCM teams – Distribution Centre operations and planning teams
Data engineers and other Advanced Analytics teams
Other teams within Tech (e.g. Data Platforms & Data Governance)

Education
University degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Econometrics, Operations Research, Industrial or Supply Chain Engineering, or comparable)
Work experience
2 – 4 years of professional experience in a data, analytics, or engineering role; relevant internships, working student positions, or a substantial applied thesis project are equally valid
Any exposure to supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or retail operations is a plus, but is not a requirement
Hard skills
Working proficiency in Python and SQL, demonstrated through academic projects, internships, or personal work
Sound grounding in statistics and core data science methods (regression, classification, clustering, basic time-series)
Familiarity with version control (Git) and comfort working in a notebook environment
Exposure to cloud data or lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Spark/PySpark) is an advantage – training will be provided
Able to visualise data and present results clearly; experience with a BI or app framework is a plus
Fluent English (written and spoken)
Soft skills
Clear and to-the-point written and oral communication skills (English)
Genuine curiosity – asks why the numbers look the way they do, and follows the question through
Intellectually honest: reports what the data supports and flags uncertainty rather than smoothing over it
Structured, reliable, and accountable for agreed tasks and deadlines
Eager to learn quickly, act on feedback, and work hands-on with operations teams, including on site
Resilience and a solution-oriented attitude

Creators- If you want to build a tomorrow better than the day that came before, you’re a creator. Creators find inspiration in unlikely places, look at the world in their own unique way, are confident and have an uncanny ability to connect dots that others just don’t see.
Innovators- You can dive into a complex problem and come out the other end with the simple solution no one else saw coming.
Confident- Be bold and bring a fresh perspective to the table. It’s the people who see the world a little differently than the rest that create the breakthroughs that inspire us all.
Determined - Never settle. Our work space is about discovery. Competition exists...but only by competing with your personal best, not your team members. Discover your boundaries and push them. Discover your team’s strengths and build them.
Collaborators – You thrive on building relationships and creating partnerships to help us be the best sports brand in the world.

MANAGE DIGITAL DEMAN INTAKE
Manage the digital demand intake process from idea submission through prioritization, business case support, and funding approval coordination.

Ability to influence without authority and support accountability across cross-functional teams.
Strong prioritization skills and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Comfortable working with leadership stakeholders and preparing concise, leadership-ready materials.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with portfolio, project, and work management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Planner, Jira, Workfront, Monday.com, Planview, or similar platforms.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards, trackers, templates, and process documentation.
Ability to analyze portfolio data, identify trends, summarize risks, and create actionable insights.

Description
Senior UX Designer at Walmart Global Tech Israel
﻿
About us:
Walmart Global Tech’s presence in Israel has grown over the past few years with 4 acquisitions to date, all develop using industry leading technologies.
We are seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Senior UX Designer to join our Tel Aviv UX team.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in User Experience (UX/UI) and understanding or User Research (UXR) , combined with strong UI and creative design skills , a deep understanding of research- and data-driven product goals , and the ability to take ownership of end-to-end UX processes .
This role requires a designer who can work in a structured and methodical way —defining problems clearly, grounding decisions in user research and data , and translating insights into clear, intuitive user flows and high-quality experiences , while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead Core Product UX Design: Take full ownership of the user experience for Walmart Israel's digital products, shaping the design vision and transforming complex requirements into intuitive, highly functional digital solutions.
End-to-End Execution: Map comprehensive user journeys and structural workflows, seamlessly translating them into interactive prototypes and pixel-perfect, high-fidelity UI designs.
Research & Data-Driven Iteration: Conduct targeted user research (e.g., usability testing, user interviews) and leverage behavioral analytics to validate design hypotheses, pinpoint friction areas, and continuously optimize the product.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central design advocate, partnering closely with Product Managers and Engineers to balance user insights with technical feasibility and overarching business goals.
Requirements
UX Strategy, Research & Data
﻿Research & Synthesis Expertise: Demonstrated ability to conduct foundational and evaluative research (interviews, surveys) and distill findings into actionable artifacts like personas and Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD).
Methodological Fluency: Deep understanding of Human-Centered Design principles, Double Diamond frameworks, and Information Architecture modeling.
Analytical Acumen: Strong capability to interpret behavioral data, A/B test results, and funnel metrics to ground design hypotheses in empirical evidence.
Design Execution & Collaboration
Craft & Tooling Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Figma and Adobe CS, backed by a portfolio showcasing scalable design systems and meticulous attention to UI detail.
Collaborative Mindset: Proven track record of thriving in agile, cross-functional environments alongside technical and commercial teams.
Persuasive Communication: Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently defend design choices to leadership using structured rationale and data.
Nice to Have – AI Mindset:
Interest in how AI is shaping user experience and product design
Ability to integrate AI thinking into discovery, ideation, and UX flows
Awareness of user trust, transparency, and limitations in AI-driven experiences
Experience designing AI-driven or data-informed experiences is a plus
Additional Requirements:
Strong English communication skills
Hebrew – required

Walmart Global Tech's presence in Israel has grown over the past few years through 4 acquisitions to date , and this team sits at the core of Walmart's e-commerce platform — the largest retailer in the world .
You'll join an AI Platform team that applies advanced Data Science, NLP, ML, and LLM-based capabilities to infer deep product insights.
Your Mission:
﻿
You bridge complex technical infrastructure and data-science-driven capabilities, turning diverse requests from product teams into a unified, scalable platform roadmap. This is a high-visibility role requiring strong execution and the ability to align engineering, data science, and global stakeholders.
﻿Responsibilities:
﻿Platform Roadmap: Turn diverse requests from product teams into a unified, scalable platform roadmap — prioritized by business impact and scalability.
Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve dependencies and ship reliably at scale.
Global Collaboration: Work seamlessly with Israel-based and US/global teams, bridging timezones and working styles.
Requirements
2–4 years of PM or Technical PM experience in backend, platform, API, or data-driven environments.
Strong ability to abstract specific feature requests into generalized, reusable platform capabilities.
A B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical/quantitative field — or meaningful equivalent experience.
Deep comfort with technical systems: REST APIs, databases, ETL pipelines, and high-scale data infrastructure. Strong conceptual grasp across the stack (Kafka, NoSQL, BigQuery, agentic/MCP platforms, and similar).
Bias for action — extremely organized, execution-focused, and eager to move fast in ambiguity.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) — fluent enough to own async communication, lead cross-timezone meetings, and write precise technical specs with a global team.
Advantages & Nice-to-Haves
B2C e-commerce or consumer product background — consumer intuition helps prioritize the right platform signals.
Hands-on experience working alongside Data Science on model evaluations or quality frameworks.
Who Thrives Here
We especially appreciate people who...
Are genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that scales to hundreds of millions of shoppers — even when the work itself is invisible to them.
Learn fast, share ideas openly, and give honest feedback.
Have a can-do attitude and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Think in systems — connecting a single technical decision to its impact across every team and surface it touches.
Not sure you fit all the criteria? Apply anyway — let us decide.

You'll work at the intersection of Data Science, e-commerce, and data platforms – owning capabilities that directly shape how millions of customers discover and buy products. You’ll own real product problems, and work across Walmart's e-commerce organization.
The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and technical foundations – from a quantitative, engineering, or CS background – combined with hands-on experience working alongside data science or ML teams, strong intuitions on how to define quality criteria and drive model improvements, and the ability to take full ownership of a technical backlog and deliver results independently.

﻿ Own, deeply understand, and execute plans for improving NLP / DS models and capabilities across various domains and customer needs; from prioritizing improvement iterations, through defining quality criteria, to collaborating with DS and Engineering on delivery.
Define evaluation frameworks: Establish quality dimensions, create labelling guidelines and examples, and work with quality and data science teams to build automated evaluation pipelines.
Own and drive a prioritized backlog of improvements to platform capabilities; understand the domain in-depth, gather feedback and faults (incl. customer analytics), and apply methodical reasoning to assess best prioritization within a given capacity.
Collaborate with data science and ML engineers as well as with global product teams, to translate product problems into model improvements; challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and drive measurable outcomes.
Manage multiple concurrent workstreams across a global, cross-timezone team.
Requirements
1-2 years of Product Management experience in a data-centric or platform-focused role – or proven equivalent analytical/technical background with clear PM-relevant responsibilities.
Strong technical foundation – degree in Computer Science, Data Science, a highly related scientific field
Passion for, and deep understanding of ML and NLP concepts, techniques, and models.
Experience engaging directly with data science or ML functions, feeling comfortable in technical discussions and in meaningfully challenging DS choices.
Strong analytical skills – comfortable with data, metrics, and quality evaluation; able to define what "good" looks like and how to measure it.
Strong written and spoken English; able to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently and drive progress.
Advantage: experience managing B2C products and features.
Advantage: experience working with teams across different time zones and geographies.
We especially appreciate people who...
• Are genuinely excited by the problems AI can solve for shoppers.
• Learn fast, share ideas openly, and give honest feedback.
• Have a can-do attitude and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Think customer-first, connect technical outputs to real shopper value and impact.

About the Role
We are seeking a world-class, highly analytical, and business-driven FP&A Manager (Individual Contributor) to join our finance team, reporting directly to the CFO and to partner directly with our executive leadership team. This is a high-visibility, super-strategic role designed for a heavy-hitter who thrives on complete autonomy and possesses exceptional financial and analytical capabilities.
This is a rare hybrid role: we need a high-level strategic thinker who is equally thrilled to roll up their sleeves, dive into the raw data, and build complex models from scratch (100% hands-on). You will act as an internal strategic consultant, embedded deeply with our commercial leaders to dissect funnels, optimize sales efficiency, and deliver actionable insights that shape our growth trajectory.
Responsibilities
· Executive & Board Partnership : Serve as the primary finance partner to the executive team. Lead the creation of high-impact financial narratives, investor relations materials, and strategic presentations for Board of Directors meetings and fundraising initiatives.
· Go-To-Market & Revenue Analytics : Partner closely with Marketing and RevOps to analyze full-funnel metrics, pipeline health, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency, and net dependency/churn trends.
· SaaS Unit Economics & Pricing: Own the financial analysis of SaaS unit economics, Lifetime Value (LTV), Lifetime Value to CAC ratios, and provide strategic deal-desk financial support to optimize contract margins and pricing structures.
· Next-Gen Financial Intelligence: Architect, own, and scale the company’s complex forecasting models, budget-vs-actual (BVA) frameworks, and rolling forecasts.
· AI & Automation Architecture: Lead the implementation of an AI-first approach to financial planning. Build and maintain advanced dashboards using BI and AI-powered platforms to maximize automated reporting and predictive analytics, eliminating traditional manual workflows.
· Operational Efficiency: Proactively identify margin expansion opportunities and cost-efficiency initiatives through rigorous benchmarking, gross margin analysis, and operational deep-dives.

· Experience: 6+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, with a proven track record in hyper-growth SaaS companies or leading tech ecosystems known for rigorous, data-driven cultures.
· Seniority & Executive Presence: Director-level business acumen with the confidence, articulation, and corporate storytelling skills required to influence senior executives, institutional investors, and the Chairman.
· GTM Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience working alongside Go-To-Market teams, sales funnels, and modern Revenue Operations frameworks.
· 100% Hands-On Autonomy: Proven capability to operate as a sole contributor—capable of executing complex projects and models independently without relying on a large team for execution.
· Tech & AI Native: Exceptional proficiency with advanced financial modeling and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). Active mastery or deep eagerness to integrate generative AI and automation workflows into daily finance operations.
· Language: Complete fluency in English (both written and verbal) is an absolute requirement.
Education & Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in a highly quantitative or business field.
· MBA, CPA, or advanced analytical degree is a strong advantage, but proven "battle-tested" analytical brilliance in a top-tier tech company is valued above all.

Description
Bounce is seeking a Controller to oversee our finance operations and help guide our financial strategy during a critical phase of growth.
This is an exciting opportunity for a results-oriented professional with a passion for scaling finance teams and processes in a fast-paced startup environment. You will play an integral role in shaping the company’s financial future, managing the month-end close process, ensuring compliance, and driving efficiency across our finance function.
If you are eager to grow professionally and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, we want to hear from you!
About Us
Bounce is a fast-growing fintech startup redefining debt management with AI-driven solutions that create seamless, user-friendly experiences for consumers and creditors alike.
With teams in Tel Aviv and New York, we are supporting hundreds of thousands of consumers as they navigate their financial journeys while forming strategic partnerships with leading creditors and fintech innovators. As we continue our rapid expansion, we're looking for talented individuals to join our team and make an impact.
Why Bounce?
At Bounce, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking team transforming the financial landscape.
As a Controller, you’ll have a direct impact on our growth and success, with opportunities to shape the company's financial strategy and process. If you're ready to accelerate your career in a high-energy, high-growth environment, we want to hear from you.
Join us and help shape the future of debt management!
How You’ll Spend Your Time
Finance Operations & Month-End Close: Lead daily finance operations and ensure the month-end close process is accurate and completed on time, providing reliable financial statements.
Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and improve financial processes to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.
Accounting Research & Compliance: Keep up-to-date with evolving accounting standards and local tax regulations. Ensure compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements while conducting research on complex accounting matters.
Audit Management: Manage the audit process, working closely with external auditors to ensure accurate, industry-standard financial reporting.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with teams across the company to collect insights, data, and feedback, driving better financial decision-making and alignment.
Financial Analysis & Reporting: Provide in-depth financial analysis (including Budget vs. Actual and trend reports) to support business decisions and guide strategy.
Requirements
Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field. CPA certification and experience with a Big 4 accounting firm required.
Experience: At least 3 years of experience as a Controller, preferably within a high-growth startup or fintech company.
Skills: Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and tax compliance. Proficient in accounting software and financial systems, with NetSuite experience a must.
Startup Mindset: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment, balancing multiple tasks and priorities.
Analytical Skills: Exceptional problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to communicate complex financial data clearly and effectively.

Description
We're looking for an IT Manager to lead and own IT operations and security across the company. It's a broad, global role, spanning four sites in Israel and the US, that covers everything from user and device management to vendor processes and security operations, with plenty of room to build and shape the function as we grow.
This is a rare opportunity to own an entire function in a growing company. You’ll be the person everyone knows, relies on, and trusts. Full decision-making authority, direct exposure to leadership, and a wide-open field to build, processes, infrastructure, and eventually a team. If you thrive on breadth, ownership, and being central to how a company operates, this is your playground.
About Us
Bounce is a fintech startup revolutionizing debt management for consumers and creditors with our best-in-class product. By leveraging the power of AI and automation, we create user-friendly experiences that drive positive outcomes for all parties involved.
With a team based in Tel Aviv and New York, we have been growing rapidly, supporting hundreds of thousands of consumers on their journey to financial resilience and building partnerships with top creditors and fintech companies.
How You\u2019ll Spend Your Time
Own IT operations globally - manage user accounts, devices, and office IT infrastructure across Israel and US sites. Handle onboarding/offboarding workflows, device management (MDM), and day-to-day help desk support.
Manage vendors and subscriptions - build and run vendor assessment and procurement processes in collaboration with Compliance and Finance. Control enterprise SaaS subscriptions and evaluate new tools.
Lead security operations - oversee SOC, audit logging, vendor risk assessments, and security questionnaires for sales prospects. Work alongside Compliance and the CTO to maintain and improve the company’s security posture.
Drive process and structure - build the workflows, documentation, and policies that turn a reactive IT function into a proactive one.
Communicate with leadership - present security priorities, budget requests, and risk assessments to executives. Prioritize pragmatically and build buy-in across the organization.
Drive growth - think strategically about how IT scales with the company, and take ownership of building the team and resources needed over time.
Requirements
5+ years of hands-on IT experience, ideally in a startup or a small IT team that covered the full scope - user management, devices, infrastructure, help desk, and admin
Solid understanding of security operations - SOC, compliance frameworks (SOC 2 or similar), audit processes, and vendor risk assessments
Experience managing vendors and SaaS subscriptions at an organizational level
Experience supporting multiple sites/locations across geographies
Strong communication skills - ability to translate technical priorities into business language for non-technical stakeholders
Self-directed - comfortable being the sole professional authority in your domain, operating with high autonomy
Willingness to be hands-on - from help desk support to cable runs, especially in the first 1-2 years
Strong English (spoken and written)
Willingness to travel to the US periodically
Nice to Have
Experience building or managing a small IT team

Collaborate with backend, infrastructure, and product teams to ship features end to end
Requirements
5+ years of systems or backend engineering experience, with strong Go skills
Solid grounding in operating system internals or low-level programming (C/C++/Rust, kernel, syscalls, memory management)
Deep understanding of Linux networking, syscalls, and process/container isolation
Familiarity with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, containers, CRI/CNI)
A performance mindset- you think about cache lines, allocations, and tail latency
Care about clean, maintainable, well-architected code
Love working on developer-first products and want your work to have real impact
Bonus Points
Hands-on experience with eBPF or other kernel instrumentation frameworks
Background in protocol parsing, packet processing, or network observability
Contributions to open-source systems or infrastructure projects
Why groundcover?
We're developers building for developers.
You'll have real ownership over your work.
We care about the craft, not just the speed.

As the category leader in Autonomous Cloud and AI Infrastructure Resource Management, we're trusted by leading enterprises including Adobe, Wiz, Epic Games, Northwestern Mutual, Coinbase, DocuSign, and Fortune 100 companies to autonomously manage their most critical production environments.
Backed by Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and other leading VCs with over $210M in funding, ScaleOps is the leading player in a massive and growing market. We are building the autonomous infrastructure management platform that will power the next decade of enterprise compute.

Join a highly skilled team building our core product offering.
Build a world-class Kubernetes resource management platform to improve the productivity of DevOps teams across the world.
Gain a deep understanding of Kubernetes and container technologies.
Write extensive code in Go and develop deep expertise in Kubernetes internals.
Enjoy a high degree of autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Bring
A positive individual who enjoys working with others.
An experienced software engineer with significant hands-on experience developing cloud-based applications.
4+ years of industry experience developing complex, technically demanding, large-scale systems.
A good understanding of cloud-native technologies, including container technologies and Kubernetes.
A degree in Computer Science from a top academic institution, or relevant experience as a Software Engineer in an IDF technological unit.
Someone who enjoys taking ownership and collaborating with others to build a world-class product.
The opportunity to significantly impact the company's future, working on the core product alongside top-tier engineers in a culture of innovation.
