tailormed.description:
The Role
At TailorMed , we’re on a mission to eliminate barriers across the entire medication journey—from affordability to access and adherence. As a pioneering force in healthcare, we’re building a new category that transforms how patients, providers, pharmacies, life sciences, and payers collaborate to ensure every patient receives the treatment they need without delay.
TailorMed is the medication success platform removing every barrier across the patient journey, from access and affordability through adherence and ongoing care. Our connected network spans 945+ hospitals, 4,700+ clinics, 3,100+ pharmacies, 100+ life sciences programs with a reach of 75 million patients and has secured more than $7.4 billion in financial assistance since 2020 tapping into an asset of 6000+ support programs.
As Sourcing Partner, you’ll own the top of the funnel for TailorMed’s hiring in the US — building pipeline for sales, customer success, operations and marketing roles across all levels. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with a direct line to leadership, where the people you bring in will shape the direction of the company.
You’ll work closely with our recruiters and hiring managers to understand exactly what ‘great’ looks like for each role, build targeted sourcing strategies, and consistently deliver qualified, engaged candidates into the pipeline..
What You’ll Do
• Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies for GTM and Ops roles
• Identify and engage passive candidates in order to impact top of funnel and candidate pipeline
• Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements, ideal candidate profiles, and what makes each role compelling
• Maintain a strong and organised pipeline in our ATS, ensuring accurate tracking and timely communication with candidates
• Contribute to employer branding efforts — helping TailorMed show up in the right communities and in front of the right talent
• Continuously refine sourcing approaches based on data — tracking outreach rates, response rates, and pipeline conversion
• Stay close to the talent market — understanding where great people are, what they care about, and how to reach them
What We’re Looking For
• 3–5 years of sourcing or recruiting experience, with a strong focus on GTM roles (sales, CS, marketing)
• Experience working in digital health B2B SaaS is required. Experiences working for companies in areas such as patient support services, specialty pharmacy, care coordination, or financial assistance platforms is a strong advantage.
• Proven track record of building pipeline for hard-to-fill roles through proactive, creative sourcing
• Strong written communication skills — you write outreach that people actually respond to
• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms;
• Data-driven mindset — you track what’s working, iterate quickly, and can speak to your pipeline metrics
• Genuinely curious about people — you enjoy the detective work of finding the right person and making a compelling case for why they should talk to us
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where things change and priorities shift
Why TailorMed
• Work that matters — every hire you make contributes to a platform that helps patients access care they couldn’t otherwise afford
• A talent function that has a real seat at the table — sourcing is treated as a strategic capability, not a support function
• A high-growth environment where your impact is visible and your scope can grow with you
• A team that is ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely invested in doing things well
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and the flexibility of a fully remote role
We’re not looking for people who want a job. We’re looking for the ones who can’t help but build. If you’re energised by the challenge of finding exceptional people and motivated by work that has real impact, we’d love to hear from you.
TailorMed is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. TailorMed prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Due to the sensitive nature of the data that TailorMed handles, finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.

the role
Vi is an enterprise AI platform for health enterprises – healthcare, biopharma, and wellness. We deploy agentic AI and predictive models into production environments where the output drives next best actions for patients, care teams, and operations to deliver ROI and improve health outcomes.
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to own the engineering team in Israel – all those working as part of the Platform layer and Vi’s Israeli-led product squads – as a true “hands-on” player/coach.
This is an IC builder + team leader role and not a management-only. You will carry full accountability for the people, the architecture, and the shipped outcome, while remaining the strongest IC & deep in the code: Building solutions from scratch and prototyping the hardest parts yourself. You set the technical bar by example.
What you’ll be part of
Core Platform – Shared, composable data and deep technical capabilities to power all Vi’s products and teams: Services span around data systems, company brain, tabular and causal foundation models, generic agentic workflows and outreach in the client’s environments, etc.
Data Web – Continuous enrichment of Vi’s proprietary, licensed, and collected data assets and productization of it across the company.
Pulse – Vi’s external-facing LLM-driven production analytics, data-querying, and visualizations system.
Israeli-led application squads – Activate and Engage HCP: productized AI running the full patient/HCP acquisition and engagement client loop, from problem definition through modeling, integrations, shipping, and measurement.
Responsibilities
Hands-on technical leadership: Own the architectural bar across the platform and IL squads, including resolving hard technical stuff yourself.
Team ownership and talent: Hire, calibrate, mentor, and grow a small team of exceptionally strong ICs. Own performance, pace, standards and the talent bar for engineering in Israel.
Platform-first execution: Deliver shared capabilities that every squad composes instead of rebuilding. Turn field-derived patterns from live deployments into reusable platform components.
Delivery accountability: Own the technical outcome of IL-led deployments end-to-end.
Non-functional integrity: Reliability, performance, security, observability, and quality of everything in your scope, in a HIPAA-regulated environment.
AI-native operating model: Push the team to work at AI speed & mindset – agentic development tooling, automated evaluation, and a team structure that adapts as the world and tooling continues to change.
Cross-functional partnership: Work directly with Product, the US application squads, Infrastructure, Data Science, and the commercial team. Translate client and business constraints into architecture, and architecture into commitments people can build around.
Requirements
Requirements
7+ years in software or data engineering , including significant time in senior IC roles, and 3+ years managing engineers – while still writing code daily.
Strong backend and data foundations – APIs, real-time and event-driven services, and high-scale distributed data pipelines in Python with Spark or comparable frameworks.
Production AWS depth – S3, Glue, EMR, Athena, the Iceberg table format, compute (EKS, ECS, Batch) and IaC (CDK preferred).
Production AI/ML systems experience – feature pipelines, training data preparation, inference services, vector stores, and modern LLM/agentic patterns including RAG, MCP, evaluation, and output guardrails.
Significant startup experience, ideally as a founding or early member of a company under 150 people. Comfortable in 0→1 with incomplete requirements and a radical sense of urgency.
Exceptional learning velocity: You absorb new domains, tools, and model capabilities faster than the market moves.
Strong communication in English with US-based stakeholders, technical and commercial.
What success looks like in the first 12 months
Platform V1 delivered on schedule and genuinely adopted by every squad, with capabilities consumed rather than rebuilt.
Single-threaded ownership for every individual & capability on the team, execution at high pace.
IL-led squads winning the large majority of their POCs and converting them into retained logos.
The Israeli engineering team recognized internally as a core driver of Vi’s overall results.
vi.title: Director of Engineering

vi.description:
Responsibilities
Source exclusive data: Identify emerging data companies, unique datasets, collection methods, and partnership opportunities that could strengthen Vi’s products.
Own evaluations end-to-end: Lead each opportunity from first conversation and sample access through profiling, quality analysis, commercial assessment, and a clear go/no-go decision.
Translate data into product value: Explain what a dataset contains, how it should be modeled, joined and refreshed, which Vi use cases it improves, and how impact should be measured.
Create proprietary signals: Design experiments, partnerships, collection programs, and tools that allow Vi to capture data unavailable elsewhere.
Requirements
1-3 years of experience in product/data/analytics or another highly analytical role.
Strong analytical skills including Python, SQL, and a critical mindset, with the ability to explore datasets, inspect schemas, and test assumptions hands-on.
Highly entrepreneurial, proactive, and resourceful, with the instinct to find opportunities, open doors, and build practical solutions without waiting for defined instructions.
Exceptional learning velocity and curiosity; able to understand unfamiliar data domains, technologies, markets, and product use cases quickly.
Comfort operating with ambiguity, high ownership, rapid iteration, and a strong sense of urgency.
Preferred: Understanding of healthcare data, claims, providers, patients, life sciences, or regulated data environments.
Excellent spoken English
Your first 90 days
Weeks 1-3: Hands-on learning the full Data Web and related industries, where the gaps are, how different products use it, and for which use cases.
Weeks 4-7: Own your first 2 evaluations end-to-end, including analysis, recommendation, and proposed ingestion approach.
Weeks 8-10: Ship one new signal source into production, end-to-end.
What success looks like
Evaluation throughput increases, including faster iterations to decline/onboard new opportunities.
Net new signals you source or create are deployed into Vi products.
Your work improves coverage, match rate, data quality, predictive lift, and product performance.
vi.title: Product Manager

vi.description:
Responsibilities
Build and own scalable data pipelines: Design, implement, and operate robust pipelines for high-volume structured and unstructured data.
Develop reusable data models: Create normalized, well-documented data layers, shared dimensions, and production-ready datasets for analytics, AI, and predictive modeling use cases.
Ensure data quality and reliability: Implement automated validation, anomaly and drift detection, lineage, monitoring, alerting, and recovery processes.
Own production performance: Improve scalability, cost efficiency, security, observability, and operational resilience across the data platform.
Solve complex problems hands-on: Investigate difficult data inconsistencies, pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and architectural challenges directly.
Partner cross-functionally: Translate product, client, compliance, and business requirements into clear technical designs and dependable production systems.
Requirements
5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, including ownership of production data systems.
Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
Deep experience designing and operating ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and distributed data-processing systems.
Production experience with Apache Spark or a comparable large-scale processing framework.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including S3, Glue, EMR, Athena, and related compute and orchestration services.
Experience with modern data lakehouse or warehouse architectures; experience with Apache Iceberg is a strong advantage.
Experience with workflow orchestration, CI/CD, Docker, Git, and infrastructure as code such as AWS CDK and CloudFormation.
Strong understanding of data quality, schema evolution, lineage, observability, privacy, security, and access controls.
High comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with incomplete requirements, high ownership, and a strong sense of urgency.
vi.title: Senior Data Engineer

vi.description:
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, operating, and scaling our cloud infrastructure while supporting both engineering and machine learning initiatives.
You will own our AWS environment end-to-end — from infrastructure architecture and Kubernetes operations to MLOps enablement, security hardening, and cost optimization. This role goes beyond traditional DevOps and includes responsibilities across IT operations support, multi-account AWS management, DevSecOps practices, DevFinOps ownership, and machine learning infrastructure.
You will play a critical role in ensuring our systems are secure, scalable, observable, and cost-efficient, while enabling fast and reliable software and model delivery.
Responsibilities
Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Ownership
Design, implement, and maintain scalable infrastructure in a multi-account AWS organization
Manage and deploy applications using Helm charts, GitOps workflows using ArgoCD
Support CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
Observability & Reliability
Implement and maintain monitoring and logging solutions.
Define alerts, dashboards, and SLOs to ensure system health and operational excellence.
MLOps Enablement
Support and operate ML infrastructure in AWS
Enable reliable model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
DevSecOps & Security
Implement security best practices across infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines
Enforce IAM least-privilege policies and secure networking configurations
Integrate security ownership and compliance controls.
DevFinOps & Cost Optimization
Monitor and optimize AWS resource utilization and costs
Implement cost visibility and reporting practices
IT & Operational Support
Support internal IT-related infrastructure tasks
Continuously improve operational processes and automation
Requirements
~5 years of experience working in a DevOps or Platform Engineering role.
BSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent (required).
Strong hands-on experience operating in an AWS environment.
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals , including: VPC design, subnets, routing tables, Load balancers, NAT/Internet gateways.
Experience maintaining Kubernetes clusters at scale , including managing and deploying Helm charts.
Strong background in observability and monitoring using: Prometheus , Grafana , and Loki and CloudWatch.
Experience with GitOps workflows and continuous delivery using ArgoCD.
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / Cloudformation), preferably using AWS CDK (Python and/or TypeScript).
Core understanding of MLOps principles , including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management.
vi.title: Senior DevOps Engineer

vi.description:
Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end sourcing efforts, identifying high-potential candidates across various channels
Utilize advanced sourcing tools and techniques to proactively build strong talent pipelines
Apply creative, out-of-the-box thinking to identify candidates for challenging roles
Own and optimize the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to offer stage
Develop and implement scalable recruiting processes across multiple functions
Serve as a trusted partner to hiring managers and the CEO, advising on talent strategy and workforce planning
Proactively reach out to passive top talent using diverse sourcing strategies and AI tools
Requirements
At least 5 years of hands-on experience in full-cycle recruitment, including sourcing.
Proven natural intelligence and problem-solving of complex operational and execution tasks
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Social Work, or a related field.
Proficient in utilizing various sourcing channels, tools, and platforms to identify and engage potential candidates
Strong ability to assess and evaluate candidate profiles to ensure alignment with job requirements, company culture, and values
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills
Experience in using data analytics and metrics to measure the effectiveness of sourcing strategies
vi.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
